common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r0:c5: Riding a horse\nPress [i2] to speed up and [i1] to slow down quickly.\nYour horse keeps running without [i2], but gradually slows.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r1:c5: Chased by a rampaging car?\nIf a car starts chasing you,\nrun close to utility poles and streetlights.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r2:c5: Door indicator lights\nDoors in the institute have colored lights beside them.\nBlue: open. Red: locked. Yellow: opens under certain conditions.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r3:c5: Plan your escape\nLook around and decide where to go next.\nIt is easier to escape if you plan before an attack.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r4:c5: Observation deck: first floor\nTalk to people and examine your surroundings.\nIt helps you escape, and you'll learn the layout as you go.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r5:c5: Avoiding danger\nWatch above you as well as ahead and to the sides.\nStaying alert can help you avoid danger.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r6:c5: When a building collapses\nGet as far away as you can from a collapsing building.\nLarge pieces of falling debris are extremely dangerous.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r7:c5: Chased by a violent man?\nStay calm and press [i4] at the right moment to dodge.\nYou can also hold [i12] to sprint away.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r8:c5: Staying hidden\nMove to the next hiding place while your pursuer looks away.\nStay calm and find your next hiding place in advance.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r9:c5: Ladders\nIf you see a ladder, try climbing it.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r10:c5: Talking to Yuki\nEven in quiet moments, try talking to Yuki.\nYou may discover a new side of her.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r11:c5: Chased by a violent man?\nStay calm and press [i4] at the right moment to dodge.\nYou can also hold [i12] to sprint away.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r12:c5: Not sure where to go?\nTry talking to different people.\nYou may find a new way forward.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r13:c5: Inside the collapsing restaurant\nWatch above you as well as your footing.\nA little caution can help you avoid danger.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r14:c5: On the lower level\nTake your time and explore your surroundings.\nYou may find a way forward.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r15:c5: Costume effects\nSome costumes increase your maximum health\nor stamina while you wear them.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r16:c5: Food and drink effects\nSome food and drink items slow down stamina loss\nfor a limited time.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r17:c5: Stamina\nThe lower gauge at the top left shows your stamina.\nIf it runs out, you cannot sprint for a short time.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r18:c5: Sprinting\nHold [i12] while moving to sprint.\nSprinting lets you run faster.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r19:c5: Changing your hairstyle\nExamine a mirror when you find one.\nYou can use it to change your hairstyle.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r20:c5: Emergency dodge\nPress [i4] when a ! appears above your character.\nYou may be able to escape danger.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r21:c5: Keeping your balance\nPress [i4] when you are about to fall.\nYou can stop yourself from falling over.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r22:c5: If something looks dangerous...\nAnything can happen near a giant shadow.\nAvoid getting too close to anything that looks dangerous.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r23:c5: Tied up\nYour options are limited while your hands and feet are tied.\nYou cannot open doors or desks.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r24:c5: Yuki's appearance\nTalk to Yuki when you have a quiet moment together.\nShe may agree to change her clothes or hairstyle.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r25:c5: Yuki's appearance\nTalk to Yuki when you have a quiet moment together.\nShe may agree to change her clothes or hairstyle.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r26:c5: Yuki's appearance\nTalk to Yuki when you have a quiet moment together.\nShe may agree to change her clothes or hairstyle.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r27:c5: The giant black alien's roar\nTake cover behind obstacles to avoid damage.\nMove forward between roars.
common/csv/LoadingTips.csh.r28:c5: Fire!\nIt is dangerous to stay near the fire for long.\nHurry to the stairs.

Spring had arrived, but the rain was cold.
I'd forgotten my umbrella,

Wait... where was I going again?
I stopped and looked around.

common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1478: What is this light...? Is it my power?
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1484: I can feel it! A new power awakening inside me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1486: I can feel it! A new power awakening inside me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1490: Haaaah! It's bursting forth! My power!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1494:
The giant arm stopped moving!
It really is your power!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1498:
You're so dependable!
Nothing like the chief, who's all talk and attitude!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1500:
H-hey! Is that what you think of me?!
L-let's get out while we can!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1503: H-hey! What on earth are you wearing?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1505:
And isn't that my uniform?!
Where did you get it?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1510:
Senior Officer Yanai, that uniform this person is wearing
is mine! It went missing a little while ago!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1512:
Hey! Where did you find that uniform?
Did you steal it?
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1514: "I didn't steal it! I'm borrowing it from the police box!"
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1516: "Sorry! I found it in the police box. I'll give it back!"
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1518:
I didn't steal it! I'm borrowing it from the dresser
in the police box's overnight room!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1520:
I'm sorry! I found it in the overnight room's dresser, and...
I'll give it back right away!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1524:
Senior Officer Yanai, that dresser is yours, isn't it?
What exactly is going on here...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1528: Oh no...! We don't have time for this!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1530: I'm going to help evacuate the residents!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1534:
Oh! Hello there.
Keep up the good work!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1536:
Wait... That's a genuine men's police uniform.
Where did you get it?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1539: Senior Officer Yanai, this woman is wearing a men's police uniform!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1542:
I didn't steal it! I'm borrowing it from the dresser
in the police box's overnight room!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1544:
I'm sorry! I found it in the overnight room's dresser, and...
I'll give it back right away!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1549:
I see... You have the sort of character that can't help
picking up a uniform when you see one...
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1551: Senior Officer Yanai, why do you sound impressed?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1556:
Everyone! Take cover behind the buildings!
Please evacuate!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1558:
You there, looking like you've just left the office! Hurry!
The other side of the street isn't on fire yet!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1560:
You there, looking like a student! Hurry!
The other side of the street isn't on fire yet!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1562:
You there, the energetic one! Hurry!
The other side of the street isn't on fire yet!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1564:
You there, looking like you just go with the flow! Hurry!
The other side of the street isn't on fire yet!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1566:
You there! You'd better hurry, too!
The other side of the street isn't on fire yet!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1569: I won't give up, either. We're going to make it out alive!
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1571:
What was that...?!
I'd better check the news.
common/lua/Text_Stage_201.luc.0:k1573:
What on earth was that...?!
Maybe it's on the news...

common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k36: Head to meet your friend. First, reach the main road.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k38: Head to meet someone special. First, reach the main road.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k40: Head to meet your girlfriend. First, reach the main road.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k42: Get away from the suspicious cash handover!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k44: You can't go downstairs. Try heading farther inside.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k46: Head to the park to meet the woman.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k48: Head to the park to meet your friend.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k50: Head to the park to meet someone special.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k52: Head to the park to meet your girlfriend.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k81: First, I need to get out of this train...
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k83: Make your way through the darkness to the station...
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k85: Cross the platform and find the stairs to the ticket gates...
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k87: Find an exit to the street.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k89: Find clues to the code for the door at the back of the cafe.

common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k102: Take Miho to her father's hospital. It should be east of the intersection with the convenience store.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k108: First Officer Oda at the stern
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k118: Visit the captain in the observation room.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k120: Go to the room with a heater to dry your clothes.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k122: You have some time to spare. Look around the ship.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k124: The shadow on the seabed has vanished. Go get First Officer Oda at the stern.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k136: Be careful not to slide off the train car.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k159: Check on the situation inside the research institute.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k161: Head to the server room on the second floor.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k163: Join the researchers barricaded in the second-floor storage room.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k165: Get the laboratory keycard from Chief Sawada's locker on the first floor.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k167: Head to the first-floor laboratory, where the deputy director is waiting.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k169: Run! Get to the entrance hall!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k191: Head to Mitsuna City, as Otsuka suggested.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k203: You can't escape while tied up. Find a way to free yourself...
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k205: You can hear a rattling sound. Where is it coming from...?
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k207: You've reached the next room. Something here might help you cut the ropes.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k209: You cut the ropes with the scissors. Go help Yuki.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k211: Yuki is free too. Get out of here, quickly!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k213: A dangerous man is chasing you, and the giant weapon outside is coming this way. Escape!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k221: Store where we dried our clothes
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k223: Reunited with the riot police officer
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k225: Head west, where Yuki is apparently being held.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k229: Rescue Yuki from W&P. She seems to be in a building at the intersection to the west.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k231: Head to the escape helicopter on the roof.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k233: Building where Yuki is being held
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k243: The pair we met in the building
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k259: Drive on and look for somewhere to rest.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k263: Head east and find somewhere safe.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k265: Head to the lower level of the bridge.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k267: Head east, toward the other end of the bridge.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k269: Building Risa Kashiwagi is heading to
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k277: Head downstairs to meet up with Risa Kashiwagi.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k284: Man who seems to be waiting for someone
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k305: Explore this floor. Has the person who asked Ms. Kashiwagi here arrived?
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k307: Hurry to the elevator! Mr. Otsuka is holding them off.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k309: The power is out, and you're trapped in the elevator. Is there anything you can do?
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k311: Cross the catwalk to reach the stairs leading down.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k313: You have to escape the building. Follow the others!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k315: Head to the west side of the 19th floor. Special Vehicles Section 2 has come to help.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k317: Find a fire extinguisher. There should be one in the northeast room on the 19th floor.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k326: Otsuka knows someone who can protect you from W&P. Meet them on the Yamabuki Building roof.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k336: Hurry and hide in the warehouse!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k338: Get out of the warehouse without being seen!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k340: Find a way out of the port.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k342: The walkway above looks like a way forward.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k344: Reach Ms. Kashiwagi and you'll be safe. Hurry!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k382: It seems safe here for now, but you should keep heading down.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k384: Find a way to unlock the emergency stairs!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k386: Hurry down the emergency stairs and escape!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k390: You're almost at ground level. Keep going!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k400: Head to the Ebine Publishing Building to see Mr. Otsuka's contact.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k402: Find Mr. Otsuka's contact somewhere in the publishing building.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k404: Speak to the editor-in-chief in the editorial office.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k406: A fire has broken out! Find the stairs down to the first floor!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k408: The publishing building is on fire! Get outside!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k410: Head to the convenience store to meet Mukojima from the editorial staff.
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k412: Leave the convenience store and head south toward Mitsuna City!
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k426: Where the man was taken away
common/lua/map_goal_text.luc.0:k428: You'll be safe at the bus stop! Hurry!

common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k11: A rainy sidewalk just after sunset
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k12: You're meeting a friend at the park. Head there through the rainy night as purple flashes occasionally light up the sky.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k13: You're heading through the rain to meet your friend at the park.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k14: Giant aliens have appeared and the city is in chaos. You're heading to the park where you're supposed to meet.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k15: Giant aliens have thrown the city into chaos. After witnessing what looked like a deal between suspicious men, you're being chased. Even so, you're heading for the park where you're supposed to meet.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k16: Giant aliens have thrown the city into chaos. Suspicious men are chasing you after you witnessed their apparent deal, and you've even slid down from a building's eighth floor. Despite everything, you're heading for the park where you're supposed to meet.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k17: Giant aliens have thrown the city into chaos. You were chased by suspicious men after witnessing their apparent deal, and even slid down from a building's eighth floor. Despite everything, you've reached the park to meet your friend.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k20: You're meeting someone very important to you at the park. Head there through the rainy night as purple flashes occasionally light up the sky.

common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k27: Giant aliens have thrown the city into chaos. You were chased by suspicious men after witnessing their apparent deal, and even slid down from a building's eighth floor. Despite everything, you've reached the park to meet your girlfriend.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k30: You're meeting someone you don't know very well at the park. Head there through the rainy night as purple flashes occasionally light up the sky.

common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k34: Deliver tickets to the radio station
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k36: Iwabuchi, the convenience store clerk, asked you to get tickets from Morimoto if you see him, then bring them to RSG Radio. They're for a live broadcast of Midnight Sky Garden. Deliver them and you'll get one ticket for yourself.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k37: Get the tickets if you meet Morimoto.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k38:
You received the concert tickets from Morimoto.
Deliver them to Iwabuchi at RSG Radio.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k39:
You gave Iwabuchi the tickets.
You got to hear the concert, too, but it was cut short.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k43: An officer stopped you while you were wearing a police uniform found in the police box dresser. A male officer then invited you to join a cosplay club.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k44: You received a Cosplay Membership Card. Apparently, the more you change outfits, the higher your Cosplay Level gets.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k68:
I followed Yuki to the flying monsters' nest. Their cries echo all around.
I have to find Yuki and escape as quickly as possible.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k69: Search for Yuki while hiding from the flying monsters.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k70: I found Yuki. Together, we need to find a way downstairs.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k71: We escaped the flying monsters' nest and reached the first observation level.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k75: The stairs seem to be the only way down from the first observation level, but a locked door blocks them. It looks too sturdy to break. Find the key.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k76: A Gyaos apparently ate the worker carrying the key to the stairs, key and all. Search the area for a way to recover it.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k77: Gyaos seem to spit out things they can't digest. Searching their vomit might turn up the key.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k78: I found the key, but it's covered in foul-smelling muck and can't be used. I need to clean it somewhere.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k79: I washed the key. Hurry back to the stairway door.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k80:
The door is open.
Keep heading down toward ground level.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k84: "Meet me at the Iberis Tower observation deck in thirty minutes." An anonymous message arrived on the smartphone Kashiwagi lent me.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k85: I don't know who's waiting, but I have nowhere else to go. The sender should be somewhere on this observation deck. Try to find them.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k86: The sender was Otsuka. He apparently knows Kashiwagi, but wouldn't explain their relationship.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k90: We finally reached the stairs, but they're exposed to the outside. Proceed carefully to avoid the flying monsters.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k91: Descend the stairs toward ground level.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k92: A flying monster appeared by the stairs and fired a beam. Will the stairs hold?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k93: The stairs were destroyed, separating me from Yuki. Find another way down to ground level.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k94: I broke through a door onto a maintenance walkway. There are no railings, so a fall is possible. Keep going and meet up with Yuki again!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k95:
I've rejoined Yuki, but the stairs down are still broken.
Search farther along the maintenance walkway for a ladder.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k96: Another giant creature appeared and burned the flying monsters' nest. We nearly got caught in it, but now they probably won't be able to pursue us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k100: While we headed for the bus stop, two armed pursuers appeared. If we reach a busy street, they may hesitate to fire.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k101: Avoid the pursuers' gunfire and head for the brightly lit street.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k102: A flying monster suddenly carried one of the pursuers away. We've escaped the threat of his gun, but...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k106: A flock of flying monsters suddenly swooped in and began wrecking the city. Head for the bus stop to get out of town.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k107: Watch the flying monsters and head for the bus stop farther down the boulevard. Pay attention to their shadows on the road.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k108: A flying monster landed, causing a traffic accident that blocked the intersection. Find a building we can pass through to reach the other side.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k109: We escaped into a building, but this place seems dangerous too. Is there a way through to the far side of the intersection?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k110: The bus stop is across the road. Flying monsters on the ground are closing in. Reach the bus as quickly as possible.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k111: We boarded the bus, but a flying monster overturned it. Another carried Yuki away...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k114: While fleeing the flying monsters, I met a badly injured young man in a truck bed. A monster appeared after he argued with his girlfriend, and he lost her. Her name is Kumi.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k115: As the young man climbed out of the truck bed, a flying monster carried him away.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k116: I met Kumi. She deeply regretted arguing with the young man, apparently named Naoki. We parted afterward. I wonder if they've found each other...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k119:
I met Kumi again.
She's injured and can't walk. She asked me to find Naoki for her.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k120:
Naoki was badly hurt the last time I saw him.
Is he still safe...?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k121:
I found Naoki. He's still badly hurt.
Tell Kumi where he is.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k122:
I told Kumi about Naoki.
Carry her to him.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k123:
I witnessed Naoki and Kumi exchange vows.
With trembling hands, he put a ring on her finger.
He seems to be resting now.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k127: Following a riot officer's directions, we drove away from the strange creatures in the underground shopping area.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k128: We've reached Sky Garden Bridge. We should be safe now that we've made it this far.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k130: The Men in the Black Car
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k131: A black car rammed us as we reached Sky Garden Bridge. Sensing danger, we tried to get away.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k132: The black car is deliberately trying to hit us. We have to get away.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k133: Two men in black got out of the car. They're coming this way. We have to run...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k134: A tough-looking man who seems to know our pursuers stepped in and stopped them. We're safe for now.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k137:
While the black car chased us, a giant creature appeared overhead.
We have to get off this exposed bridge quickly.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k138:
Two giant creatures appeared overhead.
Beams from the dark one are destroying cars. Hurry and escape!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k139: Even after we left the car, beams kept striking the bridge. Get as far away as possible.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k140: We entered the restaurant on the north side of the bridge. The first floor should lead to the lower level.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k141: We made it down, but the lower level isn't safe either. Find a way to the other side of the bridge.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k142: A slope now leads to the upper level, but it's too steep to climb on foot. Is there another way up?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k143: I found a motorcycle. We can ride it up the slope and keep going.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k144: We managed to cross before the bridge collapsed.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k147: Among the stranded people on the lower level was a man with an injured back.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k148: He seems to have hurt his back when the collapse startled him. Is there some way to help?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k149: A woman on the lower level gave me a pain-relief patch. It should help with first aid.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k150: The man put the patch on right away. It seems to be working well. I'm glad I could help.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k153: Among the stranded people, I met an engaged couple: game developer Kazuya Ichijo and Sakurako Nakagawa.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k154: They were on their way to meet her father when the disaster struck. They entrusted me with a game to give him if I meet him.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k155: At Iberis Tower, I met Nakagawa, who was waiting for Ichijo and Sakurako. He was speechless when I told him they may have been caught in the bridge collapse.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k158: Some of the stranded people are staying calm. One is even eager to make sales at a time like this.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k159: I was asked to buy fried chicken. Apparently there's a sales quota.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k163: After escaping by motorcycle, we stopped at a light on Shirotsumekusa Street. Kashiwagi asked us to follow her somewhere.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k164: Kashiwagi asked us to follow her. We decided to go along, partly to repay the favor.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k165: The overpass suddenly collapsed. Did another giant creature fire that beam from the sky? Hurry to Kashiwagi and get away.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k166: A beam exploded a tanker truck, sending nearby cars flying. Where is Kashiwagi?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k167: Just when we thought we'd escaped using a car transporter, now we have to pass right beneath the feet of a golden giant creature.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k168: We seem to have reached our destination. Hopefully that means we're off the hook...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k172: Inside a building, we were introduced to a software developer. What will happen next?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k173: Kashiwagi received a package. Somehow, we're going with her to the Cosmic Ray Research Institute.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k174: Outside, a giant creature had destroyed the motorcycle. We decided to head for the station to the north.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k175: Kashiwagi's injury kept her from boarding the train. She entrusted us with the package and asked us to deliver it to the Cosmic Ray Research Institute.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k176: We reached the research institute. Kashiwagi said to give the software to its deputy director, but something is wrong here. With everyone's agendas clashing, I ended up being the one to scout the building.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k177: I don't know which room the deputy director is in, but restarting the server should let us reach people over the internal network. A staff member gave me a note with the server room code, but he...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k178: I started the server and messaged the institute. Someone named Sawada replied, telling me to go to the second-floor storage room. Knock like this to be let in: Tap, ta-ta, tap. (Pause one beat.) Tap, tap, THUMP!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k179: The deputy director is in the lab. Chief Sawada lent me her locker key. Get the lab keycard from her locker in the room behind first-floor reception, then use it to enter the lab.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k180: I delivered Kashiwagi's software to the deputy director. But a mysterious figure appeared, and the deputy director...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k184: Beside the station shop, I met a woman frustrated with her bad luck. Can I help at all?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k185: She lost an earring. She says it was still there when she arrived at work.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k186: She apparently lost her watch too. She had it until she got out of a taxi near the intersection outside the station...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k187: I found the watch too. Hopefully her luck will improve, but what happens next is up to her.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k190: While I was talking to Otsuka, the two pursuers found us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k191: Who knows what will happen if they catch us? Evade them and escape this tower as quickly as possible!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k192: We ducked into an elevator and managed to shake off our pursuers. We lost them, but...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k195: A fire has broken out inside the tower. We have to get out as quickly as possible.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k196: Follow the firefighter's directions and descend the emergency stairs.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k197: A mysterious Labor suddenly appeared, leaving us in an office on the twentieth floor. Get out of the office and find a route to ground level.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k198: A large fire blocks the way. We need to put it out. Is there anything nearby we can use?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k199: With a girl's help, we got a fire extinguisher. Put out the fire and head for Special Vehicles Section 2, which is conducting rescues.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k200: One of the pursuers has caught up with us again. Reach the Ingram as quickly as possible!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k201: The Ingram rescued us, bringing us safely down from the tower.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k205: We reached the harbor by rescue boat, only for the two pursuers to find us again.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k206: We have to leave this harbor quickly. First, find somewhere to hide.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k207: We hid in a warehouse, but the pursuers followed us inside. They're armed, so we can't afford to be seen. Escape the warehouse without being spotted.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k208: Outside the warehouse, we ran into an Ingram. What are they doing here?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k209:
A black Labor appeared on a ship and flew away.
We need to leave this unsettling harbor quickly.
Find a way forward.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k210: The black Labor is fighting another Labor. Kashiwagi has a motorcycle ready on the far side of the battle. Hurry to her.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k211:
The warehouse exploded.
Get out of the harbor as quickly as possible.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k212: We reached Kashiwagi and escaped the harbor by motorcycle.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k216: Our pursuers finally caught us. They work for W&P Consulting, a company that deals in weapons intelligence. Who knows what they'll force us to do if we stay captive? We have to escape.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k217: First, get free of these restraints. Is there something that can cut the rope?
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k218: I've freed myself. Untie Yuki and escape before the two W&P men find us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k219: Has the battle outside ended? The giant creature is gone, and the huge machine stands still among the buildings. Escape while we can.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k220: The giant machine has gone berserk! It's coming this way! If we don't run, it'll crush us along with the building!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k221: We shook off the pursuers and escaped W&P's office.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k224: In the office where they brought us, our pursuers explained why they had been chasing us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k225: Apparently, they want to use my power to summon anomalies as a weapon.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k226: I found a W&P Consulting company pamphlet. Search the room for more information about their organization.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k230: After meeting Yuki at the park, we boarded a subway to get away. But the train stopped and won't move. We'll have to walk to the station and find a way to the surface.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k231: Head through the dark tunnel toward the station.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k232: Strange creatures appeared in the darkness, forcing us to take a detour. Keep heading for the station.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k233: At the ticket gates, we met a woman named Risa Kashiwagi. We're searching together for a way to the surface.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k234: We reached the surface! But the creatures from underground have followed us...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k238: Somehow, I woke up in a small boat at sea with Yuki. A research ship spotted us drifting and took us aboard.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k239: Go to the captain in the observation room to thank him for rescuing us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k240: The captain suggested drying our clothes by the heater. It should be to the left outside the observation room.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k241: Yuki and I dried our clothes by the heater. It'll be a while before we reach port. Perhaps we should explore the ship.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k242: I spoke with the captain. He's retiring after this voyage. He gave me his cap.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k243:
The doctor has lost track of the shadow beneath the sea.
Find the first officer at the stern and tell him to go to the wheelhouse.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k244:
The sea suddenly surged, and a giant monster appeared!
Hurry to the lifeboat!
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k245: The research ship sank. A photo of First Officer Oda and Dr. Fukazawa floated on the sea.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k249: First Officer Oda seems to be sweet on Dr. Fukazawa. I agreed to do him a favor concerning her.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k250: Oda asked me to find out what Dr. Fukazawa thinks of him. She should be near the lifeboat.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k251: Dr. Fukazawa seems to like Oda. I should tell him.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k252: Oda decided to give Dr. Fukazawa a letter, and I'm to deliver it. Incidentally, the letter isn't sealed.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k253:
Dr. Fukazawa gave me a reply to deliver to Oda.
This letter isn't sealed either.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k254: I delivered the reply. They've arranged to meet at the bow tomorrow morning, where Oda plans to tell her how he feels.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k258: Otsuka, the web writer, told us someone could help with W&P. Head for the roof of the Yamabuki Building in Mitsuna City to meet this tough-looking man.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k259: Head toward Mitsuna City, apparently to the southwest. Kashiwagi says it's too far to reach in twenty or thirty minutes.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k260: A giant shadow appeared during the radio concert. Kashiwagi called: she wants to meet us, but she's trapped. Go south of the radio station to help her.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k261: I've safely rejoined Risa. Resume heading for the Yamabuki Building in Mitsuna City.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k262: We've reached Mitsuna City. Now head for the Yamabuki Building.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k263: We reached Mitsuna, only to be chased by a black car. Get to the Yamabuki Building. The tough-looking man there should help us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k264: We met the man, but W&P took Yuki away. After the fierce wind died down, I could only stare at the sky from the rooftop, unable to get up.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k268: W&P took Yuki away. I wandered the city, not knowing what to do, until Risa found me. She knows where Yuki is. Go with Risa to rescue her.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k269: Share Risa's umbrella in the heavy rain and head for Yuki.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k270:
We dried our clothes in an empty convenience store.
I heard about Risa's late brother, Otsuka's past as a war correspondent, and more.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k271: We ran into the riot officer from our earlier escape by car. A giant plant-like growth is about to burst, so we must leave the area immediately. Make a run for it in a vehicle.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k272: We've reached the area where Yuki is held. Her building should be west along the main road.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k273: We passed the park where I was supposed to meet Yuki.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k274: We rescued Yuki from W&P. Otsuka was shot, so we headed for the rooftop helicopter. But W&P caught up with us there. Leading them was Risa... or rather, their president, Reiko Kamio.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k277: In the burning building, we found a girl struggling to breathe through the smoke. After talking with Yuki, we decided to take her with us.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k278: The girl's name is Miho. She seems to mistake Yuki for her sister. Carry Miho and escape the building.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k279: We've reached the area where Miho's father is hospitalized. Carry her to the hospital.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k280: We stopped at Miho's favorite curry shop. Apparently her sister was a big eater, so we ended up stuffed. Continue to the hospital.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k281: While I carried Miho, a nearby tanker caught fire and trapped Yuki in the flames. Miho begged us to save Yuki. We made it out of danger. Continue to the hospital.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k282: We brought Miho to her father. Her sister died in a traffic accident a week ago, but Miho refuses to believe it despite his explanations. He also said Yuki looks like her sister.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k284: Overtime in the Face of Danger
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k285: People were still working at the back of the office where Kashiwagi received the package.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k286: They seem to have been saddled with far too much responsibility. Perhaps there's something I can do to help.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k287: They're stuck because they don't know a password. The previous person in charge often sat beside the multifunction printer...
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k288:
The text I gave them was the correct password.
Looks like I helped a little.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k292: Otsuka asked us to help an editor-in-chief he knows. She's hurt her leg and can't escape. Head for Editorial Department 2 at Ebine Publishing.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k293:
This seems to be Hananira.
Find the Ebine Publishing building.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k294:
We encountered three giant aliens on the main road.
Make it through their battle to Ebine Publishing.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k295: We've entered the Ebine Publishing building. Find the chief.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k296: We found the chief. Gather her things and escape the building.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k299: We're going to meet Mukojima, one of Editor-in-Chief Hirai's staff. He's in a convenience store west of the Ebine Publishing building.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k300: Leave Ebine Publishing and head west.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k301: The ground collapsed during the giants' battle, and we fled into the sewer. Find an exit to the surface.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k302: We're out of the sewer. The convenience store where we're meeting Mukojima is right nearby.
common/lua/mission_text.luc.0:k303:
We found a frightened Mukojima in the store.
Otsuka emailed: W&P is still active.
Part ways with Hirai and the others and head for Mitsuna City.

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k77: What on earth are those things?

Let's go.

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k90: Anyway, let's get out of here.

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k282: And look at the underground mall.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k286: ...Never mind. You have a lovely face.

I'm Kashiwagi. Risa Kashiwagi.
I write columns and articles for an online news site.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k293: We introduced ourselves and told her what we'd seen.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k295: We introduced ourselves and told her what we'd seen.

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k304: Say you don't want to, and don't have your phone anyway.

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k500:
I doubt you can reach the radio station, either,
but handing these over would be a weight off my mind.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k502:
I don't want Iwabuchi tearing into me later.
I'll leave them with you.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k504:
I'm counting on you.
Take those tickets to RSG Radio.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k506: Take good care of those tickets.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k509: Sounds like things are bad above ground, too.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k511: What on earth is going on...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k514:
This squishy stuff is tough.
I threw myself at it, but it didn't budge!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k519:
If we could just get into the underground mall,
there'd be plenty to eat.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k522:
I was supposed to meet my boyfriend!
What is this squishy stuff, anyway?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k525:
Looks like you could get through that hole!
Why not try the underground mall?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k530: Readily agree: "I'll help you right away!"
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k532: Negotiate: "I'll help if you give me something."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k538:
Something in return? ...All right.
I'll give you something you won't want to be
without in an emergency.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k545:
Here, to thank you.
You saved me...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k547:
This sort of thing happens to me wherever I go.
But this is quite a disaster...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k555:
(A distraught woman rummages obsessively through the jewels.
Her name tag reads "Takebe.")
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k557: Creeped out, leave without a word.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k559: Not wanting to get involved, leave silently.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k563: Gently warn her it's dangerous here, then leave.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k569:
Ugh... I'm not sharing any with you.
It's all mine...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k575: Still creeped out, leave without a word.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k577: Still unwilling to get involved, leave silently.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k581: Kindly say, "Your life is precious!" and leave.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k585:
Will you treasure this green jewel
and think of me?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k589: Sincerely say, "I'll treasure it and think of you."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k591: Insincerely say, "I'll treasure it and think of you."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k593: Treasure that jewel and think of me...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k595: Treasure that jewel and think of me... Hehe.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k598:
Hiroko, where are you?!
If you can hear Mommy, answer me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k600:
Hiroko! Hiroko! It's all right now!
You don't have to look for the hamburgers anymore!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k602:
Hiroko! Hiroko! Where did you go?!
If you can hear Mommy, answer me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k606:
Today is the anniversary of my husband's death.
We came for GZ Burgers together,
since they were her father's favorite...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k608:
But we got separated, and I can't find her!
There are strange creatures in the underground mall...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k610:
If you see my daughter, please tell me.
Please. I'm begging you!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k613:
It's you again!
Did you find my daughter?! Did you find Hiroko?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k615: Tell the truth: "Yes. She's inside the burger shop."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k619: Tell another lie: "Yes. She was at the ticket gates."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k622:
Today is the anniversary of her father's death.
We came for GZ Burgers, his favorite...
And then we got caught up in all this...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k629:
Mommy said we could have hamburgers
if we went inside, but I can't find any.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k634: Your mother was looking for you.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k636: I'll help you look for hamburgers.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k641:
If I bring home Daddy's favorite GZ Burger,
he'll come back, won't he? He'll be happy, right?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k643: Gently say, "Yes. I'm sure he'll come back."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k645: Tell the truth: "No. Your daddy isn't coming back."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k647: Say, "Just forget about hamburgers and your daddy."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k649: Tell her, "Your mommy is looking for you outside."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k651: Unable to answer, leave without a word.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k653: That's right! Daddy will come back!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k655:
That's not true! Daddy will come back for hamburgers.
He'll come back to see me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k657: No! I love hamburgers, and I love Daddy!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k659:
Huh? Mommy's here? She came here?
That's funny... Grandma said
Mommy was in heaven.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k661:
Where are the hamburgers...?
If I find them, I can see Daddy...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k663:
I can't wait to eat GZ Burgers
with Daddy and Mommy...
I have to find the hamburgers...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k666:
Why is there still no signal?! So annoying!
I just want to go home!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k680: I'm asking what you're going to do about this!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k682:
Once you get us to our destination,
we're not your responsibility anymore?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k684:
You're useless!
Get me the stationmaster!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k688:
You're all useless!
Get me the stationmaster!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k691:
Please, do something!
I'm begging you!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k694:
As I've said, rescue teams are already on their way.
They should be at the underground mall entrance!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k696:
For now, please stay where you are
and wait for help...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k698:
Oh...
Where's the stationmaster at a time like this...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k700: This passenger won't stop yelling at me...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k709: If you're station staff, do something about this!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k711:
What's all that noise outside?
Are a bunch of passengers storming over here...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k713:
...It seems to be alive.
It's soft and pulsing.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k715:
Could it be connected to those bug-like monsters
that attacked us earlier...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k718:
I-I'm saved...?
I thought that squishy stuff had trapped me here...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k720: Ask, "Is there a note with the door code?"
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k722: Reassure him: "I'm glad you're all right."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k724:
A door code?
Hmm... I'm afraid I don't know...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k726:
If it's important,
it's probably somewhere near the counter...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k728:
Yes... We'd better
get out of here as soon as we can...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k731:
I saw it! A huge bug-like thing!
Help me! I want to get above ground!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k733: Advise her: "Wait in the cafe over there!"
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k735: Brush her off: "I've got enough to worry about."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k747:
D-don't open it!
Those things will find us!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k756:
A stranger suddenly handed me
a locker key earlier...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k758:
It seems to be for this locker,
but I think I can hear something inside...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k760:
It's creeping me out.
Could you take this key off my hands?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k764: Refuse: "No, it creeps me out, too."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k766:
Sorry, and thank you.
I'll leave it with you, then.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k770:
I see...
Sorry to bother you.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k775: Try opening it with the key you were given.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k779:
Found a large yellow ampoule.
It feels surprisingly heavy in your hand.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k789:
Excuse me! I got separated from my friend.
...Have you seen her anywhere?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k791:
She's about my age,
wearing a gray turtleneck.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k795: Lie: "I saw her by the ticket gates."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k799:
We promised to meet here if we got separated,
so she'll definitely come if I wait...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k801:
If you see her, could you tell her
Misaki is waiting here?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k810:
Thank you!
Oh, her name is Nanami.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k814:
If you see Nanami,
please tell her I'm waiting here!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k818:
If you see Nanami,
please tell her I'm here waiting!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k820: Tell her you saw Nanami in the cafe.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k825:
Nanami!
What happened to your leg?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k828: One of those bug-like things got me...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k830:
Oh...
But thank goodness! You're alive!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k836:
Thank you so, so much!
We'll find a way out, too!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k845:
Huh? Yes, I am...
...Misaki? Oh... She's waiting for me...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k847:
One of those bug-like things attacked me...
It hurt my leg. I can't move.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k849: So I thought I'd wait here until help comes.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k851: Carry her on your back to Misaki.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k853: Encourage her: "I see. Well, good luck with that."
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k871:
Take your time.
It's not as if you can get out of here.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k873: Ask, "What's the code for that door?"
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k877:
Oh, that door?
Yes, you just need to enter the code...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k879:
Now... What was it?
Sorry. I left that sort of thing to the young folks.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k885:
Hmm... Let me think.
Oh, perhaps...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k887:
The jewelry store owner...
I'm sure he put a note somewhere.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k889: ...The jewelry store is across the walkway.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k891: ...Sorry I couldn't be of more help.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k893:
...I don't know if it will help,
but I've just remembered something.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k905:
There should be a note with the code
somewhere in the jewelry store opposite.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k907:
Oh, you found the note?
Let's see...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k909:
...Ah, I see.
Yes, this is probably the right note...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k911:
It seems to be a riddle.
You might need to know your gemstones to solve it.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k913:
Oh, you got it open?
Well done.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k915:
Now hurry and escape.
I'll stay here.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k920:
Odd place for a door with a keypad, isn't it?
We don't normally use that door.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k922:
There's a jewelry store on the other side of the burger shop.
The owner put that combination lock in on a whim.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k924: Ask about the code for the door at the back.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k927:
The code for the back door?
Only the jewelry store owner knows it.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k929:
He mentioned something about birthstones...
Said there was a note in his store
that would help you open the lock...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k931:
There's a note in the jewelry store beyond the burger shop.
Check it for the back door's code.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k933:
You brought the note from the jewelry store?
He said something about birthstones...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k935:
I think we've got a birthstone calendar here too,
one the jewelry store gave us...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k937:
He said you could work out the code
by studying the note and the birthstone calendar...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k940:
That jeweler sure went to elaborate lengths.
He and I go way back.
He's always loved playing tricks.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k943: It seems to be locked with a code.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k947: There's a door with a keypad inside the shop...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k949: I can't open it without knowing the code.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k951:
The note from the jewelry store
doesn't seem to have any numbers on it.
...This alone won't open the door.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k954:
The note says: peridot, jade, emerald, ruby.
And the birthstone poster says...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k956:
Jan: Garnet / Feb: Amethyst / Mar: Aquamarine
Apr: Diamond / May: Emerald, Jade / Jun: Pearl
Jul: Ruby / Aug: Peridot / Sep: Sapphire
Oct: Opal, Tourmaline / Nov: Topaz / Dec: Turquoise
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k962:
Found a note.
Pick it up?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k968: Obtained the Note from the Jewelry Store.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k970: A poster listing each month's birthstones.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k976: I was born in January, so...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k978: I was born in February, so...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k980: I was born in March, so...

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1054:
The way ahead is blocked...
Can I somehow distract those things?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1058: Imitate a monster and pretend to be one of them.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1060: Throw an empty can lying on the ground.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1067: Looks like we'll have to crawl under that squishy thing.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1069:
Hey, you.
Go ahead on your own and check things out.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1077:
Oh, look! Over there!
A flashlight!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1079:
Equipped the Flashlight!
(Press [i18] and open ITEM
to remove equipped items.)
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1141: Hey, that hole looks big enough to get through!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1262:
I'm not sure why, but the power seems to be out.
We've lost contact with the control room, too...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1265:
Some people look badly hurt...
Why did we stop so suddenly?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1269:
I saw something moving on the tracks.
Just for a moment...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1271:
Something moving...?
A person? An animal? Down here?
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1273:
Anyway, people are hurt.
Let's go to the next station and get help.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1275: It's dark underfoot, so please don't run.
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1282: The platform is dangerous! Don't go!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1284: It's dangerous that way! Don't go!
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1286:
This is the men's room.
I really shouldn't go in...
common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1288:
This is the women's room.
I shouldn't go in...

common/lua/Text_Stage_202.luc.0:k1064: (The hero tries to imitate a Legion's posture to get by; being attacked is still being implemented)

common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k4:
Urged on by the riot police officer,
we drove off, still unable to make sense of it all.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k10: A giant alien had appeared from nowhere and ravaged the city.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k12: Underground, creatures we'd never seen were attacking people.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k14: And what was that enormous plant-like creature...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k17:
We have an update on the giant plant-like life-form
that appeared atop Acacia Department Store's main branch.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k19:
The creature itself has shown little movement so far,
but large numbers of creatures about three meters long
have reportedly appeared around the building.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k21: Riot police are on the scene, helping residents evacuate.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k23:
Next, the purple flashes seen around the world
throughout the past few days. The Meteorological Agency...
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k25: What on earth was happening to this city...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k27:
Before I knew it,
our car was approaching the waterfront.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k30:
Urged on by the riot police officer,
we drove off, still unable to make sense of it all.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k34: And what was that enormous plant-like creature...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k36:
What was that giant shadow...?
What would become of this city...?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k38:
Before I knew it,
our car was approaching the waterfront.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k42:
You scared me!
Did you fall from the road above?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k45:
I saw it just now!
A monster like a gigantic moth!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k48:
Did you hear? Earlier, near the station...
They say a huge insect-like monster appeared...
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k50: Could it have something to do with that...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k53:
Something like lightning came out of nowhere!
We need to get out of here, fast!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k56:
What on earth is that?!
Somebody, tell me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k62:
I just want to go home...
I'm so tired...
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k65:
...This bridge might not hold much longer.
It's been falling apart all over the place.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k68:
We can't go this way! It's on fire!
We have to escape the other way!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k71:
Damn it!
How do we get any farther...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k74:
...Is every route blocked?
Come on! What do we do?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k76:
Th-that was close...
This bridge is in really bad shape!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k78:
...Could we somehow climb up from here?
Looks a little too steep to climb on foot... Hmm.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k81:
Would it be wrong to just take
one of these cars or motorcycles?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k87: The trains won't be running anytime soon...
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k89:
The road above suddenly came crashing down...
And what is that huge thing flying overhead?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k93: How are we supposed to escape...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k95: Let me know if you see anyone who's hurt.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k97:
I'm a [#ff44ff44]nurse[/#], believe it or not.
I should be able to help a little.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k102: (I told her about the [#ff44ff44]man with an injured back[/#].)
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k106: I'm glad I happened to have it with me.
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k111: I told you we shouldn't go today!
common/lua/Text_Stage_203.luc.0:k113:
I've had enough!
I'm never going anywhere with you again!

common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k11:
The series of strange events in April 20XX, later known as
the "Purple Nightmare," unfolded over just a few days.
common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k15:
Research institutes around the world spent months investigating
the phenomena and their causes, but found no answers.
common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k19:
The appearance of giant aliens and monsters devastated
an area within a 120 km radius of Miyato City.
common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k21:
Web writer Hideyasu Otsuka published an account of his experiences
during the strange events. It became a bestseller.
common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k24:
W&P leader Reiko Kamio was arrested. Attention now turns
to the organization's involvement in the strange events.
common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k26:
W&P leader Reiko Kamio died during the strange events.
Her motives for becoming involved remain unknown.
common/lua/Text_EpilogueText.luc.0:k28:
The protagonist of this story, <P_FNAME> <P_LNAME>, is said to have

And if I confess and she turns me down, it'll be awkward
until we reach port. That's why I haven't been able to tell her.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1441:
Actually, if you don't mind,
could you casually ask Dr. Fukazawa what she thinks of me?
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1443:
If she doesn't think badly of me, I'd like to tell her how I feel.
I'm sorry to ask something so strange, but please!
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1445: Oh, hello. You haven't caught a cold, have you?
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1450:
The shadow on the seabed still seems motionless. The ship's running
low on fuel, so we may be running out of time to investigate.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1452:
Ah, I wish we had a more flexible captain. Still, we've collected
the data we originally came for, so I should be grateful.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1454:
Once I get back to the university, I need to write my paper
and start preparing the next survey... Oh, and...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1456:
Oh, I'm sorry.
All I ever talk about is work.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1458: You love your work, don't you?
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1460: You love marine life, don't you?
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1462: You just love research, don't you?
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1466:
Hmm... I do love it,
but that's not the only reason.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1470:
Yes, I love it,
but that's not the only reason.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1474:
I do love observing things.
But there's more to it than that...
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1476:
In my case, there's some stubborn pride involved.
I want recognition. I want to prove people wrong.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1478:
I became a professor at a university overseas in my twenties. I came back
at thirty and continued my research at a university here.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1480:
But the other professors are all experienced people in their forties
and fifties, and they treat me like a child.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1482:
So I want my achievements to prove them wrong. Research is my whole life now.
Come to think of it, I haven't seen my friends in ages.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1484:
I was married when I was a researcher overseas,
but I was always busy, and he put his business first.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1486: We drifted further apart, and soon split up.
common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1488:
Maybe that's why I became even more absorbed in work.
Well, I don't regret it.

common/lua/Text_Stage_206.luc.0:k1586:

No, but...

common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k225: What?! We're climbing up there at a time like this...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k232:
Ms. Kashiwagi! Ow...!
...I'm so glad you came!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k234: With everything that's happening, I thought you might not make it.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k236:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Now, these two are...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k238:
Nice to meet you. I'm Asano.
I work out of a corner of this company my friend runs.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k242:
Oh, stop it, Ms. Kashiwagi!
I was just tricked into being made the head of it.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k244:
In fact, I don't have a single employee. It's just me.
The company develops software...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k246:
There's something I have to deliver by tomorrow morning.
But I hurt my leg and can't take it there...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k248: We're going to deliver it for him.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k254: Yes, me and the two of you.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k258:
Leave it to us.
We take it to the Cosmic Ray Research Institute, right?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k260:
That's right. Give it to a man named Sasaki, the deputy director.
He'll know what it is.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k262: Understood. We'll get it there, so don't worry.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k264: Now, you should get out of here quickly, too!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k266:
But I still have one more job due in the morning.
I'll evacuate as soon as I've finished it!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k268: Looks like we can't use the motorcycles anymore...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k270: The station's right there. Let's take the train!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k274: Why do we have to go with you?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k276: Try to leave: "We'll be going our own way now."
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k278: Keep confessing: "I'd go anywhere with you!"

common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k293:

I'd be worried going alone.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k295: We'll be going our own way now.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k297: We'll be going our own way now.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k299:
Hey! Don't say that.
Please, I want you to come with me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k306:
This is no time to talk.
Let's hurry to the station!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k315: Please, deliver that package for me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k318: Please take care of the delivery.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k320: Please look after Ms. Kashiwagi, too.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k322:
It seems quite dangerous here, too.
I need to finish my work quickly...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k324:
Come to think of it, what was that about earlier?
Oh, well...
I have to hurry...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k326:
What is it?
Sorry, I'm busy, so I'll have to keep working while we talk.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k328: I'd like to buy your company for 100 million yen.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k334:
Oh... Sorry... I'm just so busy...
I'm not sure what you mean, but sure.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k336: I can't stop right now, so help yourself.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k338: (Took the ownership documents from Asano's desk.)
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k340: (Put the payment of 100 million yen in the desk.)
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k342:
I see.
Then, if you'll excuse me, I'll get back to work.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k344: ...Oh, may I ask you something a little unusual?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k346:
This company I run is called Hyacinth Soft.
What direction do you think
I should take it in from here...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k348: I think you should steadily build up a record of smaller jobs.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k350: I think you should develop and sell your own products.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k352:
You're right... I'm the only one doing the work,
so I suppose that's all I can do...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k354:
Our own products...
Come to think of it, I used to dream of that...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k356:
Thank you. That was helpful.
Now, please take the program
to the Cosmic Ray Research Institute.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k359: Ah... My legs have frozen. I can't move...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k361:
I want to move, but maybe I'm too scared,
or maybe I just can't look away...
Either way, I can't move...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k369:
Hmm, can't I get a better angle?
I need some results if I'm going to get ahead...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k371: I'd like a clearer shot of its face.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k374:
Oh...
The building our company's in is a total wreck.
We won't go bankrupt, will we?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k376: Where am I supposed to report for work tomorrow...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k379:
I finally got a job...
And now there's nowhere to go to work...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k381:
I've only just changed my registered address.
If I lose my job, I'll have to do all the paperwork again and move back home...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k389:
No use panicking now.
I'll play an offline game and leave the rest to luck.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k391: Might as well level up while I can.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k394:
Hey, is it really okay not to go back to the office?
The team leader and section chief are still there...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k397:
Ms. Sasazaki from the secretarial department was still there, too...
What should we do...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k400:
Judging by the news about those strange creatures,
isn't every train line dangerous?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k403:
That line... Maybe not.
Damned if we go, damned if we stay...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k406:
Huh? The screen's gone blank.
I can't buy a ticket...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k409:
Just shut the shutters already!
It's dangerous!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k412:
As I was saying, people still need to use the station,
and we have to help them evacuate by running trains free of charge...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k415:
What's happening outside...?
I've been told not to close the shop...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k422:
Sh-should I tell her how I feel while I have the chance...?
Would "I love you! Run away with me!" work?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k424:
I-I have to tell her...!
B-but what if she turns me down...?
No, but... Hmm...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k427:
No...
But... Tanaka still isn't here...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k430:
Tanaka's a grown adult. It'll be fine!
Do you want to die waiting here?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k433:
The train's here. Should I get on...?
But I don't think I can hold it...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k435:
Right, I'll get on the train!
...But maybe the cleaning will be finished in two more minutes...
What should I do...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k438:
Honestly...!
How unlucky can I get...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k440:
Losing one of my precious [#ff44ff44]earrings[/#]...
And he's still not here...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k442: Try giving her the earring you found
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k444: Say nothing and leave her alone
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k446:
Oh! My [#ff44ff44]earring[/#]!
Where did you find it?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k448: (I told her it was on the office floor.)
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k450: I see... On the office floor...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k452:
Anyway, thank you.
It's very important to me. I was wondering
whether to go back outside and look for it.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k454:
Oh! Wait...
My [#ff44ff44]watch[/#] is gone, too!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k456:
I was wearing my [#ff44ff44]watch[/#] when I left the office
and got into the [#ff44ff44]taxi[/#]...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k458:
All this chaos started right after that, so I got out of the [#ff44ff44]taxi[/#]
at the intersection just outside.
Did I drop it on the way here...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k460:
Oh...
How unlucky can I get...?
It's all his fault for being late.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k469:
It's not much,
but please take this.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k471:
Honestly...!
How long is he going to keep me waiting?!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k473:
I can't relax until you're here...
Honestly...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k476:
W-w-what do I do...?
I-I'm going to wet myself...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k478:
I-I have to finish up and get back quickly...
I-I'll get yelled at again...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k481: This must be a dream. Just a dream...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k483:
If I keep my eyes closed,
I'll wake up on a train to a pleasant workplace,
with no giant creatures outside and no worthless boss.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k489:
...She's ignoring me...
It doesn't look like she'll talk to me anymore...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k491:
Why is this happening to me...?
It's all the president's fault...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k493:
Always making us work overtime,
without paying a yen for it...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k497:
The section chief's no better...
Always agreeing with the president and sucking up to him...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k499:
He takes on work without thinking and dumps it all on us.
How does that earn him
more than twice our pay...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k503:
I work until late every night, plus weekends and holidays.
How is my take-home pay only 130,000 yen...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k505:
They say I'm not keeping up,
but the workload is obviously far too much.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k507:
People in the same field tell me
I'm doing about three people's work...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k511:
And the president keeps putting his hands all over me...
Doesn't he realize how disgusting it is?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k513:
He emails and calls me, too...
And if I turn him down, he openly cuts my next paycheck.
He's the worst...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k517:
I want to quit, but...
If a new graduate quits in their first year,
finding another job won't be easy...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k519:
But I can't take it anymore...
It's all that scumbag president's fault...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k521: I told you to go away!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k530:
Leave me alone.
I don't care about anything anymore...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k532:
Our useless president messed with the project files
without knowing what he was doing
and deleted everything.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k534:
It's due tomorrow at noon...
We can't restore the backup
because we don't know the [#ff44ff44]password[/#]...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k536:
He's blaming it all on us.
If we miss the deadline, we're fired...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k538:
And if there's a claim for damages,
he says he'll make us pay that, too...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k540:
He says it's in our contracts...
Even though no one ever told us about that...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k542:
This is a really big client.
It could run into hundreds of millions of yen...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k544:
All the project files are gone.
There are less than twelve hours left.
And we don't know the backup [#ff44ff44]password[/#]...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k546: You'd have to be crazy not to despair...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k548:
Maybe being attacked by those giant creatures outside is better
than being saddled with hundreds of millions in debt,
unable to get a decent job, and dying in the gutter...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k550:
Sigh...
Now I've got this faint glimmer of hope to cling to.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k552: I just want it all to be over...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k557: Tell him the text written near the base of the printer
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k563: I told him the string of characters that might be the [#ff44ff44]password[/#].
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k565:
Oh! I can access the backup!
Thank you! You saved us!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k567: Here, take this if you'd like.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k569:
Every second counts, so forgive me for working while we talk,
but I'm truly grateful!
We might just make the deadline now!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k571:
Huh? Oh, we need a [#ff44ff44]password[/#]
to restore the backup files.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k573:
The previous person in charge managed the [#ff44ff44]password[/#],
but they quit the other day.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k575:
We can't reach them and don't know what it is,
so we're trying everything we can think of.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k577:
They were a bit odd, often sitting [#ff44ff44]beside that printer[/#]
and muttering to themselves.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k579:
We don't have that luxury.
Sorry, but I can't stop working.
If you want to talk, could you ask that woman over there?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k584:
I'm busy right now.
Don't talk to me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k586: I told you not to talk to me!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k589:
Did I buy a little too much...?
It's hard to move...
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k592:
Oh...
I went to so many shops before I finally found it...
How can I face my sick daughter when I get home...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k597: Apparently there's a secret guide to making game development go smoothly, meow.
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k599:
But I can't find it anywhere.
At this rate, the game will never be finished, meow!
common/lua/Text_Stage_208.luc.0:k601:

Leave me alone.

The package Risa gave us...

common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k211:

That photo I just posted is getting a huge response...

Those giant creatures have injured so many people...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k223:

I have to do something...!

I need funds right away!
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k229:

common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k232: Buy Miyato Cinema for 500 million yen.
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k238:
Oh! Thank you!
This will save so many people!
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k243: You obtained the deed to Miyato Cinema.
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k245:
Haggle...? Well, you have your own circumstances.

common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k249:
Her articles always impress me.
I'm a huge fan!
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k251:
Give me those photos of Risa Kashiwagi,
and I'll sell you Miyato Cinema for 499,900,000 yen! How about it?
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k253:
...No, it has to be 500 million.

common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k255:
Oh...? Forgive me,
but it seems you don't have that much money...
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k257: I'm sorry. Please forget I asked.

common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k263: Thank you! This will save so many people!

...Say, may I ask you something?
Miyato Cinema is the oldest movie theater in Miyato City.
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k272: What do you plan to do with Miyato Cinema?
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k274: Make it a cinema that lifts the spirits of everyone in Miyato.
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k276: Sell it for a profit when the city is redeveloped.
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k278:

I'll be glad I sold it to you.
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k280:
I suppose so. With the city in this state,
there won't be many customers...
common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k282: I'll leave it in your hands. Take care of Miyato Cinema.

Get on the bus!

common/lua/Text_Stage_210.luc.0:k327:

I'm sure your mom's safe...!

Too damn big for fried chicken...!

What about you, helping deliver that program?
What are you up to?

I'm not up to anything. I thought the research there
