common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k670:
I helped deliver the program because I figured
the research would stall without it.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k672: And you? You caught the scent of money again, didn't you?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k674:
I've been visiting that institute lately. I was there
to ask about the flashes in the sky these past few days.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k678: You two seem to really dislike each other.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k684:
Don't joke about that. Being lumped in with someone
who'll do anything for money is deeply insulting.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k690: That's right. I can't stand people who'll do anything for money.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k694:
More importantly, you remember
how I saved you at Iberis Tower, right?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k696:
Instead of payment,
I took this as collateral...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k698: Isn't it about time you redeemed it?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k700:
I saved your skin, didn't I?
Time to pay up... Can you cough up 100,000 yen?

Of course, of course. But do you know
who those people chasing you are?

With dangerous people like that after you,
you must worry about keeping her safe. So...

I see. You want to get to know her better? But do you know
who those people chasing you are?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k788:
With dangerous people like that after you,
you're putting her future at risk too. So...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k790:
Go see this man.
He'll be able to sort things out.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k792: Huh? Haven't I seen that face somewhere...?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k796: He looks more dangerous than the people chasing me...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k800: You know him? That makes things easier.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k804: Right? That's why you can count on him.

common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k810:
He's on the roof of the Yamabuki Building in Mitsuna City.
All right, I'm off to work.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k812:
Oh, Mitsuna's a long way from here.
Be ready for that!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k816: He told us to go to the roof of the Yamabuki Building in Mitsuna City.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k819:
Mitsuna is the next city over. You won't get there
in twenty or thirty minutes. I think it's that way...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k827:
For Mitsuna, turn left at that corner and keep going.
It's still a long way, though, so be careful.

Iwabuchi, the clerk from the convenience store!

common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k860: You handed over the Late-Night Radio Audience Tickets.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k864:
I can't believe you actually found Morimoto!
How was he doing?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k867:
Thank you for waiting! If you're here for the live broadcast
of Midnight Skygarden, please come inside!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k873:
What do we do? There are only two tickets.
One of you can't get in...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k875:
Wait a moment.
I'll ask the staff!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k878:
Some people couldn't make it, so they have spare seats.
They said it's fine! Let's go!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k880: I see. You didn't find Morimoto...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k883: Oh... What do I do? I came all this way...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k885: I'll go talk to the staff!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k892:
...Thank you all for coming. Tonight we're broadcasting live
with some of our listeners here in the audience.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k894:
You've probably seen the news.
Giants and monsters are rampaging across the city,
causing terrible damage.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k896:
Whether you're here in the audience or listening on the radio,
I'm sure you're all very worried.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k898:
We discussed it with the staff. Some thought
we should cancel under these circumstances...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k900:
...But I thought that by broadcasting as usual,
we could remind everyone that there's still
something normal left in this city.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k902:
So we decided that, especially at a time like this,
we should keep our regular broadcast going.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k915:
Thank you for coming. I managed to free myself.
But more importantly...
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k917:
It looks like Otsuka was right after all.
And you made it through all that danger...!
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k920:
...Let's get away from here for now.
You're heading to Mitsuna City, right?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k924:
That's something I admire about you.
...Come on. Let's go.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k933:
You're safe. Thank goodness...
Where are you now?
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k935: We're in front of the radio station.
common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k938:
Then you're close. Please, can you come here?
A building collapsed, and my leg's trapped. I can't move...

common/lua/Text_Stage_212.luc.0:k942:

common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k474:
MIYATO CITY
The capital of Miyato Prefecture and a designated city.
It consists of 13 wards, with a population of 2.13 million.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k476:
Heavy industry flourishes along Miyato Bay on the Pacific coast.
Commerce thrives on the plains centered on downtown Sakura Ward.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k478:
Two railways serve the city: Miyato Electric Railway and Metro Rail.
An extensive network of wide roads also makes driving convenient.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k480: Miyato-style okonomiyaki is a famous local specialty.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k482:
PURPLE FLASHES
In recent days, purple flashes have frequently been observed
in the sky around the world.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k484:
Lightning, fireballs, and meteors also light up the sky,
but these purple flashes differ from all of them.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k486:
MAIN FEATURES
1. Part of the sky glows purple.
2. Accompanied by a lightning-like phenomenon.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k488:
3. Also observed in clear, cloudless skies.
4. Each flash lasts about seven seconds.
5. No simultaneous occurrences in multiple locations recorded.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k490:
No damage caused by the flashes has been reported so far.
The cosmic ray research institute is reportedly studying them.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k492:
SKYGARDEN BRIDGE
An 11-km bridge across Miyato Bay, open to cars, bicycles, pedestrians,
and the Garden Liner railway.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k494:
Construction took eight years and two months and cost 1.0564 trillion yen.
The builder was Kunshiran Construction, headquartered in Miyato City.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k496:
Midway across: Ristorante Miyato's Bay Area branch (Italian, inbound),
and Udan Lazat (Asian, outbound).
Udan Lazat's nasi goreng is outstanding.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k498:
IBERIS TOWER
A 50-story, 231-meter skyscraper on Miyato City's waterfront.
It has become one of the city's landmarks in recent years.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k500:
B2-15F: Shops. 16-26F: Offices. 27-48F: Hotel.
The top floor is an observation deck. Every twentieth floor
is a "truss floor" for seismic isolation and fire protection.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k502:
Builder Kunshiran Construction is targeted by environmental group NKX.
Its leader, Kiyoharu Futamura, is known for radical tactics.
Reports suggest a major protest is planned soon.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k504:
MIYATO SKY TOWER
A 190-meter broadcast tower in downtown Miyato and a symbol of the city.
It celebrated its fiftieth anniversary last year.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k506:
Iberis Tower was expected to draw away its visitors,
but it remains a popular sightseeing destination.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k508:
W&P CONSULTING
W&P Consulting Co., Ltd., commonly called W&P,
is a weapons information firm based in Miyato's Fortune Center Building.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k510:
Its clients include countries and factions worldwide.
Its reputation and track record are outstanding.
It is said to control the world's arms trade.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k512:
Outwardly legitimate, the company is dogged by dark rumors.
Besides weapons information, it allegedly arranges bribes
and eliminates obstacles for its clients.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k514:
Current president Reiko Kamio is said to have the backing
of W&P investor Company M in America.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k516:
RADIO SKYGARDEN
An AM station in Miyato City. Its flagship show, Aya Suzumura's
Midnight Skygarden, is broadcast live nationwide from Miyato.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k518:
Formerly Miyato Radio Broadcasting, it adopted the name
Radio Skygarden (RSG) for its fortieth anniversary.
common/lua/Text_Stage_214.luc.0:k520:
Aya Suzumura is from neighboring Mitsuna City
and graduated from Miyato Singers School.

common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k98:
Shortly after 6 p.m. today, two giant aliens, each about 40 meters tall, suddenly appeared near Sakuramachi Junction on Route 3 in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, and began fighting. They used beam weapons and hand-to-hand combat.

Sachiko Tomisaka, a ward resident who witnessed the battle at close range, said the two initially looked very similar. One changed appearance after landing on its backside on a pedestrian bridge.

The glowing giant whose appearance remained unchanged was briefly at a disadvantage after being kicked away, but reportedly counterattacked near Nishi-Azami Junction.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k100:
Chief Cabinet Secretary S announced that the being commonly called the "giant of light," which stopped the alien destroying the city, would be named "Ultraman."
Ultraman is approximately 40 meters tall and estimated to weigh 35,000 tons. His flying speed reportedly reaches Mach 5. Some witnesses say he appeared by growing to giant size, but the details remain unclear.

Videos uploaded by witnesses have drawn numerous comments praising his exploits.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k102:
The giant alien that disguised itself as the giant of light and destroyed the city called itself Alien Zarab. It claimed to have come from Planet Zarab to establish friendly relations with Earth.
It is about 40 meters tall, with an estimated weight of 20,000 tons.
Zarab first appeared in Sakura Ward looking almost identical to the giant of light, Ultraman. It repeatedly destroyed buildings and vehicles with glowing projectiles fired from its fingertips, a weapon some experts call "Energy Vulcan."
Ultraman forced it to reveal its true form, identifying Zarab as the attacker.

Questions remain, including why an alien claiming peaceful intentions would attack the city. Watanabe, an office worker who commutes here from Sumire Ward and requested a pseudonym, expressed outrage. "I trusted Zarab, so I'm deeply disappointed. Why impersonate Ultraman and destroy the city? If the aim was to ruin Ultraman's reputation, that's unforgivable."
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k104:
A women's police uniform was stolen from Aokibamachi Police Box in Sakura Ward, Miyato City. Police say the burglary took place while officers were directing evacuations after the giant aliens appeared.
The thief broke the reception-room door and took the uniform from a dresser in the break room. Police are seeking witnesses.

Senior Officer Yanai, who was at the police box, gave a spluttering interview. "I never noticed the door being broken. This must be the work of aliens! Why would aliens steal Officer Kuribayashi's uniform? Absolutely outrageous!"

The stolen uniform was a women's size M. Its owner, Officer Kuribayashi, said she had only started wearing it last week.
She appealed to the thief: "Losing a police uniform creates all sorts of trouble. Please return it. If you do, I'll give you a different outfit from my personal wardrobe in exchange."
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k105:
A men's police uniform was stolen from Aokibamachi Police Box in Sakura Ward, Miyato City. Police say the burglary took place while officers were directing evacuations after the giant aliens appeared.
The thief broke the reception-room door and took the uniform from a dresser in the break room. Police are seeking witnesses.

Officer Kuribayashi, who was at the police box, gave a spluttering interview. "I never noticed the door being broken. This must be the work of aliens! Why would aliens steal Senior Officer Yanai's uniform? I simply don't understand!"

The stolen uniform was a men's size M. Its owner, Senior Officer Yanai, said he had only started wearing it last week.
He appealed to the thief: "Losing a police uniform creates all sorts of trouble. Please return it. If you do, I'll give you a different outfit from my personal wardrobe in exchange."
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k107:
Police announced that passersby found hundreds of high-denomination banknotes blowing around Sakuramachi Junction on Route 3 in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, and handed them in as lost property.

The area was the site of the battle between the giant aliens. The money is believed to have come from buildings damaged in the fighting.

No owner has yet come forward. The failure to claim such a large sum has prompted speculation that the cash may have origins its owner would rather keep hidden.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k109:
Major convenience-store chain Clover announced strong March fried chicken sales, reaching 160% of the previous year's figure.

Its "Chicken Minister" range offers flavors including soy sauce, milk, and strawberry. The dessert varieties have reportedly made it popular with women as well. The company is eager to keep introducing inventive chicken products based on customer feedback.

Fans are already speculating online about the next additions. "Marinated tuna flavor is next!" wrote one. Another predicted, "It has to be a dessert. Tiramisu chicken is the most likely candidate." Strange expectations are running high.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k110: Driver's quick thinking saves all aboard
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k111:
At around 6 p.m. today, a GZ Transit bus narrowly escaped the giant aliens' battle in Sakura Ward. Driver Yoichi Tawarada's quick thinking allowed every passenger to evacuate safely.

Passenger Seiji Fujita of Nishi-Azami said, "We were nearly crushed by a giant foot, but the driver maneuvered the bus brilliantly and got us out. Then he stayed aboard, guiding everyone until we had all escaped. He saved our lives."
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k112: Giant hand tears into Sakura building!
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k113: The Kaido Building in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, was destroyed by a giant alien. According to survivors at the scene, the alien thrust its enormous hand into the building and threw the office into chaos with what seemed like telekinetic powers.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k115:
Takako Kobayashi's roadside flower stall in Sakura Ward was destroyed by crowds fleeing the giant alien attack.
Customers admired the care she gave her flowers, and the stall was always busy with people buying flowers on their way home from work.

Watching the stall she had cherished for over 20 years collapse before her eyes left Ms. Kobayashi so shocked that she crouched on the spot, unable to move.

Yoshio Sasaki, a regular customer who lives in the ward and happened to witness the incident, rubbed his right elbow and shoulder as he spoke. "People kept running into her stall as they fled. It held up the first two times, but the third collision flattened it completely. They hit it so hard, it never stood a chance. It's such a shame."

We hope Ms. Kobayashi recovers from the shock and is able to reopen her flower shop.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k116: Clear umbrellas win over young women
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k117:
Transparent umbrellas are becoming a craze among women in their twenties, particularly in urban areas. Once generally regarded as cheap, they have gained appeal this year as major department stores and clothing brands introduced designer models and finely graded choices of transparency. These innovations appear to have won customers' hearts.

Akiko Watanuki, a local trading-company employee, says, "What I love about transparent umbrellas is their transparency. Watching rain trickle down through the umbrella on a rainy day clears my head and makes me feel refreshed! I own about 20, all with different transparency levels. I choose how transparent to go based on my mood."

The clear-umbrella craze looks set to continue.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k118: Officers grow vegetables on state land
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k119:
A National Police Agency investigation found that Senior Officer Yanai and Officer Kuribayashi, assigned to Aokibamachi Police Box under Miyato Police Station, were growing vegetables for themselves on state-owned land behind the building.
They reportedly cultivated favorites including snow peas and cherry tomatoes, serving them with dinner almost every night. They even used fertilizer, suggesting a serious effort to increase their harvest.

Yanai reportedly told investigators, "I desperately wanted one more dish with dinner. I started casually, thinking a few green onions couldn't hurt. Then it escalated to spinach, snow peas, and other seasonal vegetables. Once I started on cherry tomatoes, I was completely out of control. I sincerely apologize to the public and my fellow officers."

Taking the matter seriously, the agency plans to tighten discipline by explicitly banning vegetable gardens behind police boxes in its work rules. Yanai received a three-month pay cut, and Kuribayashi a one-month cut.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k120: Young people take selfies at giant battle
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k121:
During the recent crisis, many young people were seen taking smartphone selfies in front of the battling giants.
Police are urging people to refrain from taking selfies in such situations.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k122: Escape from a burning, tumbling bus
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k123:
A city bus exploded and overturned after a giant alien attack near Sakuramachi Junction in Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
Witnesses say a young person swiftly dodged the tumbling bus and escaped unharmed.
Some also reported that part of the person's body glowed purple while avoiding it.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k125:
The Kaido Building in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, was destroyed by a giant alien attack.
The alien drove its right arm into the building around the eighth floor, then pulled it out. An observer outside said the impact dislodged a young person still inside. Despite falling from the eighth floor, the person quickly assumed a landing position and reportedly escaped injury.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k126: Road sign falls on burning boulevard
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k127:
A road sign fell near Nishi-Azami Junction on Tsubaki Boulevard in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, reportedly injuring many people. Crowds were fleeing the giant aliens' battle when one alien's shin struck the sign.
A local resident identified as M, who watched from the sidewalk, said that while others were caught beneath it, one young person whose hands glowed purple swiftly escaped the falling sign.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k129:
Desperate evacuation efforts continue on Tsubaki Boulevard in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, which has suffered extensive damage from the giant aliens.
Amid this unprecedented disaster, Officer Naoko Kuribayashi of Aokibamachi Police Box is guiding people to safety, urging them never to give up and to keep fighting to survive.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k131:
The Metropolitan Police Department announced that Yuko Saeki, arrested on suspicion of murdering her brother, has escaped custody.
Saeki fled during an accident while being transported. The giant alien attack has since thrown the city into chaos, hampering the search.
Police warn the public to be cautious, describing Saeki as violent.

Meanwhile, rumors suggest that a photograph of someone resembling Saeki has appeared online. It reportedly shows a person speaking with the handcuffed suspect.
Police are searching for the person shown talking to her.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k132: Trends: Change your hair in the restroom!
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k133:
"The quickest way to change your mood is to change your hairstyle."
So says Associate Professor F, who teaches neuroscience at M University.
The latest trend among young people is restyling their hair in restroom mirrors.

Next time you spot a convenience store, why not check its restroom mirror and try a new look?
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k134: Young person spotted with glowing hands!
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k135:
Reports of a young person whose hands glow purple are pouring in from Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
Kazuaki Ikeuchi, who works in the ward's Kaido Building, spoke with awe of someone who swept into the building.
"Both of their hands glowed purple! Then the alien pulled its hand back!"
His colleague Chika Kinoshita was equally excited. "That person is our savior! As long as they're here, we'll be all right!"
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k136: Giant alien peers into office building
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k137:
A giant alien was seen peering into an office building in Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
It reportedly brought its face up to the eighth floor of the burning Kaido Building, right in front of people sheltering there.
Why the alien looked inside remains unknown.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k138: Alien Zarab comes from the eighth galaxy
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k139:
Alien Zarab reportedly comes from the eighth galaxy. According to Zarab, the giant of light known as Ultraman is also an alien from space.
Zarab initially acted friendly toward humans, but has since been exposed as the alien that impersonated Ultraman and destroyed the city.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k140: Tips: Eat to restore lost HP
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k141:
If your HP (health) is running low, you can be sure you're in danger.
When HP reaches zero, it's game over.
Restore it by eating, drinking, or visiting a save point.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, Kyoei News editorial team)
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k142: Tips: Rest when your ST runs low
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k143:
If your ST (stamina) is running low, you can be sure you're in danger.
When ST reaches zero, you won't be able to dash for a while.
That can leave you unable to sprint when it matters, making danger harder to escape.
ST recovers after a short wait even if it runs out, but the trick is to alternate dashing and running so it never reaches zero.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, Kyoei News editorial team)
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k144: An enormous foot comes crashing down
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k145: Numerous photographs of the giant aliens' feet have been taken near Sakuramachi Junction in Sakura Ward and posted online.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k147: During the incidents around Tsubaki Boulevard in Sakura Ward, witnesses reported seeing two men attack a young person who kept nimbly dodging every blow.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k148: Tips: Save points offer a welcome rest
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k149:
When your health (HP) or stamina (ST) is low, or you decide you've played enough for today, look around for a large blue "S" and examine it.
It marks a mysterious place called a save point.
A save point instantly restores health and stamina, and records your progress so you can resume the next day.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, Kyoei News editorial team)
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k151:
The giant aliens have been seen firing beams and other forms of light from their hands to attack one another.
At times, they have also launched ring-shaped weapons.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k152: Store worker clings to concert hopes
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k153:
Yui Iwabuchi, a part-time worker at Clover's Aokibamachi branch in Sakura Ward, is another person affected by the giant aliens' battle.
A devoted fan of singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura, Iwabuchi planned to attend a late-night, fans-only concert at a radio station. But when her shift ended, her replacement had still not arrived.
To make matters worse, the student scheduled to take over had her concert ticket and was supposed to give it to her at the store.

As she worried about leaving on time, a young visitor readily agreed to bring the ticket to the radio station if they found her missing coworker.
"I don't know whether the ticket will get there, but I'm going to head for the station without giving up," Iwabuchi said.

Will she make it to Aya Suzumura's concert? This crisis is disrupting the everyday lives of people across the area.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k155:
The giant aliens left a trail of destruction along Tsubaki Boulevard in Sakura Ward, from Sakuramachi Junction to Nishi-Azami Junction.
It was around 7 p.m., and many people were out in the city when disaster struck.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k156: Cats ask for help making a game
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k157:
A post from the Kaido Building on Tsubaki Boulevard in Sakura Ward shows cats asking someone to help develop a video game.
The cats, Toro and Kuro, sought a young person's assistance because development of the game they star in, "Absolutely Safe City 2: Good Night," has run into trouble.
Toro and Kuro will reportedly appear wherever this person travels, making requests related to development.
When will the game be finished? Its fate rests on this young person's shoulders.
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k158: The Tale of the Last Sword sells 1.1 billion
common/lua/stage_201_news_text.luc.0:k159:
The Tale of the Last Sword, the celebrated novel series that sold a billion copies worldwide, recently reached total sales of 1.1 billion.
Its passionate fans, known as "Last Sworders," actively connect with one another around the world.
One fan, Horuho Sugita of Miyato City, said, "Just when you think it's traditional fantasy, it takes an utterly unpredictable turn. It keeps defying expectations in the best possible way. And thanks to these books, I've made Last Sworder friends all over the world."

common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k94:
At around 7 p.m. today, a train on the Yotsuba subway line stopped abruptly near Azami 1-chome Station. The municipal railway operator says the driver reported a suspicious shape lying in the tunnel and the need for an emergency stop. After stopping, the driver called to say he would escort passengers through the tunnel to the station. His whereabouts have since become unknown.
Police are investigating a possible connection to the unidentified life-forms appearing in the area.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k95: Giant plant linked to creatures below?
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k96:
Shortly after 6 p.m. today, an unknown giant plant approximately 100 meters tall appeared at Akashia Department Store in Sakura Ward. Authorities are investigating a possible link to the crustacean-like creatures that appeared around the same time at nearby Azami 1-chome Station.
The area had already been closed off after those creatures attacked people at the municipal subway station, so this incident is not believed to have caused any injuries.

Witnesses say cracks suddenly spread through the department store before something resembling a giant flower burst through the roof. Authorities are questioning the building's management company.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k98:
Following attacks on people by unidentified crustacean-like creatures at Azami 1-chome Station, a huge plant-like organism has also been discovered inside the municipal subway station.
Escaping passengers say root-like structures several meters thick have spread throughout the station and adjoining underground shopping arcade. They have blocked escape routes, leaving many people trapped below.

Authorities are investigating whether these structures are the roots of the giant plant that burst through a nearby department store's roof. They also announced "Legion" as the collective name for the giant organisms appearing in the area.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k100:
Following the creature attacks at Azami 1-chome Station, the Metropolitan Police Department referred stationmaster Junichi Isono, 58, to prosecutors on suspicion of professional negligence resulting in death and other offenses. He allegedly fled without properly evacuating passengers and has reportedly admitted the main allegations.

Isono was among the first to escape, leaving dozens behind. He changed into ordinary clothes and falsely claimed to be a member of the public when rescued. He has faced fierce criticism online both in Japan and abroad, including accusations that he is "a disgrace to station staff."
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k102:
Today, Ryohei Ogita, 23, an office worker from Sumire Ward, was due to meet his girlfriend and colleague Yukana Suga, 26, on the platform at Azami 1-chome Station.

At around 7 p.m., while his train stood at the station, the lights suddenly went out. Before he could wonder what was happening, he saw blood splatter across the adjoining conductor's compartment.
His body moved before he could think. Ogita was the first to flee the train. Several small Legion creatures were already on the platform. He barely slipped past them, ran upstairs toward the ticket gates, and hid in the men's restroom.

Once he calmed down, he could think only of Suga's safety, but fear kept him rooted to the spot. Then a young stranger arrived, held out a ring, and asked if he recognized it. It was unmistakably the ring he had given Suga. The stranger said it belonged to a woman hiding in the restroom next door. Ogita called her name and heard her answer. After a brief, joyful reunion, they worked together to escape the underground arcade.

"Hiding alone, with no idea what was happening, felt like an eternity," Ogita said. Just what is happening in Miyato City? An urgent investigation and prompt release of information are essential.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k103: Giant monster descends from the sky!
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k104:
At around 7:30 p.m. today, multiple witnesses reported a giant creature descending from the sky near Akashia Department Store. Riot police and firefighters were already directing traffic there following the appearance of a giant plant.
The government, which calls this creature "Gamera," had been monitoring it. After approaching the department store's giant plant, it reportedly took to the sky again and disappeared.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k106: At around 7 p.m. today, large creatures up to two meters long were photographed roaming Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k108: Riot police, firefighters, and other officers continue working to contain the damage caused by the unknown creatures and giant plant. Riot officers have also been seen risking their lives to face the creatures while civilians evacuate.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k109: Jeweler falls victim to disaster looters
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k110:
The underground shopping arcade has suffered devastating damage from the giant plant and unknown creatures. Thefts exploiting the chaos are also widespread. A jewelry store alone has lost rubies, sapphires, and other gems worth a reported one billion yen.

Among them is a huge emerald known as "Algae's Tears," valued at 400 million yen by itself. Owner Okamoto lamented, "If only Algae's Tears would come back, at least."
Police have begun questioning witnesses to identify the emerald's thief.
A woman was seen breaking display cases and rummaging for jewels, and police are searching for her as a person of interest.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k111: Do creatures respond to electromagnetic waves?
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k112: Witnesses near Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line say the unknown creatures react to mobile phones and attack people carrying them. Some academics suggest that the creatures may be responding to the electromagnetic waves these devices emit.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k113: A girl searching for a hamburger
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k114:
A girl seeking a hamburger has reportedly been seen in the underground shopping arcade beside Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line, which was devastated by unknown creatures.
The girl is said to have come to eat hamburgers with her mother, only to be killed in the attack. According to her mother, she adored her late father and had come that day to eat his favorite GZ Burger.
Hearing reports of her daughter near the burger shop, the mother tearfully suggested that she still wandered there, unable to accept missing her meal.

Others, however, question this account: they say the girl's mother died just months after her father. Debate is raging online over which sightings, if any, are genuine.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k116:
The area around Umegaya Junction in Sakura Ward has been devastated by unknown creatures emerging from Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line.
Firefighters and riot police had been deployed to deal with the giant plant attached to Akashia Department Store. A horde of mysterious creatures then attacked, reportedly causing many casualties among residents and emergency personnel.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k117: Young person fends off subway creature
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k118: A young person was seen fighting off an unknown creature inside the station.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k119: People fight back above ground too
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k120: People above ground are also resisting the unknown creatures. The young person in this photograph successfully repelled one.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k122: Unknown creatures threw Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line into chaos. Even there, people who had only just met were seen working together, determined to help one another survive.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k124:
A young person whose path was blocked by an unknown creature threw a smartphone and successfully distracted it.
Several research institutes have offered theories, and the idea that the creatures react to electromagnetic waves is compelling.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k126: Amid the chaos, a young person tried to survive by imitating one of the unknown creatures. Could something like that really save a life?
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k127: Tips: Try a change of clothes
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k128:
If you find another outfit, try changing into it.
Different clothes can increase your maximum HP and ST.
(Some will lower those limits instead.)
Above all, a new outfit can lift your mood.
If you're in a difficult situation, changing clothes can be surprisingly effective.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, Kyoei News editorial team)
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k129: Tips: Short on cash? Find the man in orange
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k130:
If you're worried about running low on money,
try talking to the man in orange coveralls.
He will buy items you're carrying.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, Kyoei News editorial team)
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k132: The unidentified creatures known as Legion, which appeared around Azami 1-chome Station in Sakura Ward, have shells composed of silicon-based material. Their body tissue is reportedly similar to a semiconductor.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k134:
Azami 1-chome Station in Sakura Ward has suffered devastating damage from the attacks by unknown creatures.
Despite their fear, people gathered near the ticket gates were seen helping one another and holding on to hope of escape.
Local resident Morimoto was caught in the disaster while heading to a part-time shift at a convenience store in Aokibamachi. Morimoto entrusted a late-night concert ticket intended for a coworker to a young person heading toward the radio station.
"I'll do my best to escape and reach the store. But if I take the ticket there, it'll be too late. I'm hoping my coworker is already heading to the concert at the radio station, so I gave it to someone going that way," Morimoto reportedly said.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k136: Natsumi Higa, a teacher at a prefectural high school in Sakura Ward, was reportedly rescued by a passing young person after her leg became trapped beneath rubble inside Azami 1-chome Station.
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k138:
Cafe Yamagobo has operated in the underground arcade at Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line since the subway opened 40 years ago. The current disaster has brought that history to an end.
Jeweler Okamoto, a childhood friend of the cafe's owner, said, "He was always calm, no matter what happened. Even when I installed a keypad lock in his cafe as a prank, he didn't get angry. He just quietly kept polishing his coffee cups."
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k139: Risa Kashiwagi: Gratitude for everyday peace
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k140:
I was caught in the monster attack at Azami 1-chome Station. Unusually for me, I had dressed up to go out and have fun. Then the station suddenly went dark, and I watched monsters emerge from the shadows and attack people.
Seeing familiar surroundings and ordinary daily life destroyed in such an unimaginable way has shaken me deeply. I still cannot sort out my feelings.
I am thankful once again to be alive, grateful for the peace we normally enjoy, and praying for those who lost their lives. (By journalist Risa Kashiwagi)
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k141: Tips: Trade collected coins for items here
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k142:
Whenever you spot a shining coin on your travels, make sure to collect it.
You can exchange your coins for wonderful items right here on the Kyoei News website.
Press the Square button to open the item exchange menu.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, Kyoei News editorial team)
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k143: The Tale of the Last Sword, Vol. 2 arrives!
common/lua/stage_202_news_text.luc.0:k144:
The hugely popular novel series The Tale of the Last Sword has released its second volume, "Pitch Black." With a setting completely different from the first book, this installment takes readers into truly pitch-black darkness.
Only two volumes in, the series already conveys an epic sense of scale.
Author O. R. James says, "I have the outline worked out for all ten volumes. Now the characters themselves should weave the story for me."
We can hardly wait for volume three and beyond.

common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k122:
Two bizarre flying creatures suddenly appeared above Sky Garden Bridge.
Their different forms suggest they are not the same species.

They flew one behind the other over the bridge, almost as though playing. Before long, beams of light began destroying vehicles on the roadway.
The beams were powerful enough to pierce the bridge itself. As if hastening its collapse, the wind from their wingbeats made the entire structure bend to an unbelievable degree.

Some time after the bridge collapsed, the two creatures vanished.
Why did they attack it? Was it a warning to humanity?
Or were they like excited children breaking things without malice? Left with only questions and catastrophic damage, what can we do?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k124:
One of the flying creatures that appeared above Sky Garden Bridge looks, at first glance, like a moth grown to enormous size. Could it be a mutation?
Animal researcher Dr. Shionogi disagrees. "Mutations can produce larger specimens, but the largest recorded member of the butterfly and moth order measures only 32 centimeters. Even if an Earth organism mutated to that size, its body structure would make flight impossible. At present, all we can say is that it cannot be an organism from Earth."

Tissue thought to belong to the creature has been recovered at sea, and a special research project is being organized to investigate. Dr. Shionogi is eager to participate.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k126:
"It's a demon." "How could it be anything else?" Comments like these keep arriving on our news video of one of the two enormous flying creatures over Sky Garden Bridge.
Unlike its companion, this one gives a distinctly savage impression.
But frightening looks alone cannot tell us whether a creature is evil, any more than they can with a person.
It certainly attacked the bridge and its vehicles relentlessly. Still, we must acknowledge that it may have had some reason for doing so.

Wild animals driven from their habitats often cause trouble when they enter human settlements seeking food. What if we had unknowingly done something similar here?
We should recognize how readily we assume humanity comes first, and sincerely investigate the cause.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k128:
Younger readers may not know that today's Sky Garden Bridge is the second to bear that name.
The first was designed and built during the years of rapid economic growth as a showcase of modern infrastructure. It carried only roads and footpaths, yet provided an extremely useful link between communities.

Then, in the winter exactly 20 years after it opened, a passenger aircraft forced to ditch after engine failure crashed into the bridge.
Readers over 40 may remember the special broadcasts that continued for days.

Public finances were strained, and a replacement was expected to take many years. Surrounding towns resigned themselves to decline.
Then, as winter ended and spring approached, a man offered an enormous sum from his personal fortune. (To be continued)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k130:
I could not believe my eyes. No, I did not want to believe them.

That was how I felt watching Sky Garden Bridge, a vital transport link reborn after a horrific tragedy, sink into the sea.
Still considered among the finest structures in the world, a bridge one might call the "world's strongest" collapsed with terrifying ease, leaving only a few supports.
The unprecedented sound of huge masses of steel scraping, creaking, and twisting sounded like the bridge itself crying out.

Yet I believe a new Sky Garden Bridge will rise again one day, carrying people's smiling faces across the water.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k132:
A vehicle was seen forcing its way across Sky Garden Bridge, crashing into other cars around the time the mysterious flying creatures appeared.
Its driver may have been fleeing in terror, but the behavior can only be called selfish.
Worse, the license plate visible in the footage revealed that the vehicle was stolen. Taking someone else's car, shoving others aside, and endangering them to save oneself would be utterly disgraceful.

The vehicle was later recovered from the seabed after the bridge collapsed, but its occupants were not found. Police are investigating.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k134:
While covering the destruction of Sky Garden Bridge, our helicopter accidentally captured something extraordinary.

Three men stood on a roadway lined with burning cars and sections already giving way.
Our own investigation identifies the two on the right as a senior member of an organization plagued by sinister rumors and his subordinate.

Astonishingly, the man opposite them is Mr. F, who belongs to an organization that should be at odds with theirs.
Was this simply a chance encounter? Perhaps, but it seems almost too convenient.

I suspect some kind of secret discussion.
Mr. F, after all, is also dogged by dark rumors.
My investigation continues. Please watch for further reports.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k136:
We obtained mobile-phone footage of a Garden Liner carriage just after the disaster, recorded by bridge-collapse survivor Shizuo Sato, a pseudonym.

The carriage is completely off its rails and clearly unable to run. Several people also appear in the footage, but sadly none has yet been confirmed alive.

Sky Garden Bridge's collapse has dealt a potentially fatal blow to Garden Liner services.
Katsuzo Hinokaji, 62, president of operator GR, looked exhausted as he struggled to say, "With the bridge gone, restoring service is impossible at present."
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k138:
Footage recorded by miraculous survivor Shizuo Sato, a pseudonym, revealed something extraordinary: the perpetrator of the deadly rampage at West Azami Park about two months ago.

"That's the face!" an officer suddenly shouted while reviewing phone footage submitted to establish conditions on the bridge. Officer Akira Fukiishi, 28, said his practice of saving wanted suspects' photographs on his phone and studying them morning and night had paid off.

Unfortunately, the suspect has not been confirmed alive since the collapse. We hope the officer's efforts will eventually be rewarded with an arrest.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k140:
A motorcycle belonging to Shizuo Sato, a pseudonym, who miraculously survived the Sky Garden Bridge collapse, was stolen during the crisis.

Sato was riding across the bridge when the giant creatures attacked. Stranded there, he developed stress-induced diarrhea. He walked somewhere discreet to relieve himself, but returned to find his motorcycle gone.

Bystanders said a young couple had mounted it and headed east before anyone could stop them.
It is generally understood that people should avoid driving during emergencies. Even if survival is at stake, using another person's property without permission also raises ethical questions.

Yet while preparing this article, we heard several opposing views: "How can you ask permission if you don't know who owns it?" and "I understand putting yourself first when your life is at risk."
This debate looks likely to continue.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k141: Why fight with cars during a disaster?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k142:
Our helicopter filmed two cars racing across Sky Garden Bridge and repeatedly colliding after the mysterious flying creatures appeared.
We could not observe them for long, but a black car seemed to be relentlessly chasing a blue one. The blue car continued despite severe damage and was later seen abandoned.
What had happened between their occupants? A personal grudge, or a sudden dispute brought on by these extraordinary circumstances? Until the occupants are identified, we cannot know. Still, seeing such ugly conflict while everyone on the bridge faced death made the creatures' actions seem less like wanton destruction and more like humanity being culled or purged. Was I alone in finding that thought profoundly sad?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k144:
One photograph taken on the crumbling Sky Garden Bridge left my heart aching. According to the photographer, the couple pictured were engaged and on their way to meet the woman's parents that day.
Sadly, neither has been confirmed alive since the collapse, and the photographer did not learn their names.
Others, including the photographer, survived against the odds. I sincerely hope these two are alive and can continue toward the married life they had planned.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k146:
"Devastating." It was the only word that came to mind when I saw this footage.
This is not a distant war zone. It is our own familiar Sky Garden Bridge.
Car after car burns along its length, seemingly without end.
In a few months, these images may be buried beneath the internet's vast accumulation of data. Even so, I must fight to keep this tragedy from being forgotten. That is my duty as a journalist.
We currently have no way to prevent such a disaster. Yet even one piece of footage might offer a clue to a solution. If each of us does what we can, we may be able to respond when something similar happens again. Could that be the key to humanity's survival?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k148:
We captured the strange beam fired by one of the giant flying creatures.
It clearly strikes the bridge like lightning of an unfamiliar color. We do not yet know whether it is made of the same elements as what we call a "beam." Experts say that, even if it were produced by familiar means, modern science could not achieve such destructive power. No material on Earth could form a barrel capable of withstanding that output.
Would that not also mean we possess no material or structure capable of stopping it?
Analysis is underway using footage, including ours. I fervently hope the project succeeds, so humanity can confront whatever giant shadows may appear next.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k150:
While covering Sky Garden Bridge's collapse, our directional microphone picked up two women left on the bridge. Their conversation left me speechless.
Rather than confronting the immediate danger, they simply blamed one another for their predicament. We have heard for years that public awareness of emergencies is declining, but I never imagined it had reached this point. In earlier interviews, even people who initially seemed unconcerned usually proved, on closer questioning, to be hiding embarrassment or putting on a brave face. They understood the danger.
Perhaps my earlier reporting was inadequate. Perhaps I found the only pair like this in the country.
Either way, such people exist: unable to recognize danger and determined to blame everyone else.
In a sense, perhaps they are happy. They may never feel guilty about anything.
But we must never follow their example. To do so would be to abandon our humanity.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k151: A phone worth more than life?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k152:
Kanae Shimizu, 20, a pseudonym, was rescued after being thrown into the sea when Sky Garden Bridge collapsed. Our reporting uncovered her extraordinary behavior on regaining consciousness.
She had passed out on impact and was brought ashore nearby. Her parents arrived in time to rejoice at their only daughter's survival. Wrapped in a blanket and held in their arms, she awoke and looked back and forth between them. Apparently unable to remember anything after falling, she nodded repeatedly as they explained. Just when the ordeal seemed over, she began searching her pockets and surroundings for her phone, to the astonishment of her parents and rescuers. "My phone! It's gone!" Her parents tried to calm her, saying they could buy another, but she remained fixated on that particular phone and finally tried to dive into the sea herself.
A rescuer's quick action stopped her. She reportedly remains obsessed with the phone at the hospital, and even her parents do not know why. I am intensely curious and hope to bring you a follow-up report.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k153: The bus that saved a life
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k154:
Shizuo Sato, a pseudonym, took many valuable photographs of the collapsing Sky Garden Bridge. He says he survived thanks to a nearby bus.
He instinctively jumped aboard, sat down in an emergency-landing brace position, and gripped the rail of the seat in front.
The bus fell into the sea with the steel and concrete that had once formed the bridge. More wreckage plunged into the water, denting the bus again and again. Protected by this steel armor, Sato survived until the debris settled.
He had another stroke of luck: the two-liter plastic bottle he was carrying was already empty.
He says it helped him survive underwater longer than he otherwise could.
Who could have imagined that refusing to litter would prove useful in such a situation?

To avoid misunderstanding, staying inside a vehicle is not always the right choice. There are serious risks, including water pressure preventing escape from a sealed cabin or wreckage trapping occupants inside.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k156:
Just before Sky Garden Bridge's final major collapse, our news helicopter captured intriguing footage.
Two people on a motorcycle were making an enormous, cinematic jump. At first it seemed to show a spectacular escape, but the motorcycle looked familiar.
Our analysis found that it matches the model and color of a motorcycle reported stolen.
If so, could this footage show the thieves themselves?
The long-distance shot makes facial identification extremely difficult. We have provided it to police and are continuing our own analysis. Watch for further reports.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k158:
New initiatives

For our third installment, we report on the Garden Liner's recent developments and near future.
Already a world leader in large-scale passenger and freight transport, it is introducing new ways to travel. Its extraordinary record of precision and safety, with schedules accurate to the minute or even second, underpins a new type of carriage already in service. Each carries only ten passengers, all in private compartments, for a more elegant journey. At roughly twice the normal fare, the comfort is relatively affordable, making it hugely popular with commuters tired of rush-hour crowds. Tickets are sold out for the next five years, and some reportedly fetch inflated prices online.
Operator GR is already moving to increase service frequency and add more of these carriages, though demand is still expected to exceed supply.

Another new type of train is due to enter service soon. Next time, we will investigate what it offers.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k160:
As mysterious giant flying creatures destroyed Sky Garden Bridge, its emergency telephones failed to connect and proved useless.

Most observers blame cables severed by the destruction, but our independent investigation suggests they may never have worked.
Usage records indicate that, since installation, calls were attempted but never connected. Each failure prompted an inspection and a report that service had been restored, yet questions remain.
Every inspection was performed by Company T, the original installation contractor. Documents we obtained show that it failed to purchase essential equipment to cut costs. In other words, it apparently installed phones that were never connected, then collected repair fees through false restoration reports.
Former employee K says the president boasted while drinking: "Everyone has a mobile anyway. Nobody uses emergency phones," and, "Even if someone notices, they're out at sea. Blame salt damage and nobody will know. Better still, the repair fee is pure profit."
If true, how many lives were needlessly lost? We will continue investigating Company T.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k162:
This is the last footage recovered from a camera in our news helicopter, which struck a mysterious giant flying creature and sank.
Its position relative to the bridge suggests it entered the sea immediately afterward.
The creature remains just visible in frame, a testament to the cameraman's determination.
He is still missing. I have known him for many years: a man who would charge ahead, quite literally risking his life, to capture his subject. I believe that even then he was absorbed in getting one more shot from another angle or distance, rather than thinking about the helicopter or his own fate.

Some may dismiss such behavior as foolishly stubborn. Yet there can be no doubt that a person like him is deeply dependable.
I am proud to report this story alongside his footage.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k163: The danger of a sudden gust
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k164:
We captured a giant flying creature passing directly in front of people fleeing across the bridge.
Its huge wings generated gusts strong enough to nearly knock down grown adults.
That it could threaten lives simply by passing inspired both immense fear and an indescribable awe.
Since ancient times, people have feared and revered the unknowable and uncontrollable, living humbly before them.
Perhaps these giant creatures have come to remind humanity of that feeling.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k166:
The flying creature resembling an enormous moth initially appeared to be pursued by the other giant. We then witnessed it shower its opponent from above with glowing, scale-like particles.
The creature beneath it cried out as if in pain and appeared to flee in distress.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k168:
We captured the moment the northern bridge restaurant, already half-destroyed by a flying creature's beam, plunged into the sea.
Famous for quiet views of the beautiful night skyline, it was so popular with couples that Christmas Eve reservations were booked ten years ahead.
The food was first-rate too. I still remember how impressed I was when I dined there for a story three years ago.
Fortunately, both customers and staff had reportedly escaped that day. I sincerely hope the restaurant can be rebuilt and reopened.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k169: Farewell to the restaurant of my youth
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k170:
The restaurant on the south side of Sky Garden Bridge has collapsed.
Unlike its more mature northern counterpart, this hugely popular, casual venue catered to a somewhat younger crowd.
It was still fairly expensive. I vividly remember saving every possible yen from my high-school part-time job to take the older woman I was dating there.

One reason for its popularity was the rumor that couples who had their first date there would stay together.
Statistics reportedly showed that an astonishing 99% lasted more than five years.

Sadly, I belong to the remaining 1%. Even so, I mourn the loss of a place filled with bittersweet memories of youth.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k172:
Actor OH, currently at the height of his popularity, was stranded on Sky Garden Bridge when the flying creatures attacked.
With him was equally popular actress SY.
They were reportedly returning to OH's home after a secret date when disaster struck.
Their relationship, revealed in this unexpected way, has divided fans into supporters and critics.
OH had been rumored to be dating another actress, KF, prompting speculation that he was seeing both women.
The revelation has been especially shocking for fans of SY, whose innocent image had never hinted at a man in her life.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k173: No longer the woman she was
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k174:
Reporting on actress SY after her secret date with OH was exposed revealed changes that began several months ago.
SY is the eldest of four daughters raised by a single mother. Despite poor health, her mother raised them after their father brought another woman into the house and forced his wife and daughters out. SY was only in fourth grade.
These experiences left her deeply distrustful of men. She entered show business without pursuing romance, working tirelessly to repay her mother and provide her sisters with a good education. That pure devotion won her many fans.

Recently, however, a rift has developed. Her sisters allegedly began withdrawing money from the earnings her mother managed, spending every night out and taking dozens of friends on lavish overseas trips.
They also reportedly exploited SY's fame to buy expensive apartments and vacation homes, naming her as guarantor.

However many hundreds of millions she earned, they spent more. A rupture was hardly surprising.
She now reportedly lives alone with her mother and has cut off contact with her sisters.

Actor OH apparently helped soothe her wounded heart.
Perhaps she is growing from a devoted woman who works single-mindedly for her family into an independent woman pursuing her own happiness.
Whatever becomes of the sisters who failed to understand her love, we hope she and her mother find happiness.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k176:
This is an emergency warning triangle.
How many drivers fail to carry one?

If you must stop on the road, you need to warn approaching drivers by placing it several to several dozen meters behind your vehicle.

Once a major collision occurs, it is too late. Put another way, a small precaution can prevent danger.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k178:
Witnesses reported a woman staring silently at the northern restaurant.
She reportedly knew that entering it would lead to the lower roadway.
Yet she never went inside. She remains missing, so her reasons are unknown.
Another witness says someone else had cleared a path into the restaurant. Why, then, did she not act?

People can appear calm while actually panicking.
Perhaps she looked as though she was calmly planning her escape when, in fact, her thoughts had frozen completely.

We can only pray for her safety.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k179: The end of an illicit getaway
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k180:
A woman miraculously rescued from Sky Garden Bridge was found to have been returning from a trip with her lover.
The man was among the other survivors, while the female friend she claimed to have traveled with had not gone at all.
Bored with her seemingly unreliable husband, she had reportedly approached a wild-natured male subordinate and begun an affair a year earlier.

Her husband has already divorced her and started a new life with their daughter.
The woman, meanwhile, left her company after her improper relationship with a subordinate was exposed.
It is a textbook ending to an affair.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k182:
The male subordinate who accompanied the woman on the affair trip reported elsewhere was seen cowering and trembling on the bridge.
The supposedly wild, rugged man proved remarkably helpless.

People who knew him through high school remember someone quiet and unassuming. University acquaintances, however, describe an assertive, confident, dependable man.
He had reinvented himself at college, building a new persona through sheer bravado somewhere nobody knew his past.
His underlying nature, it seems, was not so easily changed.

The affair was wrong, but nobody has the right to condemn him for who he truly is.
He now reportedly earns a living at a convenience store in a major city.
We hope he finds happiness there.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k184:
A refrigerated-truck driver stopped abruptly when the giant flying creatures appeared. Vehicles struck him from behind, scattering frozen fish from the container across the road.
As the fish thawed, their smell reportedly grew stronger.

He nevertheless did his best to clear them away.
Then the bridge collapsed, sending him and his frozen cargo into the sea.

By chance, he ended up inside the truck's container, which shielded him from falling girders and rubble while he waited for things to settle.
But trapped inside with half-thawed fish and schools of sea fish around him, he says the overwhelming smell nearly drove him mad.

He later changed jobs to a general-goods delivery company.
The smell still seems to cling to him, and he cannot even approach the supermarket fish counter.
It is a pity he can no longer eat fish, but plenty of other delicious foods remain.
We hope he stays healthy and enjoys the life he so narrowly saved.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k185: On the Scene: Those Left Behind, Part 1
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k186:
Among those stranded with me on Sky Garden Bridge as the giant creatures rampaged was a nurse.
She said she always carried basic medical supplies and did everything she could, including giving a pain-relief patch to someone who had hurt his back.
Having personally experienced several disasters, I know that emergencies reveal people's true character.
The bridge later collapsed, and sadly she remains missing.
I sincerely hope she has survived somewhere.
(By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k187: On the Scene: Those Left Behind, Part 2
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k188:
A woman crouched trembling as giant flying creatures circled overhead.
When I spoke to her, she kept repeating, like a chant, "I just want to go home."
Faced with overwhelming terror in a place with no escape, such behavior is all too common.
Fortunately, despite broken bones and other injuries, she survived the collapse.
Seeing her cry in her parents' arms in her hospital room warmed my heart as well. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k190:
With the train destroyed and collapsed sections of bridge blocking escape, I met someone still trying to sell products to meet his quota.

Such calm in an emergency is rare. Even across the many disasters I have experienced, I have seldom encountered it.
Curious, I listened to his story and understood. He had spent years posted to countries experiencing armed conflict, if not natural disasters. That must have given him nerves of steel.

Sadly, he remains missing after the collapse. Yet I cannot shake the feeling that he is alive somewhere.
(By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k191: Even a minor injury deserves attention
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k192:
Some people stranded on the crumbling Sky Garden Bridge complained of injuries or feeling unwell.
The man in this footage apparently hurt his back when thrown from a wrecked train.
He said it initially felt only slightly uncomfortable, but the pain grew worse over time.

Ignoring an injury because "it's an emergency," "it's only a scratch," or "it only hurts a little" can be very dangerous.
If you are not constantly moving, have a little time, and have some means of treatment, even basic first aid, you should use it.

Fortunately, this man received a pain-relief patch and became able to walk, albeit slowly.
Should you ever face an emergency, I hope you remember this article. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k193: A troublesome lie during an emergency
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k194:
A man claimed he had twisted his ankle and could not move.
It was a lie. He apparently wanted to avoid taking risks or leading an escape attempt.
Although little harm resulted this time, such lies often cause serious trouble.
They consume precious medical supplies and the time of doctors and nurses, potentially denying care to those who truly need it.

The man survived, but reportedly broke both legs when the bridge collapsed and he fell into the sea. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k195: On the Scene: Those Left Behind, Part 3
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k196:
In a sudden crisis, it is common to see people looking around helplessly, unable to understand what is happening or what to do.
Their minds are so overwhelmed that even taking a deep breath to calm down does not occur to them.
Care is needed: a clumsy attempt by someone else to reassure them can sometimes make their distress worse. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k198:
As Sky Garden Bridge neared collapse, I encountered someone profoundly disappointing.
I could not help overhearing him talking to himself.
He seemed to be hoping that the giant creatures would attack someone else, giving him a chance to escape alone.
Putting one's own safety first is understandable. But is it right, as a human being, to plan around another person's sacrifice?

In a previous disaster, I met someone willing even to kill others to survive.
It is deeply saddening.

The man on the bridge remains missing after its collapse. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k199: A dangerous man, or something else?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k200:
Witnesses saw an unusually calm man on Sky Garden Bridge shortly before it collapsed. He carried an emergency backpack with something resembling a crowbar sticking out.
Later reporting suggests he is a journalist who has survived many disasters like this one.

Because the crowbar could serve as a weapon, other stranded people initially regarded him as dangerous and kept their distance.

Once again, he reportedly survived: after the collapse, he swam ashore unaided and walked away.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k201: "We buy anything" takes social media by storm
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k202:
The buyback dealers recently attracting attention were spotted on Sky Garden Bridge as its collapse approached.

Their conspicuous outfits and unusual business model, with staff stationed in various places acting as individual shops, have made them a social-media talking point.

Many people would like them to offer a "We sell anything" service too, but unfortunately no comment has been forthcoming.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k203: Caught on camera: The moment of destruction
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k204:
This footage captures a flying creature's beam destroying the upper roadway, sending rubble and cars crashing to the lower level.
At the time, similar destruction could have struck anywhere on the bridge without warning, yet rubble blocked escape routes and left people trapped.

When the bridge is rebuilt, I hope it includes ladders or other ways for stranded people to reach the water. The next threat may not be a giant creature, but an earthquake could create similar conditions. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k206:
A giant flying creature's beam sent cars flying across the bridge.
A passing motorcycle was also spotted, apparently escaping unharmed.
Whether by chance or because its rider was a stunt performer remains unknown,
but it seemed to slip gracefully through a gap beneath the airborne cars.

Unexpected skills may help us survive extraordinary situations.
We plan to begin a feature introducing such skills soon. Watch for further details.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k208:
Before the bridge restaurant collapsed completely, we captured part of it giving way.
The floor tilted, sending chairs and tables sliding toward the sea.
Those sliding pieces of furniture pose a serious problem.

I have actually faced a similar situation myself.
Then, I avoided falling into the sea by instinctively hanging from the floor's edge.
I thought such scenes were extraordinarily rare. Apparently not.

If you encounter one, try to stay calm, watch the sliding furniture,
and make your way uphill to level ground without being struck. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k210:
This image captures two giant flying creatures passing close to the half-destroyed bridge restaurant, the one behind firing a beam at the other.

The mechanism behind this beam remains unknown.
Unofficial reports suggest several countries have begun studying ways to reproduce it for military use.

I cannot help feeling that humanity might be better off if the mystery remained unsolved.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k212:
A suspicious person was spotted in the men's restroom of the bridge restaurant shortly before its collapse.
Security footage survived because the cameras transmitted it over a dedicated line to the restaurant operator's headquarters.

Using the restroom when nearly half the building had apparently already collapsed would be odd enough. The person also wandered about as though searching for something, so criminal involvement cannot be ruled out.
Yet given the location, a financial motive seems unlikely. What could the purpose have been?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k213: A Life Devoted to Toilets, Part 1 of 3
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k214:
Have you heard the name Tatsujiro Koshiba?
He founded COCYBA, the bathroom and kitchen goods manufacturer and retailer that now boasts a 99% domestic market share and 70% overseas.

He once apprenticed under the great master Shunzo Sanuki.
But while Sanuki was an artist devoted to making each piece individually, Koshiba wanted "beautiful, functional objects that more people can afford." Their paths diverged.

With modest savings and a loan secured against his home, he established Koshiba Ltd.
That small company would later become COCYBA.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k215: A Life Devoted to Toilets, Part 2 of 3
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k216:
Of the things he had learned to make under Sanuki, Koshiba chose toilets as his first manufacturing and sales venture.
They were Western-style toilets, still unusual at the time.
He poured his heart into sculpting the original from which a mold was made for mass production.

More attractive and less expensive than existing models, his toilets won public acclaim and rapidly spread nationwide.
Yet Koshiba himself was deeply unhappy.
When mass production began, he visited his former teacher to show him a finished product.
Sanuki was furious. He hurled the toilet at a garden rock and smashed it.
Although Koshiba's original was a masterpiece, mass production inevitably introduced slight variations.
To Sanuki, every altered example was a different object, its balance ruined: a defective piece.

Public praise and rising sales could not dull the sting of his teacher's words.
Sanuki had seen straight through his compromise of sculptural beauty for mass production.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k218:
Hand dryers are now common in public and workplace restrooms.
Did you know they are beginning a new stage of evolution?

Models are now available that remove facial shine as well as dry hands.
They are hugely popular among office workers whose faces become oily when tired or toward evening.

Rather than simply drying the skin, they also moisturize it, avoiding the problem of removing shine only to leave the face parched. Users instead report a refreshing effect.
They are particularly popular with sales staff who frequently meet outside clients, and corporate orders are reportedly very strong.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k220:
A young person entered the bridge restaurant's women's restroom despite the building being moments from collapse.
Their wandering behavior clearly suggests they were not there for its usual purpose.

Why visit such a place in those circumstances? Perhaps they were a customer desperately searching for a lost possession.

As criminal activity is also possible, police are working to identify and question the person. Watch for further reports.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k221: A Life Devoted to Toilets, Part 3 of 3
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k222:
Koshiba then built a research facility and began working day and night alongside his employees to create a mass-production system that could reproduce his original perfectly.
A company cannot run with its president shut away in a laboratory. During that period, his wife Shizuka managed the business as vice president.

Even in an era when male supremacy was taken for granted, she exercised formidable leadership and expanded the company further.

After five years in the laboratory, Koshiba finally succeeded in mass-producing exact copies of his original.
Sanuki said nothing when shown the result, but apparently approved: one remains installed in his restroom to this day.

Five years of punishingly intense research took a terrible toll. Half the participating workers died from what would now be called overwork.
Yet they had shared Koshiba's vision and proudly told family and friends that they worked willingly. No lawsuits followed their deaths.
Their families even refused the company's condolence payments, saying acceptance would betray the workers' pride.

Koshiba himself died two days after showing the product to Sanuki.
His expression was reportedly deeply peaceful.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k224:
Did you know there are hand dryers designed for women?

Their hand-drying function goes beyond simple drying: a special moisturizing mist leaves skin smooth.
The effect is reportedly far faster than commercial hand creams. One test found that women with rough hands lost even their skin cracks after about three uses.

They also remove facial shine without disturbing makeup.
A special function improves the complexion at the same time, giving them an astonishing beauty-treatment effect.

Demand is strong not only from offices but from women buying them for home beauty care, to the point that production lines are being expanded.
Home models with a foot-care function are also available, earning glowing reviews for helping with swelling and cold feet.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k225: Stolen? No, the money is safe
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k226:
Someone other than a staff member was seen near the cash register shortly before the collapse.
Poor lighting makes the scene unclear, but it appears as though the person is taking money.

However, when the register was later recovered, its contents were intact. Nothing had been stolen.

What, then, was the person doing?
Trying unsuccessfully to open it? Or indulging a peculiar passion for cash registers?
The person has not been identified. Since no theft occurred, the restaurant operator does not intend to report the matter to police.
Sadly, it seems we may never learn the truth.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k227: Windsocks: Useful even in a crisis
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k228:
How many people can immediately picture a windsock?
It is the tube of fabric often seen beside roads or at airports, commonly striped green and white or orange and white.
Windsocks indicate approximate wind direction and strength.
Private motorists may pay them little attention, but they are valuable on coastal roads and other places where strong gusts can cause accidents.
Drivers usually keep their windows closed in such weather, making conditions harder to judge.

A windsock once helped me during a disaster.
After an earthquake stripped away walls and floors, I had to cross an exposed steel beam. A nearby windsock let me gauge the gusts,
so I crossed without being blown off.
I recommend developing the habit of noticing your surroundings. (By Sudo)
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k230:
Many rumors surround Sky Garden Bridge. Today we examine the claim that its supports actually float.

Normally, bridge piers are fixed to strong foundations built on the seabed.
Even a layperson like me understands that otherwise they could shift and the bridge would cease to function.

I initially wondered how such a rumor could arise.
Further reporting suggests it may not be entirely false, though I have found no conclusive evidence.
Whenever I approach a pier to investigate, a Coast Guard boat appears from nowhere and sends me away.

If true, this could be a patented invention overturning everything we know about bridge construction.
I intend to keep investigating. Watch for updates.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k232:
Walk across ten times, and...

Have you heard that walking ten round trips across Sky Garden Bridge will grant a wish?
It sounds like a bridge version of the hundred-visit shrine prayer.

The wishes supposedly differ between the northern and southern walkways on the lower level.
Ten round trips on the north grant wishes of love; on the south, wishes about studies or business.
