You must not be seen by anyone or speak along the way. With cars constantly passing, that seems all but impossible...
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k234:
Leap with a wish, and...

Sky Garden Bridge has a long history. A wooden bridge once stood here, though it bore a different name.
A story about the crossing dates from that era.

Soon after the old bridge was built, in a society rigidly divided by class, a samurai family's daughter fell in love with a commoner. Her parents hired a masterless samurai to kill him.
Despairing, she threw herself from the bridge railing. A bright light reportedly descended from above, then rose into the heavens together with another light from the water.
Witnesses' accounts gradually became a rumor that jumping from the bridge would unite a person with their beloved.

So many people jumped, and so many died, that the shogunate stationed officials permanently at the bridge to stop it.

Though easily overlooked, small shrines honoring the dead still stand beside the bridge supports on both shores.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k235: Can the bridge really bind lovers?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k236:
Can the bridge really bind lovers?

About 120 meters from the western end of the lower southern walkway on Sky Garden Bridge, part of the railing resembles an angel.
It was accidentally bent during construction, but left as it was because its strength and structural integrity were unaffected.

Its angelic appearance inspired a rumor: tie a cloth bearing your name and your lover's to the nearby railing, and your love will last forever.
No matter how often the city removed the cloths, more appeared. Eventually officials gave in and began managing the spot as a tourist attraction.
The cloths are now removed regularly, and an area is designated for tying them.

It has recently become a popular stop for couples visiting from other prefectures, so many readers may already know it.
It is curious what small things can give birth to a rumor.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k237: A third level beneath the sea?
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k238:
A third level beneath the sea?

Sky Garden Bridge is generally understood to have two levels: an upper roadway reserved for vehicles, and a lower level carrying pedestrians, vehicles, and trains.

But have you heard the rumor of a third level?
Supposedly, elevators inside the piers descend below the seabed to passages leading to other piers and the opposite shore.
These are said to be reserved for important officials in an emergency.
When I asked the management company and others, they laughed it off.
There are indeed ladders inside the piers, they said, but only for bridge inspection and maintenance.

Yet immediately after those interviews, my superior ordered me to stop investigating. Suspicious of this timing, I have considered my position and intend to resign, pursuing the story as a freelance journalist. Watch for further reports.
common/lua/stage_203_news_text.luc.0:k240:
A spiritual barrier in disguise?

Recently, claims that Sky Garden Bridge is a spiritual barrier have spread after someone noted that its shape from the sea resembles a symbol used by a certain religion to keep evil spirits out.

I investigated that faith and found that a similar symbol does indeed exist.
However, it was always an obscure religion, and apparently has no remaining followers.
People tend to connect small details and devise unusual interpretations. Perhaps that explains the rumor.
Or is something more deeply rooted progressing in secret? I intend to continue investigating.

common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k164:
At around 9 p.m. today, a fire broke out at Iberis Tower in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, Miyato Prefecture. Labors from the Metropolitan Police Department's Security Bureau, Special Vehicles Section 2, Second Platoon, commonly known as SV2, rescued people trapped inside.
The operation reportedly won support from some who had distrusted the Labor unit. However, footage shows a Labor breaking through an exterior wall to enter, and opinions are divided over whether the damage was necessary.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k166:
Labors from the Metropolitan Police Department's Special Vehicles Section 2, Second Platoon, were deployed to rescue people from a fire at Iberis Tower in Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
The unit reached the roof by helicopter and used cables during the operation. Possibly due to a piloting error, a Labor damaged the building, sending repeated showers of debris to the ground.
Fortunately no one was hurt, but nearby residents have expressed concern about the unit.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k168:
Our news helicopter captured a police Labor descending to the ground with a girl in its arms.
The machine was an AV-98 Ingram of the Metropolitan Police Department's Special Vehicles Section 2, Second Platoon. It was reportedly chosen for the rescue because it offers greater mobility and precision than the Fire Department's CRL-98 Pyro-Buster.
Judging by the girl's smile, this deployment was a great success.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k170:
During the Iberis Tower fire, a Fire Department Labor became wedged in a corridor.
An exclusive photograph obtained by our reporters confirms it was indeed stuck. Could the pilot not have noticed the problem before entering? Other firefighting Labors freed it, and it reportedly suffered no mechanical damage.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k172:
"A firefighting Labor saved me!" We heard this repeatedly from people caught in the building fire.
Sakurada of Kunshiran Construction credits one with saving his life. As he headed for an emergency exit, the ceiling suddenly collapsed and flames blocked his path.
Just as he thought it was over, a firefighting Labor appeared in Iberis Tower's central atrium and began spraying water. After extinguishing the flames, it reportedly watched over him until he passed safely.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k174:
The wreckage of a TYPE-5Q/2C Grau-Bear, of unknown ownership, was found in the remains of the Iberis Tower fire.
Its pilot has not been found. The damage suggests it fell through the central atrium.
Building officials could provide no information, and it is believed to have entered from outside. Any connection to the fire remains unknown.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k176:
"A blue Labor was blowing up the building." Terayama, who had been working on air conditioning at Iberis Tower, says a wall suddenly collapsed and a blue Labor appeared while he was evacuating after hearing the fire alarm.
The machine reportedly rampaged across the floor before heading downstairs.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k178:
At around 9 p.m. today, Komori was enjoying the night view from Iberis Tower's observation floor when the sound of a helicopter drew attention.
Looking around, Komori saw a blue Labor being carried to the roof. Could it be connected to the fire?
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k180:
At around 9:30 p.m. today, a blue Labor attacked Kunshiran Construction's headquarters and stole a safe.
The company's public-relations department acknowledged the theft and loss of important documents but said there was no outside impact, such as disclosure of personal or corporate information.
The Labor's affiliation is unknown. However, environmental group NKX had previously issued fierce protests against Kunshiran that could be interpreted as threats. Miyato Prefectural Police suspect the group's involvement and intend to question its representative, Kiyoharu Futamura.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k182:
Major mobile-phone company Lightning Connect recently made headlines over a massive customer-data leak. The breach reportedly began when a salesperson, talking on a phone in another company's elevator, said something that allowed the attacker to infer a password and access the computers.
Discussing projects in an elevator shared with outsiders, assuming nobody will understand, is indefensible. In this high-tech society, one never knows what may trigger an information leak.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k184:
Reports have emerged of a man angrily demanding, "Give me back my Weekly Giant Shadow!" in connection with the Iberis Tower fire.
The man is a Kunshiran Construction executive. A badly burned safe was recovered from the site, and he is reportedly causing an uproar over a copy of the magazine that was inside.
Miyato Prefectural Police intend to question him as a person of interest in the fire. The magazine itself has not been found.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k186:
Coastal reclamation work for Miyato City's waterfront development project has been approved to resume after an accident halted it late last month.
Once reclamation begins, the last of Miyato Prefecture's beaches will disappear.
Work starts on the 12th of next month, and the beach remains open to the public until the end of this month. Anyone wishing for one final look should visit before 3 p.m. on the month's last day.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k188:
Kunshiran Construction president Busujima has been missing since today's fire at Iberis Tower.
Miyato Prefectural Police say he was seen several times fleeing through the office. They believe he was caught in the fire and are trying to establish his safety.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k190:
Kunshiran Construction continues to remain silent about the attack on its offices. When we contacted its public-relations department, we were told to await an announcement and received no answers.
Meanwhile, Yasumi Obimori, the lawyer who represented Kunshiran in the waterfront development project, has reportedly been summoned despite the late hour. It seems clear the company knows something about the fire and the attack.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k192:
At around 9 p.m. today, fire broke out at Iberis Tower. At the same time, a Labor attacked Kunshiran Construction's twentieth-floor offices and stole a safe.
Afterward, the safe and wreckage of what appeared to be the intruding Labor were found in the ground-floor hall. The company's bankbook was missing from the safe.
The account handles Kunshiran's operating funds. Miyato Prefectural Police suspect the Labor pilot took the book before fleeing.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k194:
At around 9 p.m. today, fire broke out at Iberis Tower. At the same time, a Labor attacked Kunshiran Construction's twentieth-floor offices and stole a safe.
Afterward, the safe and wreckage of what appeared to be the intruding Labor were found in the ground-floor hall. The company's official seal was missing from the safe.
However, the bankbook reportedly stored alongside it remained. Why the culprit took only the seal is a mystery.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k195: Careless storage: Bankbook and seal stolen
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k196:
At around 9 p.m. today, fire broke out at Iberis Tower. At the same time, a Labor attacked Kunshiran Construction's twentieth-floor offices and stole a safe.
Afterward, the safe and wreckage of what appeared to be the intruding Labor were found in the ground-floor hall. Both the bankbook and official seal were missing.
Investigators say they provide access to the company's operating funds. Miyato Prefectural Police suspect the Labor pilot took them before fleeing.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k198:
At around 9 p.m. today, a man with a mohawk chased a couple around Iberis Tower's observation floor while shouting loudly.
Fire broke out before Miyato Prefectural Police arrived. The investigation is ongoing, and no significant further information was available.
Witnesses described the pursuer as "a tall, dark-complexioned man in a suit with a mohawk." Any connection to the fire is unknown.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k200:
At around 9:30 p.m. today, police received a report of two men carrying handguns on an office floor of Iberis Tower.
Earlier, a "tall, dark-complexioned man in a suit with a mohawk" had chased a couple around the observation floor. Miyato Prefectural Police believe the incidents involve the same person.
The caller, T, said, "They suddenly burst into the room shouting, as though searching for someone. I couldn't make out the hairstyle." Any connection to the fire remains unknown.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k201: A cat's cry in the high-rise
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k202:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a cat could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
According to T, the only pets kept there are hamsters, making a stray cat the most likely explanation.
"It sounded adorable, but I couldn't find it. It probably couldn't have survived all that smoke. I feel terrible," T lamented.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k203: A dog's bark in the high-rise
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k204:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a dog could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
According to T, the only pets kept there are hamsters, making a stray dog the most likely explanation.
"It sounded lively, but I couldn't find it. It probably couldn't have survived all that smoke. I feel terrible," T lamented.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k205: A morning call in the high-rise
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k206:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a rooster could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
According to T, the only pets kept there are hamsters, suggesting a wild rooster had wandered in.
"It sounded healthy, but I couldn't find it. It probably couldn't have survived all that smoke. I feel terrible," T lamented.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k207: A bush warbler sings in the high-rise
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k208:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a bush warbler could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
According to T, the only pets kept there are hamsters, suggesting a wild bird had wandered in.
"It had such a beautiful call, but I couldn't find it. It probably escaped through a window. What a strange experience," T said.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k209: A wolf living in the high-rise
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k210:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a wolf could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
No wolves are kept there, according to T. Some experts suggest it may have been the supposedly extinct Humanlike Building Wolf, a species able to live only in high-rises, attracting considerable interest.
"It was a very distinctive call, but I couldn't find it. It probably couldn't have survived all that smoke. I feel terrible," T lamented.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k211: Muto will keep letting them roll
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k212:
The Miyaspo! Fast Start Award, honoring the most memorable position player in the season's opening week, has gone to Kunshiran Elephants third baseman Muto, 27.
In the ninth inning against the Giraffes on April 2, he let a ground ball roll foul that would otherwise have ended the game in the opponents' favor. In the tenth, he hit a go-ahead two-run homer and led his team to victory.
The next day he went four-for-four with six RBIs, helping the Elephants take first place.
Learning of the award in a postgame interview, he joked about his questionable defense: "I'm delighted. It's my first award. I'll keep letting those difficult grounders roll past!"
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k213: An early cicada call: A record if true
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k214:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a tsukutsuku-boshi cicada could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
No insects are kept there, according to T. Experts say the earliest these cicadas normally sing in Miyato Prefecture is June. An April observation would be unprecedented, casting doubt on the report.
"There's no mistake. It was a tsukutsuku-boshi. I looked right away, but it stopped calling and I couldn't find it. It probably couldn't have survived all that smoke. I feel terrible," T lamented.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k216:
Today we introduce Dragon Pot, the state-of-the-art kettle from established commercial kitchenware maker Munemune!
Made entirely of thin ceramic, it features a proprietary Dragon Coating inside, patent pending. Like a wild animal's temper, it heats quickly and cools slowly!
And prepare to be amazed: being ceramic, it is microwave-safe. Naturally, it is dishwasher-safe too.
Open the handle and you will even find a power plug! That's right: it can boil water from an outlet, just like an electric kettle. The price? Only 19,800 yen, tax included! Don't miss this opportunity!
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k218:
It rarely comes up, but how long does an answering machine record? Twenty seconds? Thirty? That sounds about right for leaving a message. Yet industry leader Irodori Electric's latest landline phone, Mossy, allows an astonishing five seconds! Surely that is too short? We asked a representative why.
Us: "Hello. Why does Mossy record for only five seconds?"
Irodori: "We averaged the recorded messages on all the landline models we've sold. The average was 2.5 seconds, so we decided twice that would be plenty."
Us: "What?! You can barely say hello in 2.5 seconds!"
Irodori: "Our own research definitely found that average. To protect privacy, we measured only the duration, not the contents."
Us: "D-doesn't that include calls where people hang up without leaving a message...?"
Continued next issue.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k220:
T, a survivor of the Iberis Tower fire, says a Spiral Hercules chameleon could be heard in the twentieth-floor office during the blaze.
According to T, the only pets kept there are hamsters, suggesting a wild Spiral Hercules chameleon had wandered in.
"The call was very faint, but it was definitely a Spiral Hercules chameleon. I searched for a while, but perhaps it was camouflaged, because I couldn't find it. It probably couldn't have survived all that smoke. I feel terrible," T lamented.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k222:
"During an emergency, don't use an elevator even if it's running," says U, a public-relations representative for Irodori Electric.
"Disaster damage can distort equipment or cause malfunctions. Besides stopping, an elevator could cause unexpected accidents, including electric shocks."
During the earthquake off Miyato Prefecture on the 22nd of last month, which registered intensity 4, a man in Sakura Ward became trapped when the elevator he was using to evacuate stopped.
Take care not to use elevators during emergencies.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k224:
K escaped the Iberis Tower fire safely, but says one memory causes deep regret.
"I heard a voice from inside an elevator while evacuating. Someone might have been trapped. I was too panicked to pay attention then, but it was definitely a human voice! Someone was in there!"
No casualty figures have yet been announced. We hope whoever was trapped escaped unharmed...
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k226:
A security camera inside an Iberis Tower elevator retained footage from the fire.
Building staff did not recognize either of the two people shown, suggesting they were visitors.
This elevator was particularly badly affected by the fire, and neither person's safety has been confirmed.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k229:
A security camera inside an Iberis Tower elevator retained footage from the fire.
Building staff did not recognize either of the two people shown, suggesting they were visitors.
The raised hand of the person in the foreground seems to glow, prompting some to suggest that this person caused the fire. The elevator was particularly badly affected, and neither person's safety has been confirmed.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k231:
Environmental group NKX is fiercely protesting Kunshiran Construction's waterfront development.
The project would reclaim Miyato Prefecture's coast to build a market and apartment complexes. Work began this year but is currently suspended after an accident last month.
NKX has issued opposition that could be read as a threat: "Filling in this historic beach is outrageous. If this plan is forced through, we will use any means necessary to stop it."
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k233: The representative of environmental group NKX is missing. Our staff have spent several hours seeking comment on the Iberis Tower fire and the attack on Kunshiran Construction, but the group says it cannot respond without its leader. People connected to Kunshiran are speculating that the leader piloted the blue Labor that entered the tower.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k235:
Three suspicious people were seen on Iberis Tower's observation floor shortly before the fire.
Witness B says two were questioning a man in a leather jacket in detail, while he appeared to be demanding something in return.
Police believe they were discussing some kind of arrangement and are searching for all three as persons of interest.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k236:
Three suspicious people were seen on Iberis Tower's observation floor shortly before the fire.
Witness B says two appeared to be asking a man in a leather jacket for something, while he seemed to be making demands in return.
Police believe they were discussing some kind of arrangement and are searching for all three as persons of interest.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k237:
Three suspicious people were seen on Iberis Tower's observation floor shortly before the fire.
Witness B says two speaking with a man in a leather jacket looked as though they had seen something terrifying, while he appeared to be demanding something from them.
Police believe they were discussing some kind of arrangement and are searching for all three as persons of interest.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k238: Trio seen talking with blue Labor
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k239:
Witness accounts reveal that the Labor which entered Iberis Tower and stole a safe from Kunshiran Construction met three people on the twentieth floor.
One of the trio reportedly wore a checked jacket. Three suspicious people had also been seen on the observation floor before the fire, and police are investigating them as the same group.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k241:
A fire broke out early today at Iberis Tower in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, Miyato Prefecture. Floors 14 through 25 were damaged, and the blaze is thought to have started in a twentieth-floor office.
Miyato Prefectural Police found no ignition device, but signs of extreme force around the origin suggest an explosive or similar cause.
Building personnel say several people had seen an unfamiliar man walking around the twentieth floor in recent days. Investigators are examining whether he planted explosives.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k243:
Hearing that sandwiches at Cafe Iberis on the tower's observation floor sell out almost immediately every day, our Hungry Squad set out to investigate!

The top seller is the Iberis Tower Sandwich! Between bread as soft and springy as marshmallow lies... fried mochi?!
Served with freshly picked vegetables and tartar sauce made from rich eggs, this is no ordinary rice cake!
Its glutinous rice is kneaded with corn, red beans, and pumpkin, and inside this mochi, if that is still the right word, lurks creamy white sauce!
The whole thing is then coated in breadcrumbs and fried. One serving contains the carbohydrates of three rice balls: an astonishing 122 grams!
We queued just after opening, bought ours, and took a bite. Delicious!
If you want one, you may need to arrive before the cafe opens at 11 a.m.
The exquisite Ham and Egg Sandwich and Wagyu Steak Sandwich are also mouthwateringly good. Give them a try!
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k245:
Pippi, a hamster kept in an Iberis Tower office, survived the fire.
Pippi lived in a cage at the back of a desk's lowest drawer in the southeast office on the nineteenth floor. Flames reached the room, but evidence of a used extinguisher suggests someone happened to put out the fire around that desk.
Owner T said, "I want to thank them somehow. I abandoned Pippi, and I am truly, truly grateful to whoever saved her."
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k247:
The term "disaster looting" refers to theft amid the confusion of a fire or similar event. Iberis Tower's fire produced one such case.
S, who works on the nineteenth floor, expected to work late and had bought a Cherry Blossom Bento from the nearby Clover convenience store.
When the fire started, S evacuated, leaving the meal behind. After the flames were extinguished, S returned to find it missing from the desk.
"If someone was desperately hungry during the fire, I suppose it couldn't be helped. I just wish they'd left the money," S said.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k249:
Early today, a lightweight red cheongsam was stolen from Kunshiran Construction's nineteenth-floor office in Iberis Tower.
The garment was a new product from Nanyakanya. Miyato Prefectural Police are investigating its disappearance as theft.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k251:
Even as more young people report no dating experience or desire to marry, Iberis Tower, famous for its night views, was bustling with couples today.
Cinemas, amusement parks, and scenic viewpoints are classic date spots that many consider awkward to visit alone.
Asked why, people often voice exaggerated fears such as, "Couples will think I'm lonely." I understand feeling out of place. Yet this year, more active solo visitors are venturing everywhere, from karaoke and barbecue restaurants to cinemas and theme parks. Solo-outing expert T, with 24 years of experience, says:
"If you worry about everyone else, you'll never do anything you enjoy. Overthinking isn't good for you. Take charge of your own life and enjoy it."
A fair point. Perhaps going alone is less of a problem than we imagine.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k253:
Spring is the season of romance. Are you thinking of proposing?
In our survey last month, Iberis Tower ranked as Miyato Prefecture's most popular proposal spot!
Here are some reasons voters gave:

"I'd love a proposal with a beautiful night view." (A, office worker)
"It feels so special, I might say yes without thinking." (M, teacher)
"Dinner is expensive enough that I'd be proud to tell anyone." (P, homemaking assistant)
"The restrooms are clean." (I, food-service worker)

Was that helpful?
Men planning to take the next step this spring may wish to keep it in mind.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k255:
Emergencies may reveal a person's true nature.
H of Kunshiran Construction has become a hero after the recent fire. Working on the twenty-second floor, he opened a window as soon as the alarm sounded and urged everyone to evacuate.
Y, who escaped alongside him, said, "H is normally quiet and slightly below average at work, but he seemed like a different person. Without him, we would all have panicked. His voice was loud, his instructions precise, and everyone felt reassured enough to follow. I'd love a boss like him."
H had already gone home and could not be interviewed, but from these accounts he was certainly one of today's heroes.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k256: Man in white coat seen at fire
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k257:
Multiple witnesses reported seeing a man in a white coat at the fire scene.
He was reportedly wandering the twentieth floor, muttering something and seemingly unconcerned by the flames.
No such man was among those rescued. Police are examining the burned area.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k258: The scent of roasted sweet potatoes?
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k259:
Iberis Tower is attracting attention for smelling delicious.
When the fire began, second-floor dessert cafe Ibe Gelato was preparing its new Sweet Potato Sandwich, due to launch tomorrow.
Staff were steaming a large batch of sweet potatoes when the alarm sounded. They accidentally left the heat on while evacuating. Rather than burning, the potatoes roasted to a fluffy finish, filling the ground-level area with an appetizing aroma.
Unsure what to do with them all, the cafe is reportedly handing them out to the crowds gathered at the fire.
Ibe Gelato itself was undamaged and intends to reopen as soon as business is permitted. We eagerly await those sandwiches.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k261:
A volunteer effort was stopped at around 9:30 p.m. today during the Iberis Tower fire in Sakura Ward, Miyato City. Soji Kawaji, owner of nearby public bath Shime-no-Yu, proposed fighting the blaze with bathwater.
T, who owns the hardware store opposite, donated a large supply of buckets. Thirty local young people formed a hot-water bucket brigade.
Twenty volunteers each carried water roughly 15 meters toward the entrance, where ten others collected it and headed inside to fight the fire. Ten minutes after they began, the Fire Department arrived, warned that the operation was dangerous, and stopped it.
K, a Miyato University student who worked at the front, said:
"Knowing we might save someone, I just joined in. I took the inside job without thinking much, but the fire was above the fourteenth floor, so the ten of us at the front had an endless distance to cover. The buckets were heavy, but human lives weighed more. Having agreed to help, I wanted to do my best."
With T's permission, the volunteers took their buckets home.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k263:
At 8 p.m. today, underground idol group Mo Mo Mo Dynamite, known as Momomo, held a handshake event in Iberis Tower's twelfth-floor event hall.
Famous for exciting concerts featuring sparks and explosions, the group seemed set for a quieter event... until a real building fire broke out!
Staff struggled to evacuate fans, who replied, "It's part of the show. A little shaking won't surprise us."
Even Momomo, however, were startled by the fire alarm. When the idols themselves guided the evacuation, their fans obediently followed.
Their label, Reversible Records, has announced that it had no involvement whatsoever in the fire.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k265:
The glittering floor of Iberis Tower's observation deck is popular for its beauty, but a visitor reportedly slipped and fell there recently.
Some users say, "It's especially slippery on rainy days. Perhaps the deck should close when it rains." Cafe Iberis's owner objects: "We can't survive if we close whenever it rains. Carpet the entire floor first."
How will the tower's management respond?
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k266: Housework: A young man's real nightmare
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k267:
An old saying lists earthquakes, thunder, fire, and fathers as the things to fear. A young man rescued from Iberis Tower disagrees.
"Blackouts are worse than thunder. Fire's a disaster, but so's the housekeeping at my place. My life's a disaster. Fire and lightning don't matter unless they hit you. Earthquakes and Dad are always scary."
We later asked to visit his home for a story, but he refused. A pity.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k269:
Binoculars may show distant objects, but darkness generally limits their usefulness at night.
Recently, however, nighttime binoculars proved invaluable.
At around 10 p.m. on the 24th of last month, someone using Iberis Tower's binoculars happened to witness a robbery at a Clover convenience store in Sakura Ward. A prompt report brought Miyato Prefectural Police to the scene, resolving the incident without further trouble.
The witness, Ms. N, 28, had gone to the observation deck in despair after breaking up with her partner of five years.
"I was thinking I was about as useful as binoculars at night. Then I looked through them and saw someone wearing a helmet and carrying a knife enter the store. I called the police without thinking. And they solved it so quickly... Maybe I still have some value after all."
Our quick-thinking witness is reportedly looking for a new partner.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k271:
The Iberis Tower diet is becoming a craze.
On the south side, opposite the main entrance, stairs at the east and west corners let walkers loop continuously between the first and second floors.
Super diet adviser Amaneden spotted the opportunity and named the route Amane Road.
"Walking is excellent for health, but outdoors there are cars and traffic lights. Treadmills get boring. On Amane Road, the view changes and you never need to stop. Just as boredom sets in, there are stairs. If you get tired, you aren't stranded far from home. There's a clock, too. And now you have fellow dieters to keep you going," Amaneden says.
The southern side does have little foot traffic, apparently allowing exercise without disturbing others.
When we visited, though, people were marching like an army, or perhaps a factory line.
Interested? Why not visit Iberis Tower and see for yourself?
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k272: Set the scene for a memorable date
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k273:
Let us introduce the night view from Iberis Tower, one of the country's leading high-rise towers.
Its observation floor has glass walls all around, offering a 360-degree panorama of Sakura Ward's lights.
High-performance binoculars face every direction, letting you study distant sights without growing bored.
The sophisticated interior is equally impressive. You and your girlfriend are sure to fall under the spell of this peaceful, sparkling space.
Why not visit on your next day off?
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k274: A father's despair: "I never imagined this"
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k275:
Many people rescued from the Iberis Tower fire were visitors. Norio Nakagawa, 55, was among them.
His daughter Sakurako and her boyfriend had asked to meet him about getting married, and he was waiting for them at Cafe Iberis on the top floor.
When they failed to arrive and could not be reached, he happened to learn on his smartphone that Sky Garden Bridge, which they were supposed to cross, had collapsed.
"I opposed the marriage once. My wife died when Sakurako was still little... Today, I was actually going to give them my blessing. I never imagined anything like this..."
Sakurako's name is not currently among the confirmed survivors of the bridge collapse.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k276: Q on the Scene: The Suspicious Man
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k277:
This week, looking for something newsworthy, Q headed to Iberis Tower's observation floor!
With young office workers and dating couples everywhere, surely there would be an interesting story.
That cheerful visit ended with a fire, and our entire crew fled at once. But before that, we did approach someone intriguing!
Behind the stairs, a man was crouching and furtively talking on his phone. He looked so suspicious that nobody would go near him. Naturally, we decided to interview him.

Q: "Excuse me. Sorry to interrupt..."
Man: "Wh-what is it? Sorry, I'm on the phone..."
Q: "I'm Q. I write for a news website."
Man: "I'm on the phone. Give me a break."
Q: "Sneaking around behind the stairs on a call looks suspi... interesting. Could we talk?"
Man: "Hey, that's far too pushy. Who the hell are you?"
Q: "Is it a work call?"
Man: "Yes. There's an important operation coming up."
Q: "I see. Confidential business, then?"
Man: "Huh? Oh, yes. That's right. Confidential. Please go somewhere else."
Q: "Of course. Sorry! But 'a man who spends all his time on the phone behind the stairs' sounds interesting. May I write about you?"
Man: "W-write about me?!"
Q: "Yes. I couldn't hear the work details anyway, and I'll keep them private. Let me take a picture! Say cheese!"

...And there you have it: a man whose suspiciousness stayed at maximum right to the end. We couldn't get much detail, but it certainly sounds significant. I smell something shady! Until tomorrow! (Weekly Blog: Q on the Scene)
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k279:
A Miyato Prefecture nutrition seminar for working adults was held at Iberis Tower on the 3rd of this month.
Last month, the prefectural Health and Welfare Center surveyed 250 people working in the tower about their lunches.
It found that 204, approximately 82%, ate at the building's restaurants at least three times a week.
"Eating out offers easy access to hot, tasty meals, but frequent restaurant meals can mean too much fat and an unbalanced diet," said center dietitian Nashimura.
Nashimura explained nutrients commonly lacking in different types of restaurant meals, recommended foods to make up those gaps, and discussed things to watch for when dining out.
"I hope understanding nutrition properly will help everyone enjoy eating out and stay healthy."
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k281:
An organic vegetable harvest event will take place on the 24th of next month at the rooftop Iberis Garden in Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
As part of its greening initiative, the tower grows strawberries, cherry tomatoes, peas, and other produce on the roof, holding events when they are ready to harvest.
Reservations are required, and applications close tomorrow.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k283:
Results are in for the Ibe View photo contest. An award went to Toshiki Narakawa, 33, an office worker from Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
The contest celebrates the beauty of views from Iberis Tower.
Entries were accepted from last October through this month, attracting participants nationwide as well as within Miyato Prefecture.
Narakawa said, "I thought most people would photograph the view outside, so I deliberately chose an indoor perspective. The tower is wonderful, atmosphere and all."
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k285:
Fans of the globally acclaimed novel series The Tale of the Last Sword are increasingly visiting its real-world settings on so-called Last Sword pilgrimages.
Volume three was set in a remote, rarely visited forest. Since publication, fan numbers have gradually grown until some 10,000 people now arrive daily. The local community is actively welcoming them as part of a revitalization effort, even developing a version of the story's "house meat."
The series' undiminished popularity is extending well beyond fiction and making a major contribution to local economies.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k287:
Following today's giant-creature incidents in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, property prices in surrounding areas appear to be falling sharply.
The heavily damaged shopping and entertainment district has suffered extensive destruction of buildings and roads, with no clear recovery timetable. Owners are reportedly rushing to sell.
A local real-estate agent says some properties have fallen to around one-sixth of their previous prices.
common/lua/stage_204_news_text.luc.0:k289:
Property prices appear to be rising in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, where giant creatures appeared tonight.
Although damage is extensive and recovery prospects remain unclear, buyers are reportedly acquiring properties in anticipation of price increases during reconstruction and redevelopment.
A local real-estate agent says some properties have seen prices rise by approximately 160%.

common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k81: Mysterious black giant downs three attack jets!
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k82:
At around 10:30 p.m. today, an enormous, unidentified black life-form appeared at an intersection on Nanohana Street in Miyato City. It destroyed buildings and shot down three attack jets sent to intercept it.
Traffic was backed up at the time, with many people standing in the road. Heat rays from the creature and burning aircraft wreckage started fires, throwing the area into chaos. Police report 20 dead, ten with minor injuries, and five seriously injured, with the toll expected to rise.
Witness A said, "Everyone was desperate to get away from the giant. People ran while looking backward and crashed into cars, making the confusion worse. Police were there, but it was impossible to direct the crowd."
All three pilots have also been confirmed dead.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k83: Giant humanoid weapon appears, repels mysterious "Angel"
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k84:
The mysterious black life-form that appeared late tonight on Nanohana Street in Miyato City was repelled by a giant humanoid weapon that emerged from the roadway. The government has announced that the life-form will be called an "Angel."

The Angel had been destroying nearby buildings, but the humanoid weapon halted the spread of damage.
No detailed information about the weapon is currently available.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k86:
An attack by the Angel that appeared on Nanohana Street in Miyato City late tonight caused a parked tanker truck to explode, setting the surrounding area ablaze.
The Angel was fighting a giant humanoid weapon that emerged from the road, and a stray shot is believed to have hit the tanker. It carried gasoline and diesel destined for nearby filling stations. The driver and local residents had evacuated, and no casualties from this explosion have been reported.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k87: Missing girl returns safely to father
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k88:
At around 11 p.m. today, a girl who had gone missing in Miyato City appeared at her father's side and was taken into care. She reportedly had no obvious injuries.
She had become lost while searching for her older sister. Tonight, accompanied by that sister, she arrived at her father's room in Benibana Memorial Hospital. The girl seemed cheerful and was looking forward to going out with her sister. She is currently undergoing precautionary examinations at the hospital.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k90:
The government has yet to comment on the giant humanoid weapon that repelled the Angel late tonight.
The weapon emerged from a launch facility installed in the road, suggesting that the organization responsible for the roadway may know something about it.
Local residents say they knew the equipment was there, but had no idea what it was for.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k92:
General hospitals across Miyato City are struggling to treat people caught in collapsing buildings and explosions during tonight's giant-creature incidents.
More than 400 injuries are believed to be connected to the creatures. A shortage of doctors and nurses has left hospitals unable to keep up. The seriously injured, children, and older people are reportedly receiving priority treatment.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k94: Sewer work was underway near Nanohana Street in Miyato City, where the Angel appeared. With nearby roads and buildings severely damaged, there is currently no prospect of resuming it. The site manager said, "We want to restart as soon as we can confirm our workers will be safe. For residents' sake, we hope that will be as soon as possible."
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k96:
The Angel attack has crippled infrastructure around Nanohana Street in Miyato City. According to nearby convenience-store staff, some residents have been buying up food to prepare for an emergency.
Food has disappeared from local store shelves, while the continuing crisis prevents restocking.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k97: Giant weapon tears open wall of light
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k98:
Witness accounts from today's battle on Nanohana Street in Miyato City reveal that the Angel deployed something resembling a wall of light to block the giant humanoid weapon's attacks.
The barrier reportedly stopped strikes from the weapon's knife-like blade. The humanoid machine was then seen forcing the wall open with both hands and destroying it.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k99: Is giant curry the next craze?
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k100:
Giant creatures are the talk of the city, but "giant" is also becoming popular in the curry business.
The manager of a curry stand near the Nanohana Street intersection says, "Our extra-large servings are selling well lately. Just today, a couple came in and both ordered enormous curries."
The taste for all things giant may spread further yet.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k101: Crowds flee the Angel in their path
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k102:
People flee the enormous, mysterious life-form known as an Angel, which appeared on Nanohana Street in Miyato City late tonight.
Among them was a young person running desperately with a little girl on their back.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k103: A young person runs between the giants
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k104:
A scene from tonight's battle between the Angel and a giant humanoid weapon on Nanohana Street in Miyato City.
A young person attempted to run between the two as they faced one another.
The incident has caused deaths, injuries, and extensive damage to buildings and roads. There is no clear prospect of residents returning to normal life.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k105: Tips: Talk to the person always by your side
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k106:
Anyone can feel lost when faced with a difficult situation.
At times like that, talking to the person who's always with you might help you find a way forward.
Even if it doesn't solve the problem, it should give you a welcome change of pace!
Even someone who's usually curt will come to understand how you feel as you open up to each other.
When you're in trouble, try talking to your companions.

That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow Tips. (Satoko Midorikawa, KYOEI NEWS editorial team)
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k107: Photo: Cars crushed beneath giant feet
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k108:
Today, a sudden road collapse at Nanohana-Mokuren Junction in Miyato City caused a major traffic jam.
Many people had stepped out of their cars to look at the hole when the Angel suddenly descended.
They fled in panic, leaving their vehicles to be crushed one after another.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k110:
An attack by tonight's Angel caused a taxi parked near a convenience store at Nanohana-Mokuren Junction in Sakura Ward to explode and burn. The driver, who was browsing inside the store, escaped injury.
Taxi driver Akira Tsuge was reading a travel guide when he saw his taxi erupt in flames through the store window and instinctively looked to the heavens.
Speaking flatly, he said, "I suppose I spent too long reading there. The clerk looked young, and I took advantage of not getting told off to read two whole books. Just as I started a third, there was a commotion outside, then a blast, and suddenly my taxi was on fire. Maybe it would have survived if I'd stopped at two books."
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k111: Photo: Scars left on the city
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k112:
Nanohana Street in Miyato City after the Angel's appearance.
The city bears deep scars.
How long will recovery take, with ruined buildings and mountains of rubble still to clear?
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k113: Cat seeks development help in store
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k114:
A young person was seen receiving a game-development request from Toro at a convenience store at Nanohana-Mokuren Junction in Sakura Ward.
Toro reportedly asked for a health drink to deliver to the game's developers.
The store was sold out, so the young person obtained one elsewhere and handed it over.
If this brings Absolutely Safe City 2: Good Night one step closer to completion, that is welcome news indeed.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k115: Update: Angel's face splits in two
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k116:
New information has emerged about the Angel that attacked Nanohana-Mokuren Junction in Sakura Ward today.
Witnesses reportedly saw the part resembling its face split into two.
The pink light emitted from its palms was also extremely powerful, destroying attack jets, buildings, and cars in succession.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k117: Ad: Which watch will you wear this spring?
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k118:
Today we introduce three new watches.
First is the Zoyer Dohnen-Sohnen Premium, the finest wristwatch from luxury maker Zoyer. Simply wearing it conveys overwhelming elegance and enhances the wearer's presence.
Second is the Shimassy Millennium Chronograph from specialist diving-watch maker Shimassy. It features a unidirectional bezel and water resistance for saturation diving to 9,000 meters: a gem that can withstand even the pressure of the Mariana Trench.
Third is the Dekiranke After Five from Dekiranke, a company known for its many affordable watches.

Why not change your watch and freshen up your style this spring?
All the watches featured here can be obtained through this website's coin exchange.
I receive 3% of the wholesale price whenever you exchange for one, so please do consider it.
(By watch journalist Fumio Tokito)
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k119: Benibana Hospital stands firm amid crisis
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k120:
Benibana Memorial Hospital stands close to the scene of the battle between the Angel and the giant humanoid weapon.
Despite its proximity, many doctors and nurses have remained rather than evacuating. They continue treating incoming casualties and inpatients unable to leave.
Dr. Suzuki said, "I was off duty and at home when it happened, but knowing my colleagues were still there, I couldn't sit still. I came in. In a situation like this, I want to do whatever I can."
As though their dedication had been rewarded, the hospital has miraculously escaped damage.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k122:
"I'd finally saved enough to open. Why did it have to happen right outside my shop...?"
Saito, owner of Clover's Mokuren Street branch, spoke in despair.
The Angel descended onto Nanohana Street late tonight and headed south, destroying the city. A giant humanoid weapon then emerged from a launch facility on intersecting Mokuren Street, and the two fought directly in front of Saito's store.
The shop itself suffered no major damage, but surrounding roads and buildings were wrecked. Most residents have evacuated, leaving no customers, while damaged roads prevent regular deliveries.
Faced with such senseless misfortune, Saito says the anger has nowhere to go, leaving only emptiness.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k123: Photo: Roaring giant weapon silences Angel in melee
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k124:
This photograph captures the battle between the Angel and the giant humanoid weapon.
Witnesses say the weapon let out a beastlike cry, charged the black creature, tore open its wall of light, then straddled it and struck it repeatedly.
Initially, the weapon had tried to defeat the Angel with a massive firearm. Its sudden switch to primitive, feral combat silenced the Angel and terrified those watching.
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k125: Abandoned giant Gatling gun: no removal in sight
common/lua/stage_205_news_text.luc.0:k126:
The giant humanoid weapon that confronted the Angel on Nanohana Street in Miyato City late tonight fired an enormous Gatling gun, scattering hundreds of cartridge cases nearby.
Each case was about two meters long. Vehicles and nearby buildings were reportedly damaged by direct hits from them.
The gun itself now lies abandoned in the road, drawing residents' demands for its removal.
As large as a three-story building and extremely heavy, it is difficult to move even with heavy machinery. A contractor asked to dismantle it admitted, "We have absolutely no idea how."
Meanwhile, some members of the local Nanohana-Mokuren business association see potential in its size and striking appearance: "If it's going to stay there, why not turn it into a tourist attraction?"

common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k61: Survey ship sinks! Giant creature involved?
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k62:
Tonight, the survey ship Shibazakura sank 120 kilometers off the Taido Peninsula. The Meteorological Agency says seas were calm at the time. Witnesses reportedly saw a giant creature emerge from the water and destroy the ship in an instant. The Coast Guard is investigating the cause.

The Shibazakura was 210.0 meters long and 38.0 meters wide, with a top speed of 12 knots and capacity for 150 people. It was used mainly for marine-life research. Sources say its survey schedule had been extended at short notice that day to continue the investigation.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k64:
Dr. Fukazawa, leader of the expedition aboard the Shibazakura, earned her doctorate overseas at a young age and was regarded internationally as a promising marine biologist.
Three years ago, her paper, "The Relationship Between Heart Rate and Lifespan in Giant Seabed Organisms," was named the year's best by Poseidon Neptune, the field's most prestigious journal.
News of her death has prompted tributes from marine researchers around the world.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k66: Following the captain's death, his wife spoke through tears. "He had already reached retirement age. We were supposed to travel afterward, but they were short-staffed, so he agreed to another six months. He said this would be his final voyage and we'd definitely take that trip this time. I never imagined it would end like this..." We can only hope peaceful days return soon.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k67: Survey ship disaster leaves many missing
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k68: Many crew members and researchers remain missing after the disaster. Divers searching the wreck found that the ship had split in two and sunk to the seabed.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k70: The Coast Guard announced that the Shibazakura had rescued people adrift at sea shortly before it sank. Investigators say the captain had reported picking up two people in a small boat. The fate of the two rescued people remains unknown.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k72: Web writer Hideyasu Otsuka, 38, is being questioned by police because he was aboard the survey ship until shortly before it sank. His departure by helicopter just before the disaster reportedly prompted the questioning. Otsuka continues to insist, "I don't know anything. I'm innocent."
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k73: Crew member was a habitual shirker
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k74: One of the survey ship's crew had previously been reported for ignoring orders and avoiding work. A colleague who was not aboard that day said the crew member constantly hid and slacked off whenever the captain was not watching.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k75: A dream of captaining the world's seas ends
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k76:
Tetsuya Oda, first officer of the Shibazakura, had spoken of becoming a captain like Captain Katagiri and sailing the world's oceans. He disappeared at sea before realizing that dream.

His younger sister Harumi said, "We lost our parents early and grew up with relatives. Even in junior high, my brother worked part-time while giving everything to his studies and judo practice. He adored my son, who was born last year. No matter how hard things became, he was always persistent and cheerful. I still can't believe he's gone."
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k77: Helipad on board, but rescue came too late
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k78: The sunken Shibazakura had a helipad designed to allow emergency evacuation by helicopter. However, the ship sank so soon after the rescue call that the pad could not be used for that purpose.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k80: With more than 100 people missing, some have questioned whether the lifeboats or life jackets were defective. Regular inspections, however, had found no problems with either.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k82:
[Risa Kashiwagi: Let us work to end the world's conflicts]
There are still places where hatred drives people to fight. Competing interests and conflicting visions of justice fuel wars and battles even at this moment.
If so many people want peace, why do conflict and fighting persist?
In war zones around the world, I have seen many children living lives in which they cannot take tomorrow for granted. Meanwhile, I ask myself: what have I actually done to end these conflicts? In this series, I intend to explore actions we can all take toward peace.
(By journalist Risa Kashiwagi)
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k83: Ad: Wear a souvenir jacket this spring!
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k84:
Today's featured outfit is the souvenir jacket, a timeless symbol of youth.
If you want a fresh feeling this spring, try one on!

Souvenir jackets are available through this website's coin exchange. Don't miss them!
(By souvenir-jacket journalist Jantaro Sugai)
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k85: Young people enjoy changing clothes at sea
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k86:
A smartphone recovered from the seabed contained photographs of young people changing clothes aboard the Shibazakura.
The images suggest life on board was peaceful until shortly before the disaster.
common/lua/stage_206_news_text.luc.0:k88:
The creator of The Tale of the Last Sword, the series with passionate fans around the world, will hold a signing event in Miyato City.
A spokesperson says author O. R. James's busy schedule means the exact date and time are not yet set, but an announcement is expected soon. The venue will be designed to resemble the arena in volume four.
Previous signings have drawn queues of more than 1,000 people. Miyato City is surely about to be swept up in Last Sword fever.

common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k122:
How familiar are you with forklifts?
In this feature, we explore the appeal of these indispensable machines at ports and warehouses.
Unlike ordinary cars, forklifts steer with their rear wheels, making them far more maneuverable in tight spaces.
Their front-mounted forks can also lift containers and other cargo.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k124:
Nearby residents have reported fierce fighting between Labors at Asaseo Wharf today.
The Metropolitan Police Department announced that it is working to identify the machines and their owners while urgently deploying police Labors to bring the scene under control.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k125: Bullet marks found in Omoto Trading warehouse
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k126:
We have received information that multiple bullet marks were found inside an Omoto Trading warehouse in the city.
The Metropolitan Police Department says it will investigate the firearms' origins, reports of suspicious people, and any connection to the unidentified Labor seen that day.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k128:
A section of a city warehouse exploded late tonight, causing extensive damage nearby.
One Omoto Trading warehouse was completely destroyed by fire.
The cause remains unknown, but reports of a suspicious unidentified Labor at the same place and time suggest possible involvement.
Authorities say an investigation, including any causal link, is underway.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k130:
An unidentified Labor reportedly appeared at Asaseo Wharf in the city late tonight.
An officer piloting a Metropolitan Police Ingram who saw it said neither its model nor its affiliation could be identified.
Police are investigating its source, acquisition route, and developer.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k132:
An Ingram dispatched after reports of an unidentified black Labor at Asaseo Wharf has once again caused needless collateral damage.
It was not even fighting: while simply moving, it stumbled and struck a warehouse wall as though leaning against it.
Some residents say its pilot should start again with beginner training. Police continue to withhold comment.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k134:
We photographed a young worker sitting exhausted on a late-night wharf.
Our interview revealed that this was supposed to be a compensatory day off after three days spent almost continuously at work.
An urgent call from the company canceled that rest, leaving the worker as shown.

Time off is a worker's right, and such requests should normally be refused unless circumstances are exceptional. Reality is less straightforward.
Refusal can mean a worse performance review or reduced base pay.

The employer is currently under inspection, and the facts should emerge soon.
We can understand management's claim that understaffing creates unavoidable pressures.
But unreasonable working conditions ultimately make staffing shortages worse. That lesson must not be forgotten.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k136:
Security cameras in an Omoto Trading warehouse captured a young person apparently unconnected with the facility. Police are reportedly working to establish their identity.

The footage includes movements resembling searches of lockers and a sleeping employee's pockets. Police decided to release it because the person may be responsible for a recent rise in burglaries.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k137: Has awareness of danger fallen this far?
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k138:
We obtained footage of a young man watching Labors fight from a warehouse.
He is hardly alone. Young people are often seen casually watching dangerous situations as though they were films, or recording them on their phones.

Research suggests this can result from growing up without personally experiencing painful consequences.
For example, judging how close to stand to a campfire for warmth, or learning to watch for flames suddenly shifted by wind, comes through experience rather than abstract knowledge.
That embodied understanding then helps around gas stoves and matches at home.

Perhaps these spectators cannot imagine the danger of even brushing against a moving Labor, or of debris hurled from a battle.
For some, the realization may come only when they face an irreversible threat to their lives.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k139: Civilians at the controls? Woman rides shoulder
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k140:
We witnessed something extraordinary during the Labor battle at Asaseo Wharf.
After the black Labor defeated several Abrahams, one rose again with a woman riding on its shoulder.
Witnesses had earlier seen a young person enter its cockpit who apparently had no connection to the unit, strengthening suspicions that civilians were operating it.

We will continue investigating and report any developments.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k141: Civilians at the controls? Passenger on shoulder
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k142:
We witnessed something extraordinary during the Labor battle at Asaseo Wharf.
After the black Labor defeated several Abrahams, one rose again with a young person riding on its shoulder.
Witnesses had earlier seen a woman enter its cockpit who apparently had no connection to the unit, strengthening suspicions that civilians were operating it.

Her piloting also appeared highly skilled, suggesting considerable training.

We will continue investigating and report any developments.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k144:
A scene from Asaseo Wharf, where the black Labor appeared.
Despite the late hour, the worker pictured called his family and asked them to record the news.
He explained that if he appeared in the live helicopter coverage, he could boast about it to everyone.
Such self-promotion at others' expense is becoming more common each year, and cases escalating into actual incidents are increasing sharply.
We can only hope this worker's behavior goes no further.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k145: A wheelhouse filled with a sailor's dreams
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k146:
We gained access to the fishing-boat wheelhouse of Yahei Shinozaki, a seaman famed among those in the know.
Even a novice like me could feel his passion the moment I stepped inside.
Shinozaki entered the fishing trade at 16 and has devoted his life to the sea, spending most of it afloat.
Many of his achievements are widely known, but others are so unusual that they remain untold.
For those stories, look out for the forthcoming book, Yahei's Soul.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k148:
An outsider with an unusual fascination for forklifts reportedly visited Asaseo Wharf.
The person was apparently obsessed with driving one and eventually did so without permission.
The forklift was later abandoned at a nearby warehouse without damage. Its owner says there are currently no plans to report a theft.
Was this the work of an enthusiast seized by a midnight urge to drive a forklift?
If the mystery is ever solved, we will bring you an update.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k149: A bad employer, or a matter of perspective?
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k150:
Hajime Kariya, a pseudonym, was taking a break on the late-night wharf.
He works for a company widely described as exploitative. After refusing several interview requests, he finally spoke.
He does not personally consider his employer abusive.
His overtime admittedly exceeds legal limits, and his schedule is highly irregular.
Yet he says:
"The company told me the conditions before I joined. In exchange, I confirmed that my base pay would be higher and all overtime would be paid. They've kept that promise, so personally I have no problem."

He has two children, still in elementary school, and wants to save for university and lessons that will help their futures. His wife's poor health also influenced his choice of work.

With income inequality widening, he decided that conventional work would not support his family when white-collar success seemed out of reach.
At his current income, he expects to save enough to retire early and live comfortably with his wife once the children are independent. He says he enjoys his work.

Having said that, he returned to it.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k152:
An interview with Toshiya Okinaga, a pseudonym, who works at Asaseo Wharf, revealed shocking information.

His company allegedly handles a wide range of illegal goods, including weapons and drugs.
Using its transport expertise, contacts, and loopholes, it reportedly makes enormous profits.

I initially doubted the story, but seeing packages containing such goods left little room for disbelief.

When Okinaga first learned the truth, he hesitated but let the high pay tempt him into looking away.
Five years later, he earns tens of millions of yen annually, yet has decided he can no longer live this way.
Guilt over helping wrongdoing follows him constantly, and recently food has lost its taste.
Worse, the more the company values him, the more of his time it demands. He can barely see his family.

"It was never really about money. If I can spend time with my family, enough to meet our basic needs is all I want."
He lowered his head and sighed deeply.

We passed the information to police, and an investigation is already underway.
We will bring you exclusive updates as it progresses.

A month after the interview, I happened to meet Okinaga in town after he had quit.
He looked radiant, as though a weight had finally lifted.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k154:
This footage shows Abrahams on standby inside a warehouse.
Many security companies own several Labors like these.
But there are problems.
Large firms have the funds to acquire many machines, including the newest models.
Smaller and mid-sized firms cannot always do the same.
One regional security company I visited owned only a single, very old Labor.
Maintenance was frankly poor, and it seemed to serve mostly as a stationary presence.
(There are few civilian Labors in that region, so the need may also be limited.)

If the government used some of the hundreds of billions of yen it wastes annually to lend Labors regularly to security companies nationwide, perhaps daily life could become safer.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k155: A new business model: Traveling buyers
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k156:
A new business model has appeared in the buyback trade.
Instead of shops, identically dressed staff stand at various locations and buy virtually anything on the spot.
How they manage customer payments and store purchased goods remains a trade secret, so we could not obtain details. Even so, the approach feels fresh.

The conspicuous staff naturally draw attention. Social-media sites now even collect their locations, dramatically increasing public awareness.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k158:
Containers appear everywhere: ports, freight trains beside roads, airports, and beyond. Many readers have also seen rusting examples abandoned forlornly in scrapyards.

Their basic purpose is to group cargo and protect it from damage. But did you know they are increasingly being used in other ways?
Some people place a large container in the garden and convert it into a detached study. Others use refrigerated or freezer containers as food stores.
The possibilities keep expanding.
One owner added wheels and an engine so the whole container could be driven away in an emergency. Another installed oxygen-generating equipment and a private generator so a family of four could remain inside for a month during a flood.
Their simple shape and structure allow many modifications.
One particularly unusual project stacked containers and installed stairways to create a seven-story rental building.
How approval was obtained is unclear, but it is officially recognized as a building, and would-be tenants reportedly keep coming.

Why not explore the possibilities of containers yourself?
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k160:
How many people have looked out to sea with neither city lights nor moonlight?
Naturally, all is darkness; only the waves can be heard. I once experienced this on a beach. The blackness seemed to draw me in, and despite knowing the sand sloped gently beneath my feet, I was afraid even to step forward and touch the water.

New fish species continue to be discovered, reminding us how much of the sea remains unknown. Technology can reveal the seabed's contours by radar, yet we still do not truly know what lies below.

About two years ago, an unnamed country's advanced submarine vanished during deep-sea operations. An accident or foreign intervention was suspected. Eight months later, it was found underwater on the opposite side of the planet, its hull marked with spiral scars and its crew gone.
Initially, investigators thought cables had wrapped around the hull, caught on rocks, and scraped it as the submarine tried to escape. Then something resembling scales was found embedded in the wounds.
Whether an unknown deep-sea organism attacked remains unresolved.

For humanity, the sea is still unfathomable.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k161: An essential at sea: The lifebuoy
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k162:
Rescue lifebuoys are a mandatory part of a vessel's equipment.
They are there to save lives when an emergency strikes.

Increasingly, they can also be found at school pools and swimming beaches.
Some may think someone should simply swim out to help at a pool. But a drowning person may grab or struggle desperately, placing the rescuer in serious danger, especially without a lifeguard's training and experience.
A lifebuoy can reduce the risk of creating another casualty during rescue.

Of course, taking a lifesaving course and learning to throw a lifebuoy can better prepare you to save someone when it matters.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k164:
In this series for an incurable warehouse lover, I was able to tour a facility at Asaseo Wharf.
A few days later, the now-infamous incident occurred, and I was astonished to learn that illegal goods had been stored there.
My guide had been exceptionally kind, and I sensed nothing remotely underworld-like inside.
Perhaps the particular warehouse I visited held none of those goods.

The warehouse itself is innocent. My visits will continue.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k165: Not the toll of overwork after all...
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k166:
A worker slept face-down on a desk in a warehouse control room at Asaseo Wharf.
I initially investigated what looked like exhaustion from unreasonable overtime, only to discover otherwise.
He never worked overtime. He was simply sleep-deprived from gaming at home and napping wherever nobody watched him.

He had joined the company through his parents, who owned it. That connection reportedly left his supervisors struggling to reprimand him.
The recent incident exposed the company's involvement in wrongdoing.
Its employees scattered, and he was no exception.
Without parental backing, can he survive in the working world? Watch for a follow-up.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k168:
We obtained footage of what appears to be the bomb that triggered the warehouse explosion and fire at Asaseo Wharf.

The blast had been attributed to the Labor battle, but the warehouse now appears to have been deliberately destroyed.
Who did it, why, and for what purpose remain unknown.
I intend to continue pursuing this mystery.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k170:
An Abraham lies embedded in a warehouse, unable to move. It apparently tried to restrain the black Labor and was thrown back instead.
Another Abraham was reportedly knocked into the sea.

That the pilots escaped with minor injuries is a rare piece of good fortune.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k171: A useful bucket, even in a disaster?
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k172:
Buckets are remarkably versatile.
Besides carrying water, their original purpose, they often serve as outdoor ashtrays or small planters for ornamental plants.

A bucket lined with clothing and worn on the head can also serve as a makeshift helmet. Although weaker than a proper helmet, it may offer some protection against falling glass and small concrete fragments during a disaster.
This is only an improvised measure, of course. The point is that familiar objects can sometimes be put to unexpected use in an emergency.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k174:
A boat reported stolen was found abandoned at Asaseo Wharf.
Two men had allegedly taken it after threatening its owner with something resembling a gun. Police treated the case seriously and located it through a rapid search.

Witnesses also reported gunfire by the men near the wharf where it was abandoned. Police are working to identify and locate them.
We will report further developments as they arrive.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k176:
It is common knowledge that tides rise and fall because of the Moon's position and gravitational pull.
That gravity can act across 384,400 kilometers is extraordinary.

But have you heard a different theory now circulating?
It claims the Earth is hollow near its center and has two openings that alternately open and close. Air passing through them supposedly makes the planet expand and contract.
The alleged openings have reportedly already been located and are under investigation.

It sounds highly dubious. Do you believe it?
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k177: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 1
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k178:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. First: expanding its warehouse holdings at the wharf.

The company purchased ten more warehouses, bringing its share of the wharf's facilities to approximately 80%.
This has allowed it to handle even more cargo.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k179: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 2
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k180:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. Second: launching television shopping.

Omoto Trading has begun round-the-clock shopping broadcasts on its own nationwide television channel.
Prominent actors, actresses, and other celebrities appear according to the time slot and products, attracting viewers.
Each day, one item is also offered at the loss-leading price of just 1,000 yen. Ratings are soaring.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k181: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 3
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k182:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. Third: securing warehouses in every country.

Omoto Trading now owns warehouses in every country in the world.
Many logistics firms have facilities in the major nations, but this is the first to establish, purchase, and own warehouses everywhere, regardless of national size or development.

Asked whether this truly offered an advantage, the president responded with a smile.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k183: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 4
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k184:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. Fourth: satellite warehouses enter service.

An orbital warehouse that can receive cargo from Earth and dock entire containers, much like a space station, has finally begun operating.
Using its extensive personnel and assets, Omoto accomplished a project normally undertaken at national level.
Launch costs remain high, but the venture promises much: it requires no land and transports goods without conventional ships or trucks.
Dedicated launch sites have already been built near company warehouses around the world, and orders are gradually increasing.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k185: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 5
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k186:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. Fifth: more than 100 million employees.

Omoto's permanent workforce has finally exceeded 100 million.
Including part-time and casual staff, the total surpasses 250 million. Countries everywhere now welcome the company for providing so many jobs.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k187: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 6
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k188:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. Sixth: world leaders visit headquarters.

Between September and November last year, prime ministers from the world's major powers visited Omoto's headquarters to meet its president.
The discussions remain strictly confidential, but it was truly a worldwide pilgrimage to Omoto.
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k189: Omoto Trading's Top Ten Stories, Part 7
common/lua/stage_207_news_text.luc.0:k190:
This series presents last year's ten biggest stories from Omoto Trading, known for its many Asaseo Wharf warehouses and wide-ranging distribution business. Seventh: super-solar trucks enter service.

Omoto has begun operating large trucks powered entirely by its own solar technology. Proprietary panels atop their containers generate enough electricity in one minute to drive 10,000 kilometers, even under dark, cloudy, or rainy skies.
