Both were designers who competed at the highest level in every aspect of architecture. Experts still puzzle over such extraordinary versatility.

These toilets are valued at ten billion yen. His own admission helped place their price above that of his work.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k168:
Someone was seen rummaging through lockers in a workers' storeroom.
Disaster looting means stealing amid the confusion of a fire.
There was no fire here, but exploiting a crisis to search other people's belongings amounts to the same thing.

Perhaps the person sought supplies essential for survival, yet witnesses say their behavior suggested otherwise. From the moment they were seen on the observation deck, they seemed to wander unnecessarily and inspect everything.

The person remains unidentified, and it is unknown whether they survived.
If they did, we would like to hear what they were doing.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k169: Miyato Sky Tower left in ruins
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k170:
We obtained footage of what was once Miyato Sky Tower's upper observation level.
Formerly crowded with families by day and couples by night, it is now an unrecognizable, pitiful field of rubble.

Its lounge was once famous enough to appear in magazines as an ideal proposal spot.
Taller buildings and Sky Garden Bridge's restaurants had reduced its popularity, but a renovation about five years ago was drawing visitors back. Its loss is especially painful.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k171: Behind the Scenes at Work, Part 126
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k172:
Thanks to readers' support, our series exploring rarely seen workplaces reaches its 126th installment.
Today we look at the maintenance of Miyato Sky Tower.

The tower is repainted every four years. This is not only for appearance: preventing rust and repairing any corroded areas keeps it safe as well as beautiful.
Each repaint takes a year. Although scaffolding is used, workers sometimes move along narrow steel beams and paint by hand, making it highly dangerous.
Research into mechanization continues, but some workers are demanding it stop, saying, "We can't afford to lose our jobs."
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k173: The end of the world? A city burns
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k174:
Fires burn across the city in this footage.
It was reportedly taken from Miyato Sky Tower. Why someone filmed the view while Gyaos circled the tower is unknown.
Perhaps it was recorded accidentally.

Smartphones have certainly made it far more common for ordinary people to film events like journalists. Yet viewing a scene through a phone camera can seem to weaken their sense that it is real, leaving them unaware of immediate danger.
I hope as many people as possible understand that, once a life is lost, it is too late.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k176:
This footage shows a young person desperately running down Miyato Sky Tower's emergency stairs.
Gyaos fired beams in pursuit, destroying the staircase section by section.

Was it whim that kept the creature from aiming directly at its prey?
Many terrestrial animals torment prey in ways that look like play to us. Was this similar behavior?

In any event, the young person seems to have escaped.
We have also obtained footage of what followed, which we will present another time.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k178:
Our news helicopter captured a young person crossing a narrow steel beam without a safety line while Gyaos lurked nearby.
Several creatures seemed to be quarreling over the person as prey.

Their fighting sent occasional gusts across the beam, repeatedly making the person stagger and nearly fall.
A fall from dozens of meters above ground would be fatal.
Sadly, the risk of a Gyaos attack prevented our helicopter from approaching, leaving us only to watch.

Fortunately, the person appeared to reach the other side safely, but we could not follow their subsequent movements.
We hope they made it out alive.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k179: Kindness proves there is still hope
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k180:
We learned that someone shared adhesive bandages with strangers on Miyato Sky Tower's observation deck after it became a Gyaos nest.

In a crisis where you might be injured at any moment, caring for others and doing what you can is easy to praise but hard to practice. It is a noble act.
Hearing of similar kindness in many places surely warms more hearts than just mine.
The more people act this way, the more often we can rise again.
I resolved anew to remember that lesson and put it into action myself.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k182:
We met a woman whose partner went missing during the incident.
Many people share her situation. Some have been separated from their children or parents, as well as their partners.

Sadly, we are told few are reunited safely. Their belongings are often found later in Gyaos's regurgitated remains.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k184:
Witnesses reported seeing a gravely injured man. Even an untrained observer could tell that his wounds appeared fatal. Yet he fought to stay conscious, hoping to see his partner again, despite bleeding so heavily that he seemed moments from death. Perhaps his love for her kept him alive.

We do not know what became of him. We will continue investigating, hoping that they were safely reunited.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k185: Cruel or Helpless? A Rescue Helicopter That Never Came
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k186:
Survivors say many people stranded in Miyato Sky Tower begged a nearby rescue helicopter for help. They waved even when exhaustion made it hard to raise their arms, and shouted until their voices failed.

But the helicopter never began its rescue. Its crew tried repeatedly to approach, only to be kept away by Gyaos, whose flight capabilities far exceeded the helicopter's. Ultimately, the aircraft was shot down.

With hindsight, its inability to help is understandable. For those on the observation deck, however, it must have felt like being abandoned with hope dangling before their eyes. The government says it will discuss rescue procedures that also address this emotional distress.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k187: What Changes a Person? One Man's Transformation
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k188:
We obtained footage of Miyato Sky Tower's observation deck during the incident.

A man sits listlessly, hugging his knees, apparently resigned to his fate. Young people were seen racing down the emergency stairs, but not everyone can muster that courage.

Without powerful weapons, surrounded by Gyaos vastly stronger than themselves, few could have believed they would survive.

Fortunately, this man did. Perhaps the experience taught him how precious life is: once an unmotivated employee, he now works with an enthusiasm that astonishes his boss and colleagues. You never know what will change a person.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k189: A Desperate Situation on the Upper Observation Deck
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k190:
A person was spotted stranded in what had been the second level of Miyato Sky Tower's observation deck. Several Gyaos surrounded him. Waiting to become their meal and attempting an escape that might attract their attention seemed equally dangerous.

Sadly, we have not confirmed whether the man in this footage survived.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k192:
A man and woman gaze out from an observation deck. It looks ordinary enough, but this image was taken on the lower deck while Gyaos occupied Miyato Sky Tower.
While most people hid in terror, this couple calmly committed the night view to memory together. They seemed not to have abandoned hope, but to have decided firmly to cherish their remaining time rather than spend it in fear.
Everyone is different, including in what they value most during a crisis.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k194:
Among those stranded on the observation deck was the couple shown here. They reportedly spent the entire time lashing out at each other, each blaming the person they supposedly loved for bringing them to the tower and putting their lives at risk.

When the emergency stairwell opened, both rushed to escape. Witnesses say the man used the woman as a shield and survived, while she was carried off again by Gyaos and remains missing.

Legal action against him would be difficult. Still, learning that he moved in with another woman only days after surviving left this reporter profoundly saddened.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k195: A Door to Safety, Locked Shut in Hell
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k196:
Escape from Miyato Sky Tower's observation deck was delayed because the key to the emergency stairwell went missing and took time to recover.

The worker carrying it had fallen prey to Gyaos; he cannot be blamed. The real question is why there was no preparation for such an emergency. The simplest measure would have been a spare key kept elsewhere. The tower had only one, and its operators will surely face questions about that.

Modern sensors can assess structural damage. Such equipment could unlock doors automatically when damage indicates that people inside are in danger. Independent power, such as solar panels on an emergency circuit, should also be considered in case the main supply fails.

Cost so often prevents these measures from becoming reality, but action after lives have been lost comes too late. In these unpredictable times, this reporter believes we must do everything possible to save lives.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k198:
An unopened can of juice was found in Gyaos's regurgitated remains. Witnesses say a young person retrieved it and carried it away, leaving us wondering whether they actually drank it.
This reporter, at least, could never stomach it, however well sealed the can or thoroughly it was washed. We will keep looking for the person who took it and ask what happened. Stay tuned.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k199: Screams on the Lower Observation Deck
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k200:
Gyaos entered Miyato Sky Tower's lower observation deck, sending people fleeing in panic. Fortunately, the emergency stairwell opened shortly afterward, apparently keeping casualties there to a minimum.

To Gyaos, humans are merely food, no different from fish near the surface to a hunting bird. We understand the food chain, but as creatures usually on the predator's side, we seldom experience the terror of being hunted ourselves. In that situation, panic is only natural.

We sincerely hope no new predator appears.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k201: Caught on Camera: Terror on the Observation Deck
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k202:
We obtained footage of a woman fleeing Gyaos on what had been Miyato Sky Tower's upper observation deck. She apparently escaped this encounter, though she must have been terrified.
We have not confirmed whether she ultimately made it out alive.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k204:
Gyaos regurgitates things it cannot digest, a behavior also found in birds. In birds, these materials mainly include insect exoskeletons, bones, and feathers.

The process is also said to clean digestive organs such as the esophagus. Most people probably never think about it, but learning that even sparrows do this may have you watching birds more closely tomorrow.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k206:
Material regurgitated by birds is called a pellet. Pellets from birds that eat mice contain fur and bones, and may carry pathogens from their prey, so caution is needed. Curiosity is healthy, but it is important to understand the risks.

When collecting pellets, avoid touching them directly, and sterilize them afterward, for example in a microwave.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k207: A Melancholy Moment on the Observation Deck
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k208:
This footage shows a young person looking out from the crumbling observation deck. Were they imagining the tragedy ahead, or resolving to make it back to the ground alive? We cannot know what they were thinking as they watched the city lights.
They were later seen running down the emergency stairs, but their survival has not been confirmed.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k209: Water Leaks: A Record of the Scene
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k210:
This footage shows Miyato Sky Tower's lower observation deck while the tower served as a Gyaos nest. Was the broad puddle on the floor caused by a broken water pipe?
With the upper deck almost completely destroyed, much worse flooding or fires from electrical shorts would hardly have been surprising. Those who survived may have been fortunate amid the disaster.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k212:
Have you heard the rumor about the men's restroom on the lower observation deck?
Every Christmas Eve, at a particular time, one stall is occupied. Knock, and a voice, apparently the same man's each year, replies, "J-just a little longer..." At first no one thought much of it. After several years, suspicious staff used a stepladder to look over the partition. The stall was empty. They searched for a hidden microphone or some other sign of a prank, but found nothing.
Unfortunately, we cannot reveal the time. Another rumor says anyone who does mysteriously disappears.
Believe as much as you wish.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k214:
Here is a rumor about the women's restroom on Miyato Sky Tower's lower observation deck.
At no particular time or season, a woman looking in the mirror may suddenly see "someone" standing behind her. Afterward, she will constantly feel watched, until her mind begins to unravel.

One theory says it happens to women visiting on a date with men of a certain appearance, though there is no proof. If true, perhaps this "someone" is fixated on men who look that way, and haunts the woman out of jealousy, unable to forgive her for being his girlfriend.

Whether this is a ghost remains unknown. Believe as much as you wish.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k216:
Few visitors know about the work storeroom on Miyato Sky Tower's lower observation deck. It holds staff lockers and supplies, and ordinarily has little to do with the public. But have you heard its peculiar rumor?

On very rare occasions, a high school girl has been seen emerging from a locker. Witnesses suffer no particular misfortune, but many find it so strange that they wonder whether they hallucinated it.

A trick of the imagination, or a real girl inside a locker for some unknown reason? Believe as much as you wish.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k218:
Many readers will know the saying that couples who visit Miyato Sky Tower on their third date are certain to end up together.

Some suspect the operators invented it to attract customers, yet many couples apparently followed the advice successfully. Of course, those who later broke up may be less inclined to talk about it, creating that impression.
Believe as much as you wish.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k220:
Miyato Sky Tower has rumors about academic success as well as romance. Supposedly, if you pray for success facing north-northwest from the observation deck on January 8, you are certain to pass your exams. No statistics exist, but ever since the rumor spread, students and parents have lined up there each year.

Three people this reporter knows made the "tower pilgrimage" over the past two or three years, and all got into their first-choice schools. Another rumor says praying south-southeast that same day brings misfortune to whoever you picture, causing them to fail exams or job applications.
Believe as much as you wish.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k221: This Land, Then and Now: Part 1
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k222:
How many people know that Miyato Sky Tower stands on the former estate of renowned entrepreneur Heishiro Tadokoro?

He made his fortune in a single generation, launching business after business amid the chaos following the war. Numerous business books have been written about him. His estate once covered thirty times the area of the tower grounds. But what made him remarkable was that he did not simply display his wealth through lavish buildings and land. He built an entire town on his estate and offered it free to war orphans and people with nowhere to go. Those who wanted work received jobs and wages that helped them become independent. Once they could pay their own rent, they moved just outside his estate.

When everyone could support themselves, he donated all his land to the nation. It was later divided into the streets we know today. He is said to have retired deep in the mountains, though the truth is uncertain.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k223: This Land, Then and Now: Part 2
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k224:
Do you know what stood on the site of Miyato Sky Tower before the war?

When foreign culture was just beginning to spread and Western clothing remained uncommon, a large inn stood here. It was wooden, of course, but five stories tall: a high-rise for its time. Its owner enjoyed his wealth by using the inn as a base for all manner of wrongdoing.

Powerful connections in the police and government kept him beyond the law. Once war came, however, the imposing building became an obvious target. It was soon reduced to ashes, along with documents and evidence compromising influential figures.

No one helped the innkeeper after he lost everything. Instead, he was arrested and executed for illegal business activities, perhaps to silence him.

Who could have imagined that Heishiro Tadokoro, a man devoted to helping others, would later live on the same land?
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k225: This Land, Then and Now: Part 3
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k226:
Few people know that row houses stood on the site of Miyato Sky Tower some five hundred years ago.

Documents suggest their landlord was an ancestor of the later innkeeper. Unlike that descendant, however, generations of these landlords were respected for their kindness to tenants.

One reportedly fought officials to defend a tenant falsely accused of a crime. The landlord, tenants, and admiring townspeople barricaded themselves inside, holding off the authorities while other residents investigated. They found the true culprit, and the landlord escaped punishment.

The magistrate was so impressed by his character that he later sought his advice and help with difficult cases. It is disheartening to think such a fine man could have a villain for a descendant.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k227: This Land, Then and Now: Part 4
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k228:
About fifteen hundred years ago, the site of Miyato Sky Tower was a marketplace.

Most stalls were little more than cloth spread on the ground beneath simple roofs, much like festival stalls today. Coins were being made, but had not spread widely among ordinary people, who generally bartered rice, cloth, and other goods.

Perhaps thanks to convenient transport links, the market prospered, reaching as many as 954 stalls. Remarkably, torches burned here and there at night, allowing something like late-night trading.

Eventually, permanent houses began replacing the makeshift stalls, and the market gradually became a town.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k229: This Land, Then and Now: Part 5
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k230:
Did you know a settlement stood on the site of Miyato Sky Tower about three thousand years ago? Its remains were uncovered during construction, prompting a campaign to move the tower elsewhere.

Investigations suggest it housed thirty or forty people. It was surrounded by an unusually extensive barrier of fences, and an exceptionally tall lookout tower stood at its center.

There is no evidence of contact with neighboring settlements, suggesting isolation for some unknown reason. Perhaps the tower and heavy fencing protected inhabitants who feared attack. Or perhaps the settlement served as a prison.
Unfortunately, the truth remains unknown.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k232:
Broadcast towers nationwide are trying new ways to attract visitors now that a view from high above is no longer the draw it was when they opened.

One recent trend projects images onto observation-deck floors and windows at night. Seasonal designs help bring visitors back.

Some towers even project images onto their exteriors. Unlike replacing decorative lights, projection mapping requires no changes to the tower itself, which may help explain its popularity.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k234:
Some broadcast towers deliberately use physical decorations to attract visitors.

One has installed ornaments shaped like windmills, deer, and other objects. They not only light up but move through various mechanisms. Remarkably, the displays change by time of day as well as season, catering to families, couples, and other visitors. It hardly sounds profitable, but apparently a generous sponsor is footing the bill.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k236:
Did you know there is a broadcast tower that transforms?

It changes between five configurations according to the time of day, and even changes orientation with the seasons. During my visit, I saw its third and fourth forms. Frankly, I was amazed such enormous transformations were possible. I was assured that its structure and strength exceed all required standards, but it almost seemed enough to build the transforming robots of my childhood.

The movement was so smooth that even visitors on the observation deck seemed unlikely to feel sick. I enjoyed it immensely and recommend a visit.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k238:
One broadcast tower has a giant mascot clinging to it. The character, Rako-chan, is so large that even from far away you can see "something" attached to the tower.

Amazingly, Rako-chan moves up and down it every hour. On reaching the top, the mascot plays a sound announcing the time.

Friendly mascot or not, its enormous face appearing outside the observation deck frightens some children to tears. This reporter, however, was quietly impressed by the punctual movement and almost inaudible machinery.
common/lua/stage_210_2_news_text.luc.0:k240:
Did you know there is a broadcast tower that grows?

It gets a little taller every year. Of course, it does not grow naturally like bamboo. Roughly speaking, it is rebuilt at an astonishing speed each year to increase its height.

A taller tower needs more land, so the operators keep buying surrounding properties. Already over 530 meters tall, it will apparently continue growing. Perhaps one day visitors will gaze down at Earth from an observation deck beyond the stratosphere.

common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k104:
What time was it today...?
After abandoning Yuki, I found myself in darkness.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k106:
What time was it today...?
How long had I been in the darkness after abandoning Yuki? It felt like hours, even days, yet perhaps only seconds. I thought I would never see her again, but there she was before me! I had no idea what had happened, and I didn't care.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k107:
What time was it today...?
After abandoning Yuki, I found myself in darkness.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k108:
What time was it today...?
How long had I been in the darkness after abandoning Yuki? It felt like hours, even days, yet perhaps only seconds. I thought I would never see her again, but there she was before me! I had no idea what had happened, and none of it mattered.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k109: "I Should Have Helped": A Firefighter's Regret
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k110:
The giant creatures appearing across Miyato City have claimed many victims and devastated buildings and roads. Survivors, too, bear scars of many kinds.
Nito, a firefighter serving Sakura Ward, told us: "We were rescuing people from collapsed buildings. But the creatures fire beams without warning, and we were so cautious that we couldn't work effectively. Some people died before we reached them. Looking back, I should have gone in. If only I'd been a little calmer, a little braver..."
Rescue efforts continue throughout the city, but personnel remain in short supply.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k111: "I Didn't Want It to Catch Me": A Brother Attacked
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k112:
The giant creatures appearing across Miyato City have claimed many victims and devastated buildings and roads. Survivors, too, bear scars of many kinds.
Nakahara, a university student living near Suzuran Boulevard whose name we have changed, saw a flying monster attack his younger brother.
"My brother was in middle school. We saw a fire near the road and went to look. He ran ahead. The moment he reached the boulevard, a monster swooped down and crushed him."
The creature approached Nakahara with his brother clutched in its feet.
"I knew I had to help him. But I didn't want it to catch me. I ran without looking back, hid in a narrow alley, and stayed crouched there."
Many others in Miyato City share such emotional wounds.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k113: Celebrity Criticized Over "Then Saving Me Was Pointless"
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k114:
Entertainer Hiroo Akino faces criticism over a social-media post after fleeing the giant creature in Miyato City's Sakura Ward today. He has since apologized and deleted it.
Akino was with several agency staff members, who protected him as they escaped. Once safe, he realized one had not made it out and posted online. A reader urged him to go back and help. His reply drew outrage: "I can't go back into danger now. Besides, then saving me in the first place was pointless."
He has now written: "I was overwhelmed by unimaginable fear and made an inappropriate post. I am sorry."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k115: "If Only I'd Seen It Coming": A Bus Driver's Regret
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k116:
Flying monsters attacked many people on Miyato City's Suzuran Boulevard today. Miyato Bus organized emergency evacuations, saving numerous residents.
But the last bus due to leave was attacked. Its driver, Hamashima, whose name we have changed, miraculously survived.
"I was watching the monsters and trying to take as many people as possible. In the end, one pulled the bus over and attacked the passengers. If only I'd spotted it approaching sooner..."
He says he still cannot forget the creatures' cries as they attacked the bus.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k117: Councilor Condemned for "Nothing Could Be Done"
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k118:
Miyato City Councilor Seizo Koma has been criticized for saying "Nothing could be done under the circumstances" about today's giant-creature incident in Sakura Ward. Residents called his remark irresponsible given the many casualties.
Koma has since posted on his website: "I apologize for a statement that could be misunderstood. I did not mean to belittle the victims."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k120:
A giant creature's heat ray struck a downtown Miyato City building today where a celebrity talk was scheduled, killing 10 people and injuring 47, some seriously. The organizer disappeared after declaring, "It's not my responsibility."
Around 100 people had gathered at the Sakura Ward bookstore for a talk marking the publication of entertainer Miyuko Takagi's book. Police are investigating whether adequate evacuation routes were provided.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k121: "She's a Friend": Mitsuya Mizusaki on Chinami Fuyuhara
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k122:
Actor Mitsuya Mizusaki issued a statement through his agency after a photo magazine showed voice actress Chinami Fuyuhara leaving his apartment.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for the attention my private life has caused.
Chinami Fuyuhara is a close friend. We met when she offered me advice during my guest appearance in the animated film Sugochic Mirorin: The Eternal School Trip. The magazine's allegations are entirely untrue.
I again apologize to my fans and business partners for the trouble.
--------------------

Fuyuhara's agency responded: "We understand he is a close friend."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k123: "She's My Girlfriend": Mitsuya Mizusaki on Yuka Seno
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k124:
Actor Mitsuya Mizusaki issued a statement through his agency after a photo magazine showed actress Yuka Seno leaving his apartment.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for the attention my private life has caused.
Yuka Seno and I have grown close since working together on Milkshake Cop 2. I care deeply about her and consider her my girlfriend. The magazine exaggerated some details, but its account is largely true. We have no plans to marry yet. I hope you will kindly support us.
--------------------

Seno's agency responded: "We understand he is a close friend."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k125: "She's Like Family": Mitsuya Mizusaki on Miyuko Takagi
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k126:
Actor Mitsuya Mizusaki issued a statement through his agency after a photo magazine showed entertainer Miyuko Takagi leaving his apartment.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for the attention my private life has caused.
Miyuko Takagi grew up next door, and we spent our childhoods together. We lost touch after she moved away in high school, but recently met again by chance on The Great Bumbling Broadcast! and began keeping in contact. My feelings are not romantic; I still consider her family. The magazine's allegations are entirely untrue.
I again apologize to my fans and business partners for the trouble.
--------------------

Takagi's agency responded: "We leave her private life to her."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k127: "She's My Partner": Mitsuya Mizusaki on Shigeko Ryuzoji
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k128:
Actor Mitsuya Mizusaki issued a statement through his agency after a photo magazine showed screenwriter Shigeko Ryuzoji leaving his apartment.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for the attention my private life has caused.
Shigeko Ryuzoji and I first worked together on Homeless Vampire Kunio: Kunio's Family Contract. Ever since, she has been a trusted partner with whom I can speak freely. My feelings are not romantic, and the magazine's allegations are entirely untrue.
I again apologize to my fans and business partners for the trouble.
--------------------

Ryuzoji replied: "I'm flattered to be linked to such a handsome man. I hope the magazine's reporters will write something more imaginative next time! Ha ha."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k129: "I'm Probably Just Useful": Mizusaki on Rina Kizawa
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k130:
Actor Mitsuya Mizusaki issued a statement through his agency after a photo magazine showed model Rina Kizawa leaving his apartment.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for the attention my private life has caused.
Rina Kizawa and I met through a friend and have had meals together, but the magazine's allegations are untrue. Apart from meals, I have driven her to work, carried her shopping, booked her vacation hotels, and walked her pets. I don't think she has romantic feelings for me. She probably just finds me useful.
I again apologize to my fans and business partners for the trouble.
--------------------

Kizawa's agency responded: "We understand he is a close friend."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k131: "She Probably Feels Nothing": Mizusaki on Charline Kondo
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k132:
Actor Mitsuya Mizusaki issued a statement through his agency after a photo magazine showed artist Charline Kondo leaving his apartment.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for the attention my private life has caused.
Charline Kondo is an internationally renowned artist. Although we are the same age, I have admired her since art college. We became acquainted when she appeared on my radio show, Mitsuya Mizusaki's Sunset from Sunshine. I could never presume to imagine a romance, and I doubt she feels anything for me.
I again apologize to my fans and business partners for the trouble.
--------------------

Through her representative, Kondo replied: "I'm actually rather fond of him."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k133: Street Performer Brings Smiles to Evacuees
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k134:
Many Miyato City residents face an anxious night in shelters after today's giant-shadow incidents. Street performer Watanabe has been easing the tension with simple magic tricks and mime.
"At first I kept quiet. I thought people would scold me for performing during an emergency. Then I did a trick to comfort a little child, and suddenly a crowd had gathered..."
Evacuees thanked him for lifting their spirits. Watanabe says he is happy his skills could help.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k135: Young Cyclist's World Tour Inspires Supporters
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k136:
Jimmy Amber, 14, who is attempting to cycle around the world, visited Miyato City Hall yesterday. His challenge has attracted worldwide attention, with supporters organizing wherever he goes.
A member of Miyato City's Jimmy Support Club said: "His dedication always inspires me. I was thrilled to meet him and give him food and supplies."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k137: Beloved Baby Koala Peeks Out of Mother's Pouch
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k138:
A baby koala born at Miyato City Zoo has poked its head out of its mother's pouch. Like kangaroos, koalas are marsupials, and their young grow inside the pouch for six to seven months.
A devoted local fan excitedly told us: "Koalas are so precious. I've come every day since the baby was born. Finally seeing its face was a dream come true. I'll sleep well tonight."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k139: "I Wish I Could Touch It": Gold Exhibition Opens
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k140:
Miyato City Museum in Sumire Ward is hosting Gold Around the World, displaying goldwork from many countries. Its centerpiece is the World Gold Museum's Golden Cat, previously never loaned out: a solid-gold statue so realistic it could pass for a living animal.
Visitors say: "Even its fur looks real. I wish I could touch it. I want to take it home."
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k141: "It's Infuriating": Theft Rises Amid Miyato Crisis
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k142:
Cash and valuables are being stolen amid the chaos caused by today's giant creatures. Sakura Ward, where the giant alien first appeared, has been especially affected, with 20 cases reported to police.
One businessman returned from evacuation to find a painting worth 10 million yen missing from his office.
"Stealing during an unprecedented disaster, when we should all be helping each other, is infuriating. I want the culprit caught," he said.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k143: Evacuees Fear the Giants' Sudden Return
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k144:
Many Miyato City residents face an anxious night in shelters after today's giant-shadow incidents. The creatures have disappeared from some areas, but their sudden arrivals leave residents fearing another unexpected attack.
Others say there is no point worrying about something so unpredictable. Tension in the shelters is growing.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k146: The next Midnight Conversation welcomes actor Mitsuya Mizusaki and author Maku Kumazawa to discuss "I'd Still Rather Go Together." Mizusaki even shares his story of meeting an alien in middle school!
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k148: Next week's Weekly GZ features a reunion with Ryuji in the hit manga Tabletop Role-Playing Girlfriend. After leaving the group, he returns claiming, "I get lonely by myself, and I had nowhere else to go." But what is his real reason...?!
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k150:
The science-fiction epic Uneasy Allies on Neptune opens this weekend.
Story: Childhood friends Jin and Anel find themselves on opposing sides. Pursued by a common enemy, they board the same battleship on Neptune's seas. Neither trusts the other, but both decide to wait and see. They begin questioning a world where childhood friends must fight each other...
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k152:
Morio Shiba, whose last novel Klein's Pressure Points sold a million copies, returns with Convenience Store Magic Circle.
After accidentally summoning an evil demon, Shota gives it vague orders such as "Either is fine, but if you insist..." The flustered demon ends up helping the townspeople instead...
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k153: New Book: I Want to Say I'm Sorry
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k154: The latest book by rising reportage writer Kanji Sankai gathers interviews with people from all walks of life who want to apologize. From murderers to elementary school children who fought with friends, its many stories stir a wide range of emotions.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k155: Aya Suzumura's New Apology Song Is a Hit
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k156: Rising singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura's new single, Say Hello Like Always, Then Tell You I'm Sorry, has sold 500,000 CDs. Its tale of conflict and reconciliation after a petty quarrel with a close friend has touched listeners of all ages. Youthful Belly Roll, the drama using it as its theme, continues to enjoy high ratings.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k157: Aya Suzumura's Reunion Song Is a Hit
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k158: Rising singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura's new single, Take Your Hand and Celebrate Our Reunion, has sold 500,000 CDs. Its story of estranged friends meeting by chance and renewing their bond has touched listeners of all ages. Unidentified Squadron Yuman, the special-effects hero series using it as its theme, continues to enjoy high ratings.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k159: Aya Suzumura's Tearful New Song Is a Hit
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k160: Rising singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura's new single, Tears of Joy That Won't Stop, has sold 500,000 CDs. Its depiction of a woman's struggle to confess her unrequited love has touched listeners of all ages. Teacup Love, the drama using it as its theme, continues to enjoy high ratings.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k161: Aya Suzumura's Hold You and Never Let Go Is a Hit
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k162: Rising singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura's new single, Hold You and Never Let Go, has sold 500,000 CDs. Its direct expression of love has touched listeners of all ages. Love Country, the film using it as its theme, is also a box-office hit.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k163: Aya Suzumura's Kneeling Apology Song Is a Hit
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k164: Rising singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura's new single, I'll Kneel and Beg Forgiveness, has sold 500,000 CDs. Its apology for forgetting a lover's birthday has touched listeners of all ages. Mari Hiraya Won't Forgive You on Your Knees, the anime using it as its theme, continues to enjoy high ratings.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k165: Aya Suzumura's Desperate Embrace Song Is a Hit
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k166: Rising singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura's new single, Hold You Tight and Kiss You Endlessly, has sold 500,000 CDs. It follows a boy's coming of age as he journeys through a ruined world searching for the girl he adores, who has been abducted. The song has touched listeners of all ages. Written as the theme for Mars the Railway Collector, it accompanies an anime that continues to enjoy high ratings.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k167: Rap Version of Mai Iida's Our Sky Released
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k168:
A rap version of singer-songwriter Mai Iida's Our Sky has been released. The arrangement adds a new dimension to the song's world.

Our Sky is available from Granzella Music at http://granzellamusic.jp/.
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k169: Fried Chicken Minister Nears 100 Billion Sales
common/lua/stage_210_3_news_text.luc.0:k170: Clover, the convenience-store chain centered on Miyato City, announced on its official social-media account that its Fried Chicken Minister range is expected to reach 100 billion total sales soon. The popular line is known for its wide variety of flavors.

common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k107: Flying monsters swarm Miyato City's office district
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k108:
A large number of flying monsters descended on Suzuran Boulevard in Miyato City.
Highly aggressive toward humans, they attacked and carried off people in the office district, plunging it into chaos in moments.
They appear to have left the boulevard for now, but similar attacks are reportedly occurring in other districts.
Hundreds are believed injured on Suzuran Boulevard alone, with around a hundred missing.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k110:
The government has announced that the flying monsters seen near Suzuran Boulevard in Miyato City will be called "Gyaos."
Associate Professor N of S University, who is collecting eyewitness accounts, says they grow far faster than any known organism. They have been confirmed to attack and eat people, but other aspects of their biology remain unknown.
The government is urgently seeking their nesting site. Professor N says, "If we find the nest, the people carried away may be there."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k112:
Police received reports of gunfire near Suzuran Boulevard in Miyato City.
Witnesses say a menacing man threatened two young people with a gun.
The pair then escaped in the confusion when flying monsters appeared, while the armed man was carried away by one.

Police increasingly suspect organized-crime involvement, but with strange incidents occurring everywhere, sufficient personnel for an investigation may be unavailable.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k114:
Gyaos appearing at a Suzuran Boulevard intersection startled motorists and caused traffic collisions. At least 21 vehicles have been confirmed involved.
Many Gyaos were flying along the boulevard at the time. Drivers approaching from connecting roads suddenly encountered enormous bodies crossing directly in front of them.
Numerous other accidents also occurred along Suzuran Boulevard, and police continue assessing the damage.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k116: PANSIE Department Store, at the center of Suzuran Street in Miyato City, has suffered devastating damage from Gyaos. Most windows are broken, and connecting walkways and the atrium have sustained major structural damage. A spokesperson said, "We are assessing the damage. There is no timetable for reopening."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k118:
Amid the chaos caused by Gyaos on Suzuran Boulevard in Miyato City, a man reportedly allowed himself to be carried away to rescue an abducted woman.

Witnesses say two young people escaped an overturned bus and were attacked by Gyaos. The woman pushed the man aside and was captured in his place. He then climbed onto the bus, spread his arms, and let himself be taken to follow her.
We can only pray that these brave young people are safe.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k119: A new kind of bank-transfer scam
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k120:
A new bank-transfer scam is attracting attention. Callers say things like, "Grandma, it's me! Let me do something nice for you," then return twice the amount the victim transfers.
The damage does not stop there. Their further misdeeds reportedly include sending expensive bedding and installing handrails throughout every room of the victim's home.
Police are using every available resource to find the culprits.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k122:
A woman was seen being attacked and carried away by Gyaos near PANSIE Department Store in Miyato City.
Witnesses say she was seized after rushing out through the entrance. Many others have also been carried off.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k124: A photograph shows one of the Gyaos in Miyato City carrying a person away. A man in red clothing can be seen clutched in its feet. The creature reportedly flew east afterward.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k126:
One of the Gyaos in Miyato City was seen colliding with a building.
It reportedly lost its balance and fell to the ground.
Associate Professor N of S University said, "It may have been distracted by its human prey."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k128:
Gyaos destroyed a sign cherished as a symbol of Suzuran Boulevard.
Its fame as a meeting spot has prompted an outpouring of sadness.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k129: A cruel twist: Sign blocks entrance
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k130:
The famous sign destroyed by Gyaos landed in a place too cruelly unfortunate to call a miracle.
It fell across the entrance to PANSIE's west building,
the very doorway people had been using to seek shelter moments earlier.
Experts believe the day's strong winds carried the broken sign into that position.
The impact cracked the ground and severely bent the sign itself.
Whether anyone was nearby is still unknown, but someone trapped beneath it would have had virtually no chance of survival...
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k132:
Gyaos destroyed a connecting walkway at PANSIE Department Store in Miyato City.
A traffic accident had stranded more than a dozen people on the road below. They were reportedly caught in the collapse when Gyaos attacked. The full extent of casualties remains under investigation.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k133: A chance reunion amid the Gyaos crisis
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k134:
Two people experienced a remarkable reunion during Miyato City's Gyaos crisis.
Office worker Yoko, 28, a pseudonym, seriously injured her leg while fleeing. She reached PANSIE Department Store, but the injury worsened until she could no longer walk. Former doctor Shinichi, 38, also a pseudonym, arrived while escaping the creatures and gave her first aid. As they talked, they discovered to their astonishment that they were long-separated siblings. Shinichi said, "I'm glad I could treat her in those conditions. But to discover she was my sister... Thinking we might never have met without Gyaos leaves me with mixed feelings."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k135: Gyaos attacks people fleeing atop tankers
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k136: Numerous traffic accidents during Miyato City's Gyaos crisis made roads impassable for pedestrians. Some climbed onto tanker trucks to get through. E, who watched from an apartment on Suzuran Boulevard, said, "Being so high up made some of them easy for the flying monsters to spot and carry away. I couldn't even call out a warning. There was nothing I could do..."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k138:
A Miyato Bus driver reportedly helped evacuate residents during the Gyaos attack.
The driver and police at the scene guided people onto the bus, allowing several dozen to escape Suzuran Boulevard. Driver Miyata choked back emotion: "I was acting on instinct. But thinking of the people we couldn't save..."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k140:
Built by Kunshiran Construction, Kunshiran Bridge is one of Suzuran Boulevard's essential date spots.
The beautiful nighttime reflections on the water are said to soothe office workers exhausted by their jobs.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k142:
PANSIE Department Store is holding a clearance sale!
Up to 50% off throughout the store! Don't miss this chance to visit!
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k143: A Reporter's View: Covering the Gyaos attack
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k144: While reporting on Miyato City's Gyaos attack, I saw young people photographing the creatures assaulting victims. The pictures will probably appear on social media. Showing the horror of the incident has value, but thinking of those under attack left me feeling deeply helpless.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k146: Gyaos entered PANSIE Department Store's east building in Miyato City, breaking through the atrium ceiling and attacking people sheltering inside. Associate Professor N of S University said, "Its persistence in pursuing prey is extraordinary compared with known animals. It may also possess an exceptional sense of smell."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k147: The History of Suzuran Boulevard, Part 1
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k148:
Suzuran Boulevard was reportedly an important transport route long ago, when few settlements could be called towns.

Rugged mountains and supposedly bottomless swamps surrounded the area, leaving this the only flat, safe passage.

Eventually, land along it was developed, and houses appeared one after another.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k149: The History of Suzuran Boulevard, Part 2
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k150:
Documents record that Suzuran Boulevard prospered as a post town around 600 years ago.

The land was apparently poor for farming, but valuable as a stopping point between other post towns.
Entertainment venues sprang up for travelers, creating something like a modern nightlife district.

In retrospect, this may have been the prototype for today's boulevard.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k151: The History of Suzuran Boulevard, Part 3
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k152:
When Western culture began arriving, modernization spread outward from Suzuran Street.

Wooden homes were rapidly replaced by Western-style, mortar-built structures.
Buildings along the street grew larger as well.

Modernization took hold unusually quickly, making the area one of the country's most advanced towns and attracting even more visitors.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k153: The History of Suzuran Boulevard, Part 4
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k154:
Even as fear of approaching war spread nationwide, Suzuran Boulevard's entertainment district flourished.
Generous bribes apparently kept official scrutiny away, allowing businesses to operate freely.

Visitors reportedly described the district as paradise.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k155: The History of Suzuran Boulevard, Part 5
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k156:
Once war began, even bribes could no longer protect the district. With luxury condemned as the enemy, Suzuran Street seemed to decline.
Yet although entertainment venues officially closed, many apparently continued operating behind the scenes.

Ordinary customers could no longer visit, but senior military officers provided a profitable replacement.
The street's people had always been resourceful.
Sadly, aerial bombing destroyed most buildings.
For the first time, Suzuran Street lost its sparkle.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k157: The History of Suzuran Boulevard, Part 6
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k158:
After the war, the area rebuilt at astonishing speed.
The buildings were gone, but residents had apparently moved their accumulated funds elsewhere, leaving ample money for reconstruction.
The foundations of today's streetscape emerged almost overnight.
It was also during this recovery that the name "Suzuran Boulevard" was adopted.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k160:
Mysterious letters on manhole covers

Nobody knows when it began, but manhole covers on Suzuran Boulevard reportedly bear different letters: "ro" on one, "ka" on another.
The official explanation is that patterns merely resemble letters. Still, it is curious that supposedly mass-produced covers each have subtly different designs.

One theory says reading them in a particular order produces a code revealing treasure buried by a shop that once stood on the boulevard.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k162:
The night the gas lamps flared

When street lighting still used gas, all the lamps on Suzuran Boulevard suddenly burned more fiercely at once.
An investigation found nothing wrong, and why only this area was affected remains a mystery.

The phenomenon occurred twice. On both occasions, a major earthquake struck somewhere the following day, prompting rumors that it was a localized warning sign.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k164:
The wandering midnight shadow

Just before dawn, when even this nightlife district empties, a wavering shadow is sometimes seen roaming the streets.
Anyone who sees it is said to die, or lose someone close, within three days.

Two or three people reportedly see it each year, followed by the death of the witness or a relative.
However, the misfortune can supposedly be avoided by deliberately colliding with the shadow.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k166:
The driverless car

It is easy to overlook passing traffic, but witnesses occasionally report an unoccupied car on Suzuran Boulevard.
It is not one of the autonomous vehicles currently under development.
It is clearly an older passenger car with lightly tinted windows.

Seeing it the day before an exam or business negotiation supposedly brings success.
Perhaps this car really does help things move along smoothly.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k168:
Streetlights that all go dark

About five years ago, only Suzuran Boulevard's streetlights went out simultaneously.
It was not a local power failure, and the cause remains unknown.

When a major earthquake struck elsewhere the next day, residents recalled the past: a similar event had occurred in the gas-lamp era.

Locals say, "If the streetlights all go out again, a major earthquake will definitely happen somewhere the next day."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k170:
A voice calling from behind

Many people walking Suzuran Boulevard report hearing a child call from behind, only to turn and find nobody there.

A boy's voice supposedly foretells misfortune; a girl's, happiness.
It is a fifty-fifty gamble, but some young people hoping for romantic success repeatedly walk the boulevard, deliberately taking their chances.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k172:
The seventh mystery: An answer that kills

The seventh of Suzuran Boulevard's mysteries is actually unknown.
There may be a clue somewhere, or there may not.

It is said that anyone who learns it dies at that instant.
Several past investigators have indeed died suddenly, without chronic illness or an accident.
Human curiosity reaches everywhere, but perhaps some things are better left unknown.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k173: The Tale of the Last Sword becomes a game
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k174: A game adaptation has been announced for The Tale of the Last Sword, the hit novel series with a billion copies sold worldwide. Details remain undecided, but it will be an action-adventure allowing players to become part of its world. Preorder bonuses include figures of Troll and Isabella, plus a full-size soft-vinyl Last Sword. Any Last Sworder will want them.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k175:
Amid the chaos caused by Gyaos on Suzuran Boulevard in Miyato City, a woman reportedly allowed herself to be carried away to rescue another abducted woman.

Witnesses say the two escaped an overturned bus and were attacked by Gyaos. One woman pushed the other aside and was captured in her place. The second then climbed onto the bus, spread her arms, and let herself be taken to follow her.
We can only pray that these brave young people are safe.
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k177:
Miyato Cinema is expected to close as early as next month. The city's oldest movie theater has operated for 70 years.
Today's giant-creature incidents badly damaged the surrounding area, making continued business difficult. The site may also be sold in anticipation of redevelopment during recovery. Former owner Shirai was known for passionate management and overcame repeated threats of closure, but ownership changed recently, apparently bringing a new direction.
One resident said, "I saw summer-holiday movies there as a child, and had my first date with my girlfriend there too. I'll be sad to lose it."
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k178: Miyato Cinema becomes a recovery hub
common/lua/stage_210_news_text.luc.0:k179:
Miyato Cinema is drawing attention as a focal point for the city's recovery. Its oldest theater has operated for 70 years.
Although tonight's giant-creature incidents caused severe damage across Miyato, the cinema has opened its doors to people who lost their homes and is screening films free of charge, offering comfort amid despair. Evacuee Araya said, "A giant destroyed my home. I heard this place was open and came here. I'm happy I finally got to see Sugochic Mirorin: The Missing Lunch Break, which I'd missed."

common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k66: Police responded to several calls from neighbors who heard screams inside the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute late at night. Officers found the remaining researchers uniformly exhausted and unable to answer questions. They will wait for their recovery before interviewing them again.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k68:
The National Cosmic Ray Research Institute has been studying the purple lightning frequently seen over Japan in recent days. It suggests that material drifting in space may be breaking through parts of the Van Allen belts and entering the atmosphere.
Deputy Director Dr. Sasaki says the basic mechanism is becoming clear, but the substance itself remains under investigation. Private research organizations and local IT companies are assisting.
With some people fearing effects on human health, identification of the material and its cause cannot come soon enough.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k69: Strange Intruder Seen at Research Institute
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k70: Someone claiming to be a National Cosmic Ray Research Institute researcher submitted a photograph of a mysterious late-night intruder. According to the poster, it carried a large ray gun, had a striped body, and teleported while occasionally making a strange "Da-da!" cry.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k71: A Research Leader with an Unusual Past
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k72:
Mitsuki Sawada, chief researcher at the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute, has an unusual background: she once wrote video-game scenarios.
She began visiting a game company and writing while still at university, contributing to several visual-novel adventure games about platonic romance.
Sawada smiled warmly as she recalled her student days.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k73: Researchers Threaten Walkout over Lack of Shop
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k74:
Researchers at the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute have told management they will temporarily stop work in protest at the absence of a shop or convenience store.
"It's awful that we can't even get a rice ball when research makes us hungry," one complained.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k76: Two staff members were rescued from a storeroom designed to block cosmic rays and electromagnetic waves. Witnesses confirmed that the mysterious intruder could disappear and reappear elsewhere, but for some reason it could not enter the room where the pair hid. They narrowly escaped death.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k78: Police discovered that security cameras at the Cosmic Ray Research Institute recorded the mysterious intruder. The footage also shows a machine it apparently brought with it, and the intruder operating the device.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k80: Investigators say they have not confirmed the safety of Sasaki, deputy director of the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute. One of Japan's leading scientists, he has published numerous papers in the American science journal Leeka.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k81: Server Failure Leaves Institute Cut Off
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k82: Some believe the mysterious intruder's objective was to seize the Cosmic Ray Research Institute itself. Internal communication relies entirely on computers, while shielded rooms block mobile phones. Supporting this theory, surviving researchers say they lost all means of communication when the server's power went down.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k84: The incident has also exposed problems with the institute's evacuation routes. One escaped researcher said: "The second-floor corridor was piled with equipment. We couldn't get through." Clearing an escape route took valuable time.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k85: Cat Seeks Game-Development Help at Institute
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k86:
A young person was seen receiving a game-development request from Toro at the Cosmic Ray Research Institute. Toro reportedly asked for motion data needed for his project.
If this brings Absolutely Safe City 2: Good Night a step closer to completion, that is welcome news.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k88: At least three mysterious beings are believed to have attacked the Cosmic Ray Research Institute. Witnesses reported three different faces. Investigators are continuing their inquiries on the assumption that multiple intruders occupied the facility.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k90:
Staff at the Cosmic Ray Research Institute play shogi during breaks. Deputy Director Sasaki favors the Static Rook Anaguma, while Chief Researcher Sawada prefers the Fourth-File Rook. Everyone studies their own strategies enthusiastically, and the annual Institute Cup is a highlight.

Sawada said: "With Deputy Director Sasaki gone, we sadly have no one left who plays Static Rook Anaguma. I want to keep promoting shogi here so we never forget his enthusiasm."
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k92:
The National Cosmic Ray Research Institute is internationally renowned for its cutting-edge work. Brilliant minds from around the world gather there to conduct advanced research every day.

Yet one thing is baffling: it has no toilets. Staff jokingly blame Deputy Director Sasaki, who commissioned the building, for forgetting them, or suggest they were sacrificed to maximize research space while using every inch permitted by building-coverage limits.
Employees must leave the institute to use a restroom elsewhere.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k93: Rock Singer Announces Last Sword Song
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k94:
Spit Will, vocalist of the popular rock band Spot Wail, has announced Eiska, a song inspired by The Tale of the Last Sword.
"I love the novels, so I'm thrilled to write this. I'll make something incredibly cool that even devoted Last Sworders will approve of!" he said. Fans can expect a must-hear track.
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k95: More Facility Problems Exposed at Research Institute
common/lua/stage_211_news_text.luc.0:k96:
The recent attack on the Cosmic Ray Research Institute has exposed numerous problems. Following an orange-juice theft apparently prompted by the lack of vending machines, it has emerged that the facility lacks water and heating needed to keep researchers healthy.
During this reporter's visit, there were no taps providing drinking water, only a large ceiling ventilation unit. Researcher Hayami was emphatic: "Having nowhere to warm up is a matter of life and death."

common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k75: Red Angel Appears, Slicing Buildings Apart
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k76:
An enormous, unidentified red life-form appeared in Miyato City's Sumire Ward around 3 a.m. today. It cut through buildings one after another, causing extensive damage. Its identity and purpose remain completely unknown.
The government announced it will call the red creature an "Angel," as it did the black life-form that appeared on Nanohana Street today.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k77: Radio Concert Keeps People Connected in Crisis
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k78:
Around 2:30 a.m. today, amid extraordinary incidents across the region, Radio Sky Garden, or RSG, held a fans-only concert for its popular late-night show Midnight Sky Garden.
Producer Shiroshita said: "Of course we intended to cancel. But fans came despite everything happening, and we realized this was precisely when a live radio concert could give listeners courage."
Singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura hosts Midnight Sky Garden, broadcast nationwide from RSG.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k79: Photo: A Giant Goes into Battle
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k80:
A giant humanoid weapon confronts the red Angel that appeared near RSG's Sumire Ward radio station around 3 a.m. today.
It emerged from a launch installation built into the road.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k81: Urgent Need for Safer Parks in Sumire Ward
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k82: Violent incidents in Sumire Ward's parks late at night have increased since the start of the year. Police have added patrol staff, but so far with little apparent effect. The precinct chief says further measures are planned to protect residents.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k84:
"Aren't roadworks supposed to end with the fiscal year?" asks one Sumire Ward resident, frustrated that construction continues into the new year. This week, work is underway at 36 sites, disrupting everyday life and prompting many complaints.
"I'm appalled by the ward's lack of planning when commissioning all this," the resident added.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k86:
Many witnesses saw the fierce late-night battle between a giant humanoid weapon and the red Angel in Sumire Ward. The weapon initially fired a Gatling gun, then pulled back, equipped knife-like weapons in both hands, and charged.
Witnesses also saw that the cable linking its back to the road-mounted launch installation had been severed. Military journalist Misatoya said: "We don't know the details, but it may supply power. If so, the humanoid weapon could have been in serious danger."
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k87: Mystery Building Revealed as Giant Weapon's Arsenal
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k88:
Today's red Angel incident revealed the purpose of a Sumire Ward building that had long puzzled residents: it was an arsenal for the giant humanoid weapon.
Standing on the street outside the radio station, the building supplied firearms used against the Angel. Locals had called it the "mystery building" because no one ever seemed to be inside.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k89: Concertgoer Suspected of Entering Staff Room
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k90:
An intruder entered Radio Sky Garden's staff room late tonight and took a soft drink. The station was hosting a Midnight Sky Garden concert, and a member of the audience is suspected.
Only an orange juice from a staff member's desk was taken. Its owner sympathized: "There are no vending machines here. Maybe they were thirsty and couldn't resist." The employee's frustration was directed at the station's facilities.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k91: Photo: Lettering on Giant Weapon's Launcher
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k92:
Writing was spotted on the launch installation of the giant humanoid weapon that repelled the red Angel in Sumire Ward today. Does it name the builder, the installation, or perhaps the weapon itself?
Neither national nor local authorities have yet explained the road-mounted equipment or the humanoid weapon.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k93: Travel Agency Manager Laments Sumire Ward Disaster
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k94:
A travel agency in Sumire Ward suffered severe damage during tonight's battle between the red Angel and the giant humanoid weapon. Nearby buildings and roads were also devastated.
Branch manager Taro Tomiyama lamented: "Worse, the chaos exposed my love of cosplay, and now my staff avoid me. If only this hadn't happened..."
He added earnestly: "I want a workplace where people accept you even if you like cosplay and keep costumes in your locker."
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k95: Photo: People Caught in the Red Angel Attack
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k96:
People unable to escape the red Angel's attack on Sumire Ward watch it battle the giant humanoid weapon before their eyes.
The weapon eventually repelled the Angel, and they were able to return home safely.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k97: Photo: Humanoid Weapon Repels Red Angel
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k98:
The red Angel in Sumire Ward sliced buildings apart with glowing, whip-like arms, even piercing the giant humanoid weapon's body.
But the weapon ultimately repelled it amid a tremendous flash of light. Residents watching the battle celebrated together when they realized it had won.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k100:
Firefighter Miyoshi of the Sumire Fire Station lost his composure watching the red Angel fight the giant humanoid weapon. Overwhelmed by his own helplessness, he fell into despair.
"Seeing these enormous things fighting so fiercely made me realize how small and powerless I was. But a firefighter from another station encouraged me. I recovered and resolved to do what I could."
The stranger left without giving a name. No responding crew has identified anyone matching the description, leaving Miyoshi puzzled.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k101: Saki Honjo: "This Is When My Singing Matters"
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k102:
Musician Saki Honjo was waiting backstage for her appearance on tonight's live Midnight Sky Garden broadcast when the disaster struck.

"I was listening to Aya Suzumura's performance and getting focused. Suddenly the music stopped. As I wondered what had happened, a blinding light passed overhead. There was an incredible noise, and I ducked. When I looked up, the ceiling was gone. I could see the sky."

Honjo and Suzumura encouraged the frightened crowd as they went downstairs and escaped the building.

Honjo's hits include By Your Side..., and she has often brought hope to disaster areas through her performances. With Miyato City devastated by giant shadows, she told us firmly: "This is precisely when my singing matters."
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k103: Aya Suzumura Promises to Finish Interrupted Concert
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k104:
Musician Aya Suzumura was caught in the disaster during a public live broadcast of her show Midnight Sky Garden. The red Angel sliced through the building directly above the studio.

She had planned to perform Our Sky and See You Again., but was forced to stop. Some fans reportedly seemed more disappointed at missing the rest of her songs than at encountering the disaster. Suzumura promised evacuees she would perform in Miyato City again.

"We discussed canceling with the staff," she said. "But I wanted to reach the fans who came and everyone listening, so we went ahead. I'm truly sorry they ended up in danger. Still, the feeling that made us want to perform on a day like this matters. I promise we'll finish this concert."
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k105: Cats' Game-Development Requests Reach a Milestone
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k106:
Late tonight, Toro and Kuro announced that completion of Absolutely Safe City 2: Good Night is now in sight.
＜主人公＞ played a major role: without their help overcoming numerous challenges, development would have been canceled. Toro said: "We have everything we need now, meow! It's practically finished! Leave the rest to us, meow!"

A release date remains undecided, but fans of the first game are already expressing both hope and concern.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k107: Aspiring Oceanographer Inspired by Dr. Fukazawa
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k108:
Ryoko Mizunuma, a marine-science student at Miyato University, was exhausted by studies and part-time work. Unable to balance earning tuition money with research, she was close to abandoning her dream of becoming an oceanographer.
"Then someone appeared before me and talked about my idol, Dr. Hitomi Fukazawa. What a coincidence, I thought. No, it must be fate."
She was too tired to remember what the person looked like, but the encounter renewed her determination.

Dr. Fukazawa went missing in an accident during a marine survey aboard the research vessel Shibazakura late tonight.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k109: Young Hero Reunites Girl with Mother During Battle
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k110:
A young person was seen carrying a girl on their back through tonight's battle between the red Angel and the giant humanoid weapon in Miyato City's Sakura Ward.
The girl had become separated from her mother. Her rescuer crossed the road where the giants were fighting and brought her back. Fierce winds apparently generated by the Angel made the crossing extremely dangerous.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k111: Bus Driver Found Dead After Sumire Ward Incident
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k112:
A body found in a burning bus on a Sumire Ward street tonight has been identified as its driver, Kazuhiko Saito, 57.
The scene was where the red Angel appeared in Sakura Ward. Investigators believe an impact during its battle with the humanoid weapon killed him. No other victims were inside; he apparently stayed behind directing the evacuation.
His grieving daughter Madoka said: "I'd just written asking him to visit his grandchild. If only I'd gone to see him sooner."
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k114:
The giant red Angel attacked Sumire Ward tonight, devastating the street around the radio station and claiming many victims.
Shortly before it appeared, I saw a couple exchanging tender words on the street. Miyato City was already suffering from incidents such as the giant alien in Sakura Ward. I must admit I looked at them with irritation, thinking, "At a time like this?"
Then the neighborhood became rubble. Even as I struggled to photograph the Angel, I kept wondering about that couple. After the humanoid weapon repelled it and things calmed down, I returned to where they had stood. No one was there.
Were they safe? Had they helped each other escape? Could their love withstand the giant-shadow crisis?
I felt a profound sadness at how distant the ordinary life in which two ordinary people could freely express their love had become.
common/lua/stage_212_news_text.luc.0:k116:
Among the chocolate snacks sold in convenience stores and supermarkets, Enoki Village and Moyashi Town are enduring favorites. Now their fans are apparently at "war."
It is playful rivalry, of course: people mainly use social media to make humorous cases for their favorite.
The manufacturer told us: "We know they're attracting attention. We have Enoki and Moyashi factions in our own company! We hope customers will buy their favorite and recommend it to others. Personally, I'm on Team Moyashi."

According to the fan roundup site Enoki-Moyashi War Chronicles, the battle stood as follows at noon today:

Which do you prefer?
Enoki Village: 45%
Moyashi Town: 40%
Both are skinny; they're basically the same: 15%

common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k154:
A huge black creature reappeared in Miyato Prefecture's Yotsuba Ward around 3 a.m. today. It may be the same one seen at Hinageshidai Station.

It is heading toward Fortune Center Building, severely damaging buildings and homes in its path. Police are urgently directing evacuations, but the late hour makes protecting residents extremely difficult, and damage continues to spread.

Prefectural police urge anyone near Yotsuba Ward to follow police instructions or, if no officers are present, leave immediately.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k156:
A witness near a Self-Defense Forces base reported seeing an enormous weapon being transported by aircraft.

"It was dark, so I could only see a silhouette," the witness said. "But that huge shape looked just like the black creature at Hinageshidai Station."

The aircraft apparently headed toward Yotsuba Ward, suggesting that some kind of weapon has been deployed.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k157: Giant Creature Ravages Fortune Center Area
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k158:
The giant creature approaching Fortune Center Building suddenly stopped and began destroying nearby buildings with a beam.

As seen at Hinageshidai Station, it can fire a pale blue beam from its mouth. The attacks have devastated the area, flattening buildings and starting fires. Even its occasional roars produce tremendous shock waves, shattering nearby windows simultaneously.

Its reasons remain unknown. A specialist in animal behavior commented: "At this stage, prediction is difficult. Our best option is to get away from it as quickly as possible."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k160:
Transport aircraft have just delivered an enormous silver machine in front of Fortune Center Building in Yotsuba Ward. No announcement has been made, but it may be the new Self-Defense Forces weapon reported by witnesses.

Immediately upon landing, it attacked the giant creature. A beam from what appeared to be its mouth made the creature recoil sharply.

The machine seems an effective countermeasure, yet its appearance and attacks closely resemble the creature's, suggesting some connection between them.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k162:
The enormous silver weapon suddenly stopped moving. The reason is unclear, but it appeared to lose power. The transport aircraft, seemingly caught off guard, are watching from a distance.

Meanwhile, the giant creature left Yotsuba Ward and vanished. Witnesses say it submerged in the nearby sea.

As suddenly as the destruction began, an eerie quiet has returned to the area.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k163: Did the Creature's Roar Disable the Giant Weapon?
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k164:
Many reports about the giant weapon's shutdown share one detail: it appeared to stop suddenly after the black creature gave a loud roar.
We lack enough information to be certain, but a connection between the weapon and creature seems possible. If a roar can truly disable it, that would be a fatal weakness in a weapon intended to fight the creature.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k165: Out of Control? Giant Weapon Attacks City
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k166:
The silver weapon that had stopped moving suddenly restarted and began destroying the city.

One transport aircraft approached, perhaps to guide it, but was shot down by a missile. The other two immediately headed for the crash site.

The machine appears to be out of control. As it walks through the city destroying everything, it looks just like the black creature.

It is now heading straight toward Fortune Center Building. A direct collision seems inevitable if it continues on course.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k168:
After rampaging for thirty minutes, the silver weapon finally stopped and was recovered by transport aircraft.

The immediate crisis appears over, but destruction remains everywhere. Fortune Center Building is completely destroyed, and homes along the machine's route have suffered catastrophic damage. Yotsuba Ward faces a long recovery.
