The government has yet to issue a statement. It must explain itself to the public and respond swiftly to victims. As an unprecedented man-made disaster, this incident will inevitably bring condemnation and demands for accountability.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k169: Do Giant Creatures Count as Natural Disasters?
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k170:
"They said giant-creature damage wasn't a natural disaster, so my insurance wouldn't pay."
So says a dejected Mr. Kawaide, owner of Kawaide Sky Building. Despite the complete destruction of his property, he received nothing.

In response to concerns like these, Oriental Insurance has launched Disaster MAX, covering every disaster except those caused by people. Yes, giant-creature attacks like this one are fully covered! We protect your property from every kind of disaster!

Visit Oriental Insurance's information page for a quote today!
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k172:
The apparently uncontrolled giant weapon began moving while firing missiles indiscriminately.

The barrage caused enormous damage to nearby facilities, with many missiles striking Fortune Center Building.

One expert said: "It could only have been targeting that building. There's no way to check now, but perhaps something inside attracted the giant shadows."

Police reportedly intend to interview people connected with Fortune Center Building. Further developments are eagerly awaited.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k173: Giant Weapon and the Government's Role
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k174:
The government has yet to explain the giant weapon deployed near Fortune Center Building. The late hour may be contributing to the delay.

Defense Minister's aide Oshiba briefly told reporters: "We are confirming the situation. Please wait for an official statement." Despite a barrage of questions, the interview ended there.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k176:
Scientists worldwide are taking an intense interest in the giant creature's biology.

First is its extraordinary size. It looks reptilian, but how does it sustain a body far larger than any known animal? It must need enormous energy, yet no feeding has been observed.

Then there is its mouth beam. Its dorsal fins glow before it releases a beam of extraordinarily high energy. This seems more like a weapon than a survival mechanism, and difficult to explain through evolution. Despite its immense body's energy needs, it expends still more in these attacks.

One biologist concluded that nuclear fusion must occur inside it. Most colleagues reject this as impossible in a living body, though some concede that the theory makes sense if the beam is a means of releasing excess heat.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k177: Anger Grows over Weapon Use in Urban Area
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k178:
Residents are increasingly angry that a weapon was deployed in a populated area and then went out of control, even given the giant creature's presence. Victims are organizing protests, and reported clashes with police have heightened tensions.
Organizer Mr. Kawaide said: "Using a weapon in the middle of the city is unacceptable. We will protest firmly and demand compensation and measures to prevent this happening again."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k179: Young Person Risks Life to Rescue Woman
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k180:
An avid birdwatcher, Mr. K, sent us this eyewitness account. Watching the giant creature through his telescope, he glanced toward Fortune Center Building and spotted someone still inside.

Looking more closely, he saw the person frantically doing something. A moment later, a woman stood up; apparently she was being rescued.
"I was astonished," he said. "I wondered what anyone was doing there, then realized they were helping a woman. I could never have done that. Truly remarkable."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k181: Strange Grin Spotted in Face of Giant Shadow
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k182:
Birdwatcher Mr. K sent us an unusual report. While observing the giant creature through his telescope, he noticed someone inside Fortune Center Building.

Looking closer, he saw the person grinning despite the danger.
"The moment I saw that face, I cried out and fell backward," he said, bewildered. "I've never seen such a grin in my life. There was something terribly leering about it."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k183: Young Couple Kisses in Front of Giant Shadow
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k184:
Birdwatcher Mr. K submitted a rather passionate eyewitness account. While watching the giant creature through his telescope, he noticed two people inside Fortune Center Building.

He zoomed in and saw them kissing.
"Disgraceful!" he said, blushing. "I wondered what was happening, and there were two youngsters kissing! They ought to consider the time and place. Absolutely disgraceful!"
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k185: Suspicious Meeting in Fortune Center Building
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k186:
Birdwatcher Mr. K reported a suspicious encounter. While observing the giant creature through his telescope, he spotted two figures inside Fortune Center Building.

Looking closer, he saw them handing over "something white."
"I couldn't make it out," he said suspiciously. "It was white, perhaps a little shiny. What could they be exchanging at a time like that? It must have been some shady deal."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k187: Human or Cryptid? Egg Person Spotted
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k188:
Birdwatcher Mr. K submitted a mysterious sighting. Watching the giant creature through his telescope, he noticed two figures inside Fortune Center Building.

A closer look revealed a woman handing someone a large quantity of eggs.
"It might have been an Egg Person," he mused, gazing into the distance. "My grandfather told me about them back home. They adore eggs, eat nothing else, and can live two hundred years on them. If they see you carrying eggs, they'll follow you right into your house until you give them every last one. Come to think of it, we had an Egg Person fence at home. Ha ha."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k190:
Birdwatcher Mr. K has sent further details after continuing to watch the alleged Egg Person.

Even after receiving many eggs, the figure persistently demanded more. The woman apparently had some left and reluctantly handed those over too.

"Definitely an Egg Person," Mr. K said solemnly. "That persistence is unmistakable. They're harmless if you give them your eggs, but eat one in front of them and who knows what will happen. If you meet one, I strongly advise you to hand your eggs over quietly. I don't want anyone else to suffer what happened to my grandfather."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k191: Rise in Young People Who Won't Think for Themselves
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k192:
New research suggests a rise in young people unable to solve problems independently. Youth commentator Sahara argues that asking when you do not understand has become asking even when you could work it out yourself.

"You can't just teach them everything," he said. "Asking may be easy, but explaining takes effort too. Learners need the right attitude. Perhaps I'm old-fashioned, but we were told to learn by watching, and we watched desperately. Don't young people understand that anymore?"

Changes in the environment surrounding young people may have created the current situation.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k194:
A survey conducted late last month among teenagers and people in their twenties found optimism up 16% from last year.

Economic recovery and improved academic performance are thought to be major factors. Greater emotional breathing room has reportedly helped increase the number of young people with a strong sense of justice.

Wakabayashi, chairman of the nonprofit Thinking About Young People, welcomed the results: "It's a very positive trend. Our work seems to be paying off. I hope their energy continues to build better relationships."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k195: More Young People Giving Up Easily
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k196:
A recent study reports that more young people quickly lose heart. Many give up over minor difficulties, saying "I can't do this," which reduces ambition and damages relationships.

Youth commentator Sahara said: "Seeing others give up makes them think they might as well do the same. Parents in particular should avoid expressing defeat in front of their children. Young people may not be able to help feeling discouraged, but they should try not to say it aloud."

Perhaps prevention depends not only on individuals, but on the environment around them.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k197: Are Young People Really More Quick-Tempered?
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k198:
Every year we hear that "young people these days lose their temper easily." That implies earlier generations did not. But is it true? Perhaps youth has always been an age of short tempers.

Why might that be? Young people have abundant energy. Without an outlet, perhaps it emerges as anger. A quick-tempered person may simply lack somewhere to direct that energy. In that case, rather than more people becoming angry, it may be harder to find meaningful outlets.

If so, this is a social problem, not merely a problem with the young. Perhaps modern life offers fewer opportunities for them to pour their feelings into something.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k200:
Several figures were reportedly seen in the remnants of Fortune Center Building after the giant weapon destroyed it. They eventually passed through a surviving doorway.
Someone familiar with the building said: "That section has stairs leading to the ground floor. Judging by the remaining structure, they may have escaped through the door." Their safety has not yet been confirmed.

Police have now arrived and begun rescue operations. We hope everyone is brought to safety soon.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k201: The Threat of a Giant Creature's Roar
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k202:
The black creature's enormous body and mouth beam are obvious threats. I would add its occasional roar to that list.

After one roar, the office where I work was devastated. Every window shattered, and the shock knocked me unconscious. When I came to, I hardly recognized the room. Desks and lockers had slammed to the floor, papers and equipment were scattered everywhere, and huge cracks ran through the walls and ceiling. Fearing the ceiling would collapse, I barely escaped with my life.

I suspect other buildings nearby suffered similarly. Its size and beam may look most frightening, but even its voice puts us in danger.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k203: W&P Consulting Faces Catastrophic Business Damage
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k204:
W&P Consulting's offices suffered devastating damage from a giant shadow before dawn today. The company holds a major global share in weapons information and brokerage, so the effects may spread worldwide.
Investors have already begun reacting, and today's markets are expected to be turbulent.

A company statement is expected today and will be closely watched.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k205: Fortune Center Collapse Devastates Tenant Companies
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k206:
The giant weapon's rampage completely destroyed Fortune Center Building, home to companies including Otani Solutions and W&P Consulting. Their operations are expected to be severely affected.

Several companies have missing employees, making an immediate return to business unlikely. With no precedent for this kind of disaster, the compensation provided may determine when they can reopen.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k207: "I Just Kept Running": Survivor Describes Terror
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k208:
"I had no idea what was happening. Before I knew it, I was just running and running. It feels strange to be alive now."
So says Tabata, an employee of W&P Consulting in the destroyed Fortune Center Building. He was working late when disaster struck.

"I never imagined the entire office could disappear. What am I supposed to do tomorrow?" he added, bewildered and anxious.

Many have lost homes or workplaces overnight to giant shadows. Finding the cause of these repeated appearances is increasingly urgent.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k209: Looting Suspected as 10 Million Yen Vanishes from W&P
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k210:
Miyato Prefectural Police received a report that 10 million yen was stolen from W&P Consulting's devastated offices before dawn. A company representative found the surviving safe empty, though it should have contained bundles totaling that amount.
There was no sign that impact forced it open, nor any banknotes scattered nearby. Someone likely unlocked it and took the contents. Police are carefully establishing the facts.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k211: Investigated: Can You Really Slip on a Banana Peel?
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k212:
Slipping on a banana peel has been a staple joke for generations. Then our editorial team realized something shocking: none of us had ever actually done it.

Something was wrong. We shuddered. Were we being made to believe banana peels were slippery when they weren't? Could this be government manipulation?

Lacking evidence, we immediately formed a team to investigate: can a person really slip on a banana peel?

We placed one on the floor and stepped on it. Then we repeated the experiment in roughly 100,000 combinations, varying the angle, shoes, banana variety, even our mood. After three weeks of exhaustive testing, the team reached its final conclusion: banana peels really are slippery.

Rest assured.
You really can slip on one.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k213: Cries of Grief Ring Across Disaster Zone
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k214:
Another giant-shadow incident before dawn has devastated Yotsuba Ward. Damage extends throughout the ward, with many missing after the late-night attack.

Police and firefighters are stretched thin and requesting help from outside their usual districts. Relatives have been seen collapsing in tears on the rubble or trying to move debris themselves without waiting for rescuers. Cries of grief echo everywhere.

Many remain trapped beneath collapsed buildings. Swift rescue efforts are urgently needed.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k215: Miracles and Misfortune for a Woman Too Scared to Move
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k216:
A Yotsuba Ward woman was frozen with fear directly below Fortune Center Building when the giant weapon struck. Then both a miracle and a mishap befell her.

Rubble, desks, and lockers rained down, yet every piece missed. She escaped without a scratch: nothing short of miraculous.

After reaching the station, she noticed people staring in surprise. A glance in a mirror revealed her face was completely black. Apparently ink or something similar had spilled over her. Alongside her miracle came this small misfortune.

"Little things keep going wrong now," she said cheerfully. "I just slipped on a banana, too. It's like paying for bad luck in installments. Still, at least I'm alive."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k217: Last Sword Gets Stage Adaptation with Michiko Kinmokusei
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k218:
The internationally popular novel series The Tale of the Last Sword will receive its first stage adaptation by the Miyato Revue. Volume eight is being adapted as a musical.
Top star Michiko Kinmokusei, playing its protagonist Marlo, said: "I'm a huge Last Sword fan myself. I hope I can bring Marlo beautifully to life."
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k219: Urban Legend Confirmed: The Nonexistent Floor
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k220:
Have you heard of Fortune Center Building's "nonexistent floor"? The tower supposedly had 36 floors, but a rumor popular among high school students claimed there was a floor 10.5 between the tenth and eleventh. Our investigators questioned building staff but could never verify it.

After the collapse, however, a careful count of its exposed levels revealed 37 floors. The rumored floor apparently existed. Building personnel are as puzzled as anyone; who built it, and why, remain unknown.

It is deeply frustrating that the mystery now lies buried in rubble.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k222:
A young man named Tabata was searching through Fortune Center Building's rubble. He finally gave up after firefighters persuaded him to stop.

Having graduated from university, he began his first job just last month. Now disaster has left his career uncertain. Worse, he had left his pay envelope at the office and was searching for it among the wreckage. If it is not found, making ends meet will be extremely difficult.

Barely into working life, Tabata already faces a painful crossroads.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k223: The Untold Struggles of Hakusan Water Delivery
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k224:
Taicho Co.'s Hakusan Foothills Water Dispenser is a familiar service today, but few know how hard it was to establish.

At first, every employee carried barrels up into the Hakusan foothills, collected water, and brought it down each day. The work was so punishing that many collapsed from exhaustion, and after six months the service's survival was in doubt.

Determined to deliver this water, the president persuaded management and investors to fund channels bringing it directly to the factory, as today. Some customers insist that no longer counts as authentic foothills water, however, so a premium service still uses the old barrel-carrying method.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k225: Banknotes Rain Down at Fortune Center Building
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k226:
A huge quantity of banknotes fluttered around Fortune Center Building after its destruction before dawn. Nearby residents scrambled delightedly to collect them while men apparently connected with the building shouted for them to stop. The money seemed to come from an open safe atop the rubble.

Police arrived and ended the chaos after several dozen minutes. All money collected by residents was confiscated, and some residents and company personnel were briefly detained. Officers are counting the recovered notes, though some loss seems inevitable.

There was reportedly no sign of the safe being forced open by impact, suggesting someone may have forgotten to lock it.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k227: Fortune Center's Ruins Draw Unexpected Admiration
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k228:
Images of Fortune Center Building's remains have drawn comments from around the world:
"Incredible that it stayed standing like that!"
"What kind of engineering does this country have?"
"Dangerous, but I almost want to climb it."

The building is effectively destroyed, yet its two ends miraculously remain standing. Someone apparently connected with the site posted that they would soon be demolished for safety. Replies argued that doing so would be wasteful, or that they should remain as a symbol of the incident.
Still, the risk of collapse leaves those responsible little choice but removal.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k229: Persistent Fires Raise Questions About Building Materials
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k230:
The giant-shadow incident started fires across Yotsuba Ward. Some continue burning fiercely, prompting concerns about flammable building materials. In one especially hard-hit area, rubble itself is burning; the material used apparently becomes more flammable as it ages.
It reportedly complied with the law, but future legal changes may address it.

Ironically, the giants' devastation has exposed problems that had previously escaped scrutiny.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k231: New Release: The World's Safest Spinning Chair
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k232:
Leading office-supply brand Yotsubashi has launched "the world's safest spinning chair."

President Yotsubashi personally oversaw every stage from development to user trials. A spokesperson said male and female employees in their twenties through sixties were required to spend every break spinning in the chair for a month, ensuring safe, comfortable rotation.
"It surpasses competitors in ease of spinning, resistance to motion sickness, and comfortable rotation speed," the spokesperson declared confidently.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k233:
Leading office-supply brand Yotsubashi has launched "the world's safest spinning chair."

President Yotsubashi personally oversaw every stage from development to user trials. A spokesperson said male and female employees in their twenties through sixties were required to spend every break spinning in the chair for a month, ensuring safe, comfortable rotation.
"It surpasses competitors in ease of spinning, resistance to motion sickness, and comfortable rotation speed," the spokesperson declared confidently.
common/lua/stage_213_news_text.luc.0:k235:
An apparently new computer virus is spreading rapidly, replacing every file on infected PCs with pictures of nuts. Its source remains unknown, but it is exploiting vulnerabilities with remarkable efficiency.
So far, the only concrete defense appears to be staying off the internet, and urgent action is needed. Worldwide losses could reach hundreds of billions of yen, and cybercrime police in many countries have begun responding.

common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k164:
Four giant aliens appeared on the streets of Miyato City's Hananira district late tonight, fought, then vanished. Eight nearby buildings collapsed. Police initially reported 12 people injured, some seriously, and one missing, with the toll expected to rise.
Three aliens appeared first. A fourth joined their battle, which intensified into an exchange of heat rays that devastated surrounding buildings. One is believed to be the silver alien seen in Sakura Ward yesterday evening.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k165: Alien Battle Leaves Roads Sunken and Impassable
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k166:
Tonight's giant-alien battle in Hananira caused major road collapses, some over eight meters deep. The affected routes are closed.
Rubble and wrecked vehicles block nearby roads so completely that even construction vehicles cannot reach the site. There is no estimate for reopening.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k167: Fire at Publisher's Building: Alien Battle to Blame?
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k168:
A fire at Ebine Publishing's Hananira offices has apparently been extinguished, with no injuries reported. It is believed to have started in Editorial Department 2 on the sixth floor.
The nearby alien battle may have caused it, though firefighters also suspect a carelessly discarded cigarette. Investigators will establish the cause.
Ebine publishes the general-interest magazine Weekly Giant Shadow.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k170:
A sewer-like odor filled Clover's Hananira West convenience store. An employee said: "Come to think of it, maybe it started when three people came in, one carrying a woman on their back. Everything was chaotic; I can't remember clearly."
The store is closed today for cleaning. With giant aliens fighting nearby at the time, the odor is thought to be connected to the incident.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k171: Alien Wind Blast Sends Cars Flying
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k172:
An extremely powerful gust accompanied a deafening noise from the black alien during the four-way battle in Hananira. It shattered windows and blew away abandoned cars.
One victim, a man in his thirties, said: "My new car was only delivered last week. I still have 36 payments left, and I don't know whether the insurance will cover it."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k174:
Winning numbers for the 578th annual Jumbo Jumbo Lottery have been announced.
First prize: 600 million yen
Winning number: 123450
Adjacent-number prizes: 200 million yen
Winning number: 123449
Winning number: 123451
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k175: Giant Alien Crashes into Weekly Giant Shadow Offices!
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k176:
This photograph was taken from the roof of our own Ebine Publishing building. Three aliens suddenly appeared outside late tonight and began fighting. A reporter braved flying heat rays on the roof to capture this image. Full details will appear in Weekly Giant Shadow's special issue, The Miyato Giant-Creature Crisis.
(Seiko Hirai)
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k178:
Today we're featuring a guy who happened to visit our editorial office! Giant aliens made it a rough day, but his cool outfit shows the toughness that got him through it!
(Teru Mukojima)
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k180:
Today we're featuring a woman who happened to visit our editorial office! Giant aliens made it a rough day, but her cute outfit shows the courage that got her through it!
(Teru Mukojima)
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k181: Woman Found Hiding in Sewer Rubble Runs Off
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k182:
A woman was discovered beneath collapsed debris in Hananira's sewers. She glared at rescuing firefighters and insisted: "An accident didn't trap me here. I buried myself in the rubble."
She vanished shortly after being freed. A man who saw her at a temporary shelter said: "There was something wrong with her eyes. She gave me the creeps. I looked away for a moment, and she was gone."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k183: Buried Treasure Found Beneath Hananira Sewer
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k184:
Workers clearing collapsed ground in Hananira found a jar containing 108 gold koban coins. Their characteristics suggest they date to Japan's early modern period.
Yasuda, an antique-coin dealer in Mitsuna City, said: "They're worth at least several million yen, perhaps more when their historical significance is considered."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k185: Human Thighbone Found at Sewer Collapse
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k186:
Workers clearing collapsed ground in Hananira found a skeletal bone believed to be a human femur. It appears to have been buried for a long time, and police are conducting detailed analysis.
It lay beneath a paved arterial road. Investigators are considering whether it was buried during construction or mixed into the earth used for the work.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k188:
A skull believed to belong to the Cretaceous dinosaur Parasaurolophus was found deep beneath collapsed ground in Hananira. Its distinctive crest suggests a member of that group.
Local chamber-of-commerce chairman Onda said: "We've had enough giant creatures, but dinosaurs are welcome! We want to promote Hananira as a dinosaur town."
Parasaurolophus: A herbivorous dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous, 82-66 million years ago, measuring 8-10 meters and weighing 4-6 tons. Its long crest extends from the nose toward the back of the head.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k189: A Bond of Trust Between Giant Aliens?
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k190:
During Hananira's alien battle, the silver giant appeared to encourage the blue one. After the black alien's attack left the blue giant injured on one knee, the silver giant patted its shoulder.
A woman, 26, who saw this while fleeing at their feet said: "It really looked like encouragement. Once I thought that, the silver alien seemed incredibly dignified."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k191: Alien Heat Rays Captured at the Moment of Firing
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k192:
A photograph captures three giant aliens in Hananira firing heat rays of different colors and sizes.
An astrophysics associate professor at a university commented: "Some Earth organisms emit light, but generating enough light energy to use as a powerful weapon is astonishing. These are unquestionably beings unlike anything on our planet."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k194:
Risa Katsuragi's agency announced that the celebrated avant-garde calligrapher was rescued from a stalled elevator.
She had visited a Hananira event hall for an exhibition of her work when four giant aliens appeared. As she tried to evacuate, the shock of an alien's roar cut power to the elevator, trapping her.
She was freed an hour later without serious injury but is receiving hospital treatment for exhaustion. Organizers will postpone the exhibition until she recovers.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k196:
Risako Kusunoki, 77, of Mitsuna City is being praised for persuading a man who repeatedly stole amid the alien-crisis chaos to turn himself in.
Walking home from a convenience store late at night, she saw him trying to enter a ground-floor apartment window. After a tense standoff, she listened to the troubles that led him to steal and offered advice. He agreed to accompany her to a police box, where he was arrested.
"I was frightened," she said, "but he reminded me of my son, who lives far away. I couldn't ignore him. I hope he'll change."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k197: Risa Kashiwaagi Wins Best Actress at Milky Way Film Festival
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k198:
Risa Kashiwaagi won Best Actress at the Milky Way Film Festival, held in Country F and ranked among the world's hundred film festivals. Her film Stray Cat Wi-Fi: No-Man's-Land also won Best Screenplay.
Director William Tsuruta said: "I'm honored to leave a mark on film history. This film could never have been completed without Risa. I'm grateful to her."
Afterward, Kashiwaagi addressed the giant-creature incidents in Miyato City: "I'd like to donate the prize money. I hope recovery comes as soon as possible."
(Image: a scene from Stray Cat Wi-Fi: No-Man's-Land)
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k199: Alien Kicks Truck into Tanker, Causing Huge Explosion
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k200:
Abandoned vehicles in Hananira have caught fire during the giant-alien battle. Crushed cars ignited and exploded, spreading flames to neighboring vehicles.
The black alien also kicked a large truck into a tanker, igniting its gasoline in an enormous blast. A wide area around Hananira West Junction remains ablaze.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k201: Most Japanese Stocks Fall on Giant-Creature Fears
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k202: News of Miyato City's destruction since yesterday evening has sent most Japanese stocks lower. Medical, construction, and defense shares are among the exceptions, rising in anticipation of major rescue and reconstruction efforts.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k203: Emergency Cabinet Meeting Considers Alien Negotiations
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k204:
An emergency meeting at the prime minister's office discussed negotiating with the giant aliens.
The chief cabinet secretary said: "The creatures appear unpredictably. So far they have been confined to Miyato City and its surroundings, but other regions could be affected. Our defenses have limits. We agreed that dialogue with the aliens should be pursued to minimize damage."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k206:
The government's emergency website is struggling under a flood of inquiries about relatives in Miyato City.
Masako Umeda, whose son works at a Hananira convenience store, said: "I can't reach him. I'm so worried. I just want him to be safe."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k207: Ebine Publishing Seeks Recovery Under New Owner
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k208:
Ebine Publishing's Hananira headquarters suffered major damage from today's giant aliens, but a new owner is promising recovery. Employee Mukojima said: "The roof has largely collapsed, and other staff are missing. Honestly, I thought it was over. But the new owner said they'd rebuild Ebine. I'll do everything I can to help."
The path will be difficult. Roads as well as the building are badly damaged, making normal work impossible. Perhaps there is no need to remain at this particular site. The company's next steps will be closely watched.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k209: Regional Coffee Is Brewing a New Trend
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k210:
Regional coffee is emerging as a new industry trend. Roasting, grinding, and brewing all affect flavor, and products modeled on beloved local cafes are beginning to appear.
Kenzo Aiuchi, chairman of the Miyato Coffee Club, said: "It's wonderful to enjoy carefully crafted coffee so easily. I hope it encourages people to visit the actual cafes. My personal dream is that more coffee lovers will support more shops, until the whole city is filled with its aroma."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k211: Fried Chicken Minister Reaches 100 Billion Sales
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k212:
Miyato-based convenience-store chain Clover announced that its Fried Chicken Minister range reached 100 billion cumulative sales before dawn today. The popular range is known for its many flavors.
Its official social-media account posted: "Thanks to our customers, we've reached this incredible milestone. Next stop: one trillion!"
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k213: Man in Swimsuit Appears at Hananira Store
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k214:
A man wearing a swimsuit entered a Hananira convenience store, but was gone when police arrived following a report.
Giant aliens were nearby at the time. An officer suggested: "Perhaps he used the chaos to fulfill a longstanding wish to walk around town in swimwear."
Police added that unless the swimsuit was exceptionally revealing, no offense had been committed.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k215: Woman in Swimsuit Appears at Hananira Store
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k216:
A woman wearing a swimsuit entered a Hananira convenience store, but was gone when police arrived following a report.
Giant aliens were nearby at the time. An officer suggested: "Perhaps she used the chaos to fulfill a longstanding wish to walk around town in swimwear."
Police added that unless the swimsuit was exceptionally revealing, no offense had been committed.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k217: Tomorrow's Events Canceled Nationwide After Alien Incidents
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k218:
Events and concerts across Japan are being canceled following Miyato City's giant-creature crisis.
Popular idol group Homeostasis, currently touring nationally, announced that tomorrow's Aosagi Stadium concert would be postponed for audience safety.
Leader Shota Hino wrote online: "We discussed this with many people and made the decision we felt was best. We're sorry to everyone who was looking forward to the concert. For now, please put your safety first."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k220:
The broadcaster has postponed episode 27 of the popular anime Sugochic Mirorin following the giant-alien appearances. A scene in which a giant Mirorin makes ice cream in a cement mixer was judged too reminiscent of Miyato City's crisis.
A replacement program will air, followed by episode 28 the following week. Whether episode 27 will ever be shown is undecided.
Sugochic Mirorin follows a magical girl's everyday life. Popular with children and adults alike, it is now in its fifteenth season.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k221: Professional Baseball Suspended Amid Alien Crisis
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k222: Professional baseball organizers have suspended games following Miyato City's giant-creature incidents. With appearances still unpredictable, they cannot ensure the safety of spectators and staff. The suspension will continue until games are judged safe to hold.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k223: At Least Four Missing After Alien Wind Blast
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k224:
At least four people remain missing after being blown away by powerful winds from the black giant alien in Hananira. Police are seeking witnesses.
One self-employed survivor said: "I avoided a direct hit by sheltering behind something. I saw people flying away like dead leaves. It was terrifying."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k226:
Here's a guy who happened to stop by our editorial office!
He loves cosplay, and this is his favorite policewoman's uniform! I had a closer look, and it was convincing enough to pass for the real thing. He wore that skirt beautifully!
(Teru Mukojima)

common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k283: Last Sword Charity Editions to Support Miyato City
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k284:
O. R. James, author of the bestselling Tale of the Last Sword novels, announced charity sales to support Miyato City after the giant-creature incidents.
Specially bound editions of the series will be offered, with buyers choosing any price from 1,000 yen upward. James said: "Even little candies, gathered together, can become a great source of strength. Please lend a little of yours to Miyato City."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k286:
Ristorante Miyato, the popular luxury French restaurant headquartered in Yotsuba Ward, is closing. The business, which had expanded overseas, has changed owners and plans to reopen under a new concept.
Prospective head chef David said: "We envision a members-only restaurant combining our French culinary knowledge and experience with udon, kishimen noodles, and rice bowls to delight discerning diners."
The main restaurant will close temporarily for renovation, and overseas affiliates will be reorganized. A reopening date is undecided.
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k288:
Overseas branches of Ristorante Miyato are performing well and expected to reach their annual sales target of 500 million yen. The popular luxury French restaurant is headquartered in Yotsuba Ward.
It has actively expanded into North America, Europe, and Asia, with more than ten overseas locations. An industry source said: "The food is excellent, but the service also suits each country's culture. They promote cultural exchange too, offering meals accompanied by foreign instruments or rakugo storytelling."
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k289: Ebine Sells All Assets; Weekly Giant Shadow Ends
common/lua/stage_214_news_text.luc.0:k290:
Ebine Publishing will sell its business, land, and buildings, with Weekly Giant Shadow ceasing publication after this week's issue. The major damage caused by giant aliens in Hananira today is believed to be the main reason.
Employee Mukojima said: "The roof is badly damaged and other staff are missing. I couldn't see how we could continue. When I heard we were closing, I wasn't surprised. But I don't know what I'll do tomorrow."
Ebine changed owners shortly before this. The sale is said to have earned the new owner at least two billion yen.

common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k70: Before dawn today, the giant flower attached to Akashia Department Store at Umegaya Junction burst. A blinding flash engulfed the area, reportedly destroying the neighborhood completely.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k72: Footage posted online before dawn shows a giant creature walking along Ayame Street, a major road. It reportedly headed toward the giant plant at Akashia Department Store.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k73: Giant Plant's Roots Break Through Ground!
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k74: Before dawn today, the giant plant's roots rose up and emerged above ground.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k76: An evacuation order was issued around Azami 1-chome Station before dawn. Creatures appearing since last night had already devastated the area. After reports that the giant plant on Akashia Department Store would burst, the Self-Defense Forces decided to order an evacuation.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k78: The overnight rain has grown heavier in the hours before dawn.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k80: Before dawn, a riot officer reunited with evacuees. There was no time to celebrate one another's survival before boarding a vehicle to get away from the giant plant as quickly as possible.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k82:
Umegaya Park suffered catastrophic damage when the giant plant burst, prompting an outpouring of grief online.
The mayor proposed the park in 1966 to preserve a peaceful refuge amid the city's growth. The council unanimously approved it. Having long cherished it as a place to relax, nearby residents are shocked by its destruction.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k83: More Looting? Goods Vanish from Convenience Store
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k84:
A convenience store inside the evacuation zone has reported stolen merchandise. Police believe someone waited for staff to evacuate before entering.

Curiously, a heater had been placed in front of the register and appeared to have been used.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k86: A horse escaped from a racetrack ten kilometers from Akashia Department Store the day before the giant plant prompted an evacuation order. Its whereabouts remain unknown, and police are gathering information.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k88: A riot officer directing evacuations said the giant creature appeared suddenly from the sky. It seemed to fly by emitting jets from the openings where its limbs had retracted.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k89: Murder Suspect May Have Entered Evacuation Zone
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k90:
Police received information that Yuko Saeki, wanted on suspicion of killing her brother, may have fled into the evacuation zone around Azami 1-chome Station.
The giant plant's explosion reduced the area to ruins, and her fate is unknown.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k91: Government Estimates Cost of Extraordinary Incidents
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k92:
The government estimates economic losses from the incidents around Miyato City at more than 11 trillion yen. As the crisis continues, losses may rise further.
It plans to fund reconstruction through spending cuts and tax increases, though influential ruling-party lawmakers argue that reconstruction bonds should also be considered.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k94: As the evacuation around Azami 1-chome Station neared completion, cameras recorded numerous creatures emerging from underground and attacking departing vehicles. They were the same monsters that had attacked the station area.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k95: Akashia Department Store Vanishes After 90 Years
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k96:
The plant attached to Akashia Department Store burst before dawn, devastating the surrounding area. At the epicenter, the store vanished without a trace, ending its long history.
It opened before the war as the small independent Akashia-do, known locally for good merchandise at low prices. During the postwar boom it expanded, continuing to operate with the aim of improving local quality of life.
Residents responded: "It's such a shame. We hope they won't give up and will rebuild."
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k97: A Narrow Escape with Flames at Their Backs
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k98:
Our reporter captured riot-police vehicles and civilians fleeing at full speed from approaching flames, having started evacuating just before the giant flower at Akashia Department Store burst.
The two civilians were on a motorcycle. Apparently, the reporter could barely keep up on foot.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k100:
Some people are confronting Miyato Prefecture's extraordinary crisis head-on. Trickster Transport, in business since before the war, lives by the motto "Through fire and water," devoting itself to delivering every package no matter the conditions.
One courier, Tsuro Haita, dodged attacks from small creatures emerging around devastated Azami Station to deliver a parcel to a doorstep. "Monsters don't scare us! We didn't stop delivering when bombs were falling. Bring it on!" he declared.
Their determination to fulfill their duties despite unprecedented danger commands admiration.
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k101: A Desperate Rescue in the Rain
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k102:
Riot police remained until the last moment directing the evacuation around Azami 1-chome Station before dawn, peering through rain and shouting themselves hoarse. One officer spotted a woman slumped motionless inside a car.

Her vehicle was badly damaged by apparent creature attacks and collisions, finally stopping against another car. Knocked unconscious, she had missed the evacuation warnings.

Every door was warped shut. The officer could neither open them nor wake her by shouting and pounding on the window. Just as despair set in, he found a crowbar-like tool nearby and pried a door open. Her unconscious position had obstructed her breathing; a little more delay could have cost her life.

After waking in hospital, she said shyly: "I opened my eyes somewhere unfamiliar, with a strange man watching me. That startled me, but then he burst into tears when he saw I was awake! He's the one who saved me. It gave me a bit of a weird feeling, but I'm here because of him. I want to repay him as much as I can. Hopefully, by staying at his side."
common/lua/stage_215_news_text.luc.0:k103:
Our reporter captured riot-police vehicles and civilians fleeing at full speed from approaching flames, having started evacuating just before the giant flower at Akashia Department Store burst.
The two civilians were on a horse. Apparently, the reporter could barely keep up on foot.

common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k67: Giant weapon holds up Angel from the sky?
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k68:
Early this morning, an immense, unidentified life-form appeared over Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture, slowly descending from the sky. Nearby residents saw a giant humanoid weapon arrive beneath it and apparently try to stop its fall.
The government announced that, like the unidentified life-form seen in Miyato City, this creature would be called an "Angel."

Mitsuna City borders Miyato City, where giant creatures have been appearing since yesterday.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k69: Giant footsteps cave in Mitsuna roads
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k70:
A giant humanoid weapon was seen racing through central Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture, early this morning.
Its passage caused damage including collapsed sections of road in the Mizuna Shopping District.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k72:
In Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture, residents must leave their garbage at designated collection points by 8 a.m. on collection day. Some put it out the night before, however, sparking a dispute.
Those opposed to nighttime disposal say it leaves collection points dirty and allows crows and other animals to scatter the trash. Those who support it include residents whose schedules prevent them from putting garbage out by 8 a.m.
The city commented, "We have installed nets to keep crows away, but they are not a complete solution. We would like to take further action."
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k73: Photo: Three giant weapons repel Angel
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k74: Early this morning, three giant humanoid weapons were seen deploying against the enormous Angel that appeared over Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k76:
Police received a report early this morning of a black car trying to run someone over in Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture.
The vehicle had already driven away by the time officers arrived.

Witnesses described a luxury black sedan relentlessly pursuing a young person who was unfamiliar to local residents.
Police are searching for both the vehicle and the person it was chasing.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k78:
Localized violent winds were recorded in Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture, early this morning. Residents described a sudden, powerful gust from the southwest, strong enough to send empty cans, flowerpots, and car tires flying. One resident was injured by a rolling tire and taken to hospital.
The Meteorological Agency says sudden strong winds can occur in spring, but that this event in Mitsuna City has few precedents.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k80:
Early this morning, police received a report that five vending machines had been destroyed in the Mizuna Shopping District of Mitsuna City, Miyato Prefecture.
A resident discovered the damage during an early walk and called 110.
Police are investigating the incident as an attempted theft of cash from the machines.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k82:
Shopkeepers and local residents met yesterday at the civic center in Mitsuna City's Mizuna Shopping District to discuss business hours.
Residents demanded longer hours, voicing frustration that most shops close at 6 p.m. "Six is far too early, no matter how you look at it. They should stay open until at least six thirty." Shopkeepers explained why they could not agree: "If we don't close by six, we'll miss the night baseball games." Talks ended in a stalemate, although the shopkeepers showed some flexibility, saying, "We'd like to reconsider after November."
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k83: Walls rise from beneath Mitsuna City
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k84:
Huge walls rose from the streets of Mitsuna City, where a giant Angel has appeared. Dozens of these walls formed an enormous sloping structure. Their emergence destroyed nearby homes and caused other damage.
Residents around the walls reportedly plan to form a victims' group and protest to the national and local governments. The national government has yet to issue a statement about the walls.

The walls rose as a giant humanoid weapon was approaching the Angel overhead. Military journalist Misatani, an expert on weapons, said, "The details are unclear, but perhaps these enormous slopes formed a track that allowed the humanoid weapon to keep running without slowing down."
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k86:
An intruder entered a milk shop in Mitsuna City's Mizuna Shopping District early this morning and stole earrings worth six million yen.
The earrings were a family keepsake belonging to the shop's owners, Mr. and Mrs. Horiuchi.
Milk deliveries had been delayed by the giant creature incidents that began yesterday. The intruder is believed to have entered while the couple were outside the shop.
Police suspect someone who knew the Horiuchis owned the valuable earrings and are questioning people in the neighborhood.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k87: Column: Strength in refusing to give up
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k88:
[Risa Kashiwagi: Don't give up on surviving this crisis or ending conflict]
People's lives in this country, and around my home in Miyato City, are now threatened by giant shadows.
Looking beyond our borders, conflicts and battles continue to rage. If we surrender to these threats, or abandon hope of a world without war, we lose sight of the direction our lives should take.

I believe that each of us holding fast to what we think is right is the source of our strength: the strength to survive this crisis and to rid the world of conflict.
Sometimes our decisions, or the things we are trying to do, may draw criticism. Even so, I believe we can build a world where everyone lives happily by always trying to choose, from the many paths before us, the one we truly believe in and want to take.

In my next column, I plan to write about what I am thinking now and what I intend to do. (By journalist Risa Kashiwagi)
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k90:
The giant Angel that appeared over Mitsuna City early this morning was destroyed by three giant humanoid weapons that rushed to the scene.
The Angel is believed to have descended slowly from space. Initially spherical, it eventually unfolded to cover the entire Mitsuna area.
One humanoid weapon reached the predicted impact point and held the Angel up to prevent it from falling. Two more then arrived and attacked it.
The purple weapon supporting the Angel appears to be the same type seen in Miyato City. The red and yellow weapons that followed reportedly had differently shaped heads.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k92:
As previously reported, a runaway car tried to run down a resident in Mitsuna City early this morning.
But it did not stop there: the vehicle also smashed a dresser left in the road.
Its owner, 85-year-old Su Tan, was furious. "With strange things happening everywhere, I packed my savings, food, and clothes into my dresser and planned to evacuate to my relatives' home. That runaway car ruined everything!" Police are investigating the incident as property damage.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k93: Mizuna sewer work to be extended
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k94:
Sewer work in Mitsuna City's Mizuna Shopping District will take longer because of the giant humanoid weapon that appeared early this morning.
The Sewer Maintenance Division of the Mitsuna Water and Sewerage Bureau, which oversees the work, says new damage has been found in part of the sewer system. The affected section had passed the previous durability inspection, but is believed to have been damaged by the impact of the giant weapon running through the shopping district.
Originally scheduled for completion on the 13th of this month, the work is now expected to continue until the end of next month, including checks for further damage.

At a press conference, the bureau's director bowed in apology. "We regret the continued inconvenience to local residents. We will carry out this work carefully, overlooking nothing, to improve your living environment. We ask for your understanding."
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k96:
Mitsuna City has struggled with growing amounts of garbage in recent years.
Some areas have seen a sharp rise in waste, placing an increasing burden on collectors. Bulky items such as dressers and wardrobes protrude into the road, seriously obstructing passing vehicles.
Relatedly, when a giant Angel appeared over the city early this morning, a black sedan was seen driving dangerously through the streets, smashing dressers and wooden crates in its path.
One resident said, "It's embarrassing to live here. Residents' behavior is part of the problem, but the disposal rules need work too."
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k98:
Parts of Mitsuna City's Mizuna Shopping District lost power in an outage believed to have been caused by a damaged utility pole. Repairs are still underway in some areas.
Black automotive paint was found on the pole, and police are searching for a black sedan that was driving recklessly around the time of the outage.

A giant humanoid weapon passed through the shopping district that day, and its footsteps were initially blamed. However, the power had failed before it arrived, prompting a new investigation.
common/lua/stage_216_news_text.luc.0:k100:
A young person visited a milk shop in Mitsuna City's Mizuna Shopping District early this morning and handed earrings to its owners, Mr. and Mrs. Horiuchi.
The earrings were a keepsake from Mr. Horiuchi's mother, who died four years ago.
Worth six million yen, they had been found outside the shop and returned to the couple.
Milk deliveries were delayed by the giant creature incidents that began yesterday. The Horiuchis were outside when the young person handed over the earrings and left without giving a name.

common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k56:
Shortly after 6 p.m. on April 3, two roughly forty-meter-tall aliens appeared near Marugame Junction on Route 3 in Minami-Shinjuku 9-chome and began fighting with energy weapons and martial arts.

Tomisaka of Tama City, who watched nearby, said they initially looked alike, but one changed appearance after falling backward onto an overpass.

The unchanged, shining giant's chest light began blinking, after which it rose into the sky and flew away at tremendous speed. The remaining alien then destroyed parts of the city, apparently injuring hundreds.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k58:
Chief Cabinet Secretary S announced that the "Giant of Light," who stopped the alien destroying the city, will be called Ultraman.
He is about forty meters tall, weighs an estimated 35,000 tons, and reportedly flies at Mach 5. Some witnesses claim he appeared by growing larger, though details remain unclear.

Videos uploaded by witnesses have attracted many comments praising his actions.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k59: Alien Zarab Was Impersonating the Giant of Light
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k60:
The alien that disguised itself as the Giant of Light and destroyed the city calls itself Alien Zarab. It had said it came from Planet Zarab to establish friendly relations with Earth. It is about forty meters tall and weighs an estimated 20,000 tons.
Zarab first appeared in Shinjuku looking almost identical to Ultraman, destroying buildings and vehicles with a fingertip weapon called Energy Vulcan. Ultraman forced it to reveal its true form, exposing the attacker.

Why a supposed visitor of peace attacked remains unexplained. A commuter from Kawasaki, whom we will call Watanabe, said angrily: "I trusted Zarab, so I'm terribly disappointed. Why impersonate Ultraman and destroy the city? If it was trying to ruin Ultraman's reputation, that's unforgivable."
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k62:
A women's police uniform was stolen from Tonchiki Police Box in Minami-Shinjuku while officers directed evacuations during the alien incident. The thief broke through a door and took it from a cabinet in the rest room. Police are seeking witnesses.

Sergeant Horiuchi, who was there at the time, told us furiously: "I never noticed the door being broken! It must have been an alien. Why would it steal Officer Ishida's uniform? Outrageous!"

The stolen uniform was size M and had only entered use last week. Its owner, Officer Ishida, appealed: "Losing a police uniform causes all sorts of trouble. Please return it. If you do, I'll give you a different outfit from my own wardrobe."
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k64:
Passersby found hundreds of high-value banknotes blowing near Marugame Junction on Route 3 in Minami-Shinjuku 9-chome and handed them to police as lost property.

The aliens had been fighting there, and destruction of buildings apparently released money kept inside.

No owner has yet come forward. Given the amount involved, that silence has prompted speculation that the money's origins may not bear public scrutiny.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k66:
Major chain Green Green announced that March fried-chicken sales reached 160% of the previous year's level.

Its wide range includes soy sauce, milk, and strawberry flavors, with dessert varieties reportedly popular among women. The company eagerly promises further innovations based on customer feedback.

Fans are already speculating online: "Next will be marinated tuna flavor!" or "It has to be a dessert. Tiramisu chicken is a strong possibility!" Expectations are taking some strange forms.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k67: Quick-Thinking Driver Saves Every Bus Passenger
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k68:
Around 6 p.m. on April 3, a GZ Transit bus nearly became caught in the alien battle in Minami-Shinjuku. Driver Yoichi Tawarada's quick thinking allowed every passenger to escape.

Passenger Fujita of Maihama said: "An enormous foot nearly crushed us, but the driver steered us clear. Then he stayed aboard until everyone had evacuated, guiding us out. He saved our lives."
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k69: Giant Hand Plunges into Shinjuku Building!
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k70: An alien destroyed the GZOE Building in Minami-Shinjuku 8-chome. It reportedly thrust a huge hand inside and threw the office into chaos with something resembling telekinesis.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k71: Flower Stall Destroyed by Fleeing Crowd
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k72:
Motoko Tomii's Shinjuku flower stall was destroyed by people fleeing the alien attack. Known for the care she gave her flowers, the shop was popular with customers buying bouquets after work.

Watching the stall she had cherished for thirty years collapse before her eyes, Tomii was so shocked that she crouched down and could not move.

A regular customer, Sasaki of Kamata, happened to witness it. Rubbing his right elbow and shoulder, he said: "People kept crashing into her stall. It survived the first two impacts but collapsed completely on the third. They hit it so hard, it couldn't possibly have held up. Such a shame."

We hope Tomii recovers and reopens her flower shop.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k73: Clear Umbrellas Catch On with Young Women
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k74:
Clear umbrellas are booming among women in their twenties, especially in cities. Once seen as cheap, they have been transformed this year by department stores and clothing brands offering designer models and a range of transparency levels.

Akiko Watanuki, a Tokyo trading-company employee, said: "I love their clarity. Watching raindrops through the canopy clears my head and makes me feel refreshed! I own about twenty with different degrees of transparency and choose one to match my mood."

The clear-umbrella boom seems set to continue.
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k75: Police Officers Grow Vegetables on State Land
common/lua/stage_217_news_text.luc.0:k76:
A National Police Agency inquiry found that Sergeant Horiuchi and Officer Ishida of Tonchiki Police Box grew vegetables for their own meals on state-owned land behind the station. They cultivated favorites such as snow peas and cherry tomatoes, eating them almost nightly. They even used fertilizer, apparently to increase yields.

Horiuchi reportedly said: "We wanted one more dish with dinner. At first I thought a few green onions wouldn't hurt. Then it escalated to spinach, peas, and other seasonal vegetables. By the time we planted cherry tomatoes, we couldn't stop. I sincerely apologize to the public and our colleagues."

The agency regards the matter seriously and plans to prohibit vegetable gardens behind police boxes in its work rules. Horiuchi received a three-month pay cut, and Ishida a one-month cut.

common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k74: Early this morning, witnesses saw a red giant defeat a red monster near Sakuramachi Junction in Sakura Ward.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k76:
Did you know one woman is still selling flowers amid the crisis?
Takako Kobayashi, a florist near Sakuramachi Junction, has had her stall destroyed twice during these incidents. Despairing, she considered giving everything up. But she resolved to keep working so she could raise her son into a fine adult.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k77: Mysterious Young Person Seen with Glowing Hands
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k78: Witnesses report a young person whose hands emit light. Some say the light healed injured people; others say it was used to threaten them. Further sightings may reveal the truth.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k80:
Police officers continue to struggle amid the extraordinary incidents. Sakura Ward patrol officer Naoko Kuribayashi is one of them. Despite tireless evacuation work, the succession of unimaginable events brought home her own helplessness. She was also reportedly troubled by her superior's cosplay hobby.
The crisis instantly shattered everyday lives maintained through delicate balances. It may be some time before people have the breathing room to reflect on what happened.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k81: Sky Flashes Stop: Is the Crisis Over?
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k82: At 7 a.m. today, the Meteorological Agency announced that the flashes seen overhead in recent days had ceased. Dr. Sasaki, deputy director of the Cosmic Ray Research Institute, said the incoming material from space was no longer being detected. Why it stopped so suddenly remains unknown.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k84: The recent incidents have left many people injured and exhausted. Alongside physical harm, many carry deep psychological wounds, which some experts say are especially pronounced among younger generations. Precise data has yet to be gathered, but addressing this emotional damage is urgent.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k86: The object mounted on the red giant's head appears to be an enormous boomerang-like weapon. The giant fought with it in hand, but dropped it after a monster's attack. Shopkeeper Tamotsu Yamamoto, who says he measured it on the ground, reported that the silver weapon was over seven meters long.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k87: Burst Pipes Cut Water in Sakura Ward
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k88: The red monster's destruction has ruptured water pipes in Sakura Ward. Water is gushing above ground in some areas, and the Self-Defense Forces have begun supplying affected neighborhoods. There is no estimate for restoring service.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k89: Department Store Badly Damaged, Unable to Reopen
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k90: A Sakura Ward department store suffered major damage in the battle between the red giant and red monster. Manager Fujio Fujiwara says losses will be enormous, with merchandise destroyed as well as the building damaged.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k91: Was the Red Giant Unable to Fire Its Beam?
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k92: Witnesses to this morning's battle say the red giant placed a hand against its forehead to fire a beam, but nothing happened, allowing the monster to counterattack. Scholars are debating why the attack failed.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k93: Two People Stay Close Through the Crisis
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k94:
Sakura Ward suffered greatly during the extraordinary incidents. Some survived the night inside damaged buildings, including Takao Yonehara and Yuki Nagahama, who stayed close despite their fear and lived to see morning.

Question: Did you ever think it was over?

Yonehara: I believed we'd survive. I kept encouraging her never to give up.
Nagahama: With him beside me, I never felt like giving up. I was determined we'd make it.

Perhaps refusing to give up is the greatest strength we have for opening the way to tomorrow.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k96:
Journalist Risa Kashiwagi, whose real name is Reiko Kamio, has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder and kidnapping. Her magazine and online writing had won strong support among young readers.
As president of weapons consultancy W&P, she used investment from American arms giant M Company and dealings with defense agencies to build a business with annual sales of hundreds of billions of yen in only a few years.

She had written as Risa Kashiwagi since her student days. Her arrest revealed that the popular journalist and the head of one of Japan's largest weapons consultancies were the same person, deeply unsettling her young admirers.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k97: W&P Dissolves After President Reiko Kamio's Death
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k98:
Reiko Kamio, president of weapons consultancy W&P, has died. Backed by American arms giant M Company, she built annual sales of hundreds of billions of yen within a few years through defense-agency dealings.
With Kamio and other executives killed during the crisis, attention had turned to a successor. Instead, major shareholder M Company called an extraordinary shareholders' meeting, where a motion to close the business passed. W&P will dissolve.

Kamio also worked as journalist Risa Kashiwagi from her student days. Reportedly, only executives at W&P and M Company knew they were the same person.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k100:
The Metropolitan Police announced the disciplinary dismissal of Inspector Toru Fujiwara, 55, head of White-Collar Crime Investigation Unit 2 in the Second Investigation Division.
His excessively violent methods and discretionary refusal to act on certain serious crimes had already raised concerns. This time, his private use of a police helicopter led to approval of an exemption from dismissal-notice requirements and immediate termination.
Fujiwara reportedly ignored surrounding reporters, gave a defiant smile, and walked away.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k101: Walking On in Search of Safety
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k102: Near Tsubaki Boulevard in Sakura Ward, repeatedly caught in giant-alien battles, people were seen walking on and on in search of somewhere even slightly safer.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k104: A woman was seen praying to a monster near Sakuramachi Junction in Sakura Ward. Standing on a ruined pedestrian bridge, she reportedly murmured: "Please buy some flowers... Please."
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k105: Young Person Pays Three Million Yen for One Flower
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k106:
A report submitted to this site describes a young person who left three million yen for a single flower at a stall near Sakuramachi Junction.
The florist was distraught after her stall's destruction. The customer handed her the money and walked away.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k107: Last Sword Fever Reaches Space: All Ten Volumes Aboard Probe
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k108:
The International Space Development Federation announced that all ten volumes of The Tale of the Last Sword will travel aboard the unmanned deep-space probe Saikeen, due to launch next autumn. It will head beyond the solar system, observing Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and Uranus along the way.
"We want extraterrestrial life to discover Earth's most popular story," the federation said. "If they understand it, the circle of Last Sworders may spread across the universe."
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k109: Tropical Island Hideaway Faces Mysterious Flooding
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k110:
The luxury overseas beach resort Tropical Island Hideaway is in danger of submerging. Its manager went to the waterfront this morning and found the sea more than a meter higher, covering the beach and low piers. Cancellations are pouring in, severely hurting the operator.
Investors suspect a connection with Miyato City's giant-creature incidents. Fears that the entire resort may sink have sent its value plunging.
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k111: Tropical Island Hideaway Awarded Six Stars
common/lua/stage_218_news_text.luc.0:k112:
Luxury overseas beach resort Tropical Island Hideaway has received Monthly GZ Resort's highest-ever rating of six stars. Founded by Miyato City resident Mikawa, it has won praise from wealthy guests worldwide, though ownership has since changed.
Investor Dawson, a former guest, said: "The beautiful beach is wonderful, of course, but digging for fossils is great fun. I'll never forget the excitement of finding an enormous one."
Mikawa has been missing since becoming caught in the giant-creature incidents that began yesterday.

Dear Dr. Fukazawa,

Please forgive this unexpected letter.
There is something I must tell you today.
I know I should say it in person, but I feared
I would be too nervous to find the words
if we were face to face. So I decided to write.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r8:c4:
Thank you for all your hard work.
We have only a few hours left before reaching land.
Our time together was short, but I enjoyed working with you.
I deeply admire your dedication to your research.

The thought of saying goodbye makes me terribly sad.

If I could, I would like to keep helping you,
to support you,
and always stay by your side.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r8:c5:
This sudden confession may have upset you.
Selfish as it may be, I wanted you to know how I feel.

I'm sorry to interrupt your work.
Please take care of yourself.

Tetsuya Oda
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r9:c3:

common/csv/reading_material.csh.r9:c4:

There is something I want to tell you, too.

I'll wait for you at the bow tomorrow morning.
Please spare a little time for the two of us to talk.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r9:c5:
The sea breeze is still cold at night.
Please take care of yourself, too.

Until then,
good night.

Hitomi Fukazawa

common/csv/reading_material.csh.r26:c4:
1. PURPLE FLASHES ACROSS THE SKY!
Have you seen purple flashes in the sky lately? Sightings
have been reported worldwide, particularly in the Northern
Hemisphere. Astronomers and space and weather agencies
are investigating, but their origin remains unknown.
We asked Deputy Director Sasaki of the National Cosmic
Ray Research Institute, which studies high-energy
radiation traveling through space, for his thoughts.

Reporter: What are these purple flashes?
Sasaki: We don't know yet. They may be a weather phenomenon,
but share few traits with anything previously observed.
Our institute doubts that theory. Perhaps this is an
unknown luminous phenomenon. (Continued on next page.)
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r26:c5:
1. PURPLE FLASHES ACROSS THE SKY! (Continued)
Reporter: Do the flashes affect people's health?
Sasaki: So far, no physical or mental symptoms have been
reported from exposure. Radiation levels are normal.
However, the sudden light has apparently caused accidents
by startling or distracting people.

Reporter: What will you do next?
Sasaki: We will continue investigating the flashes.
We want to make progress as quickly as possible.

Their nature remains a mystery, but for now, worrying
so much that you become distracted seems the greater
danger. We await further information.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r26:c6:
2. POPULAR DINING AT IBERIS TOWER
On the waterfront overlooking Sky Garden Bridge, Iberis
Tower offers panoramic views of Miyato City. Shops occupy
floors B2-15, offices 16-26, and a hotel 27-48. Its greatest
draw today is the restaurant area on floors 14 and 15.
With famous eateries from across Japan, choice is difficult.
We visit Pizzeria Verano, the favorite of women in their 20s.

Trained in Naples, its pizza chef gets the dough's salt
and char just right. Try the margherita with genuine
buffalo mozzarella and the restaurant's recommended wine.
Another hit is the Galaxy Mountain Mille-Feuille Pizza:
every pizza on the menu stacked in layers, weighing 2 kg!
Finish it in 30 minutes and your food and drinks are free!
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r26:c7:
3. MY DIARY: JOURNALIST RISA KASHIWAGI
This time, we speak with journalist Risa Kashiwagi.

Reporter: Your reports on young people's psychology and
how they express themselves in society stand out across
many media. You're athletic, speak seven languages, and
cook like a professional. How did you become so talented?
Could we start with what drew you to journalism?

Kashiwagi: My parents' work took us overseas when I was
in high school. I discovered a world with entirely different
languages and customs. That made me interested in my own
country's culture, too. I think that led to my career.
(Continued on next page.)
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r26:c8:
3. MY DIARY: RISA KASHIWAGI (Continued)
Reporter: You began working as a journalist as soon
as you entered university, didn't you?
Kashiwagi: By then, ordinary people sharing information
online was quite normal. I was lucky to gain recognition.
Reporter: What are your plans?
Kashiwagi: I've been reporting within Japan lately, but
I want to find time to work overseas. I'd also like to go
swimming this summer. Oh, and one more thing...
Reporter: Yes?
Kashiwagi: I'm not a professional-level cook. Just average!
(Laughs.)
Reporter: My apologies! (Laughs.) Thank you for your time.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r26:c9:
4. SUSPICIOUS TIES BETWEEN OFFICIALS AND A GROUP
We learned that a ministry official has repeatedly visited
Fortune Center Building in Miyato's Yotsuba Ward for several
years. It houses many companies. When contacted by phone,
the ministries denied any such visits. They may genuinely
not know: the official likely visits secretly, hiding his role.

We also learned that a defense official favored Company A
in equipment procurement, accepting illicit payments to
leak bidding information. Company A has no office in Fortune
Center Building. We suspect something there connects
the official to the company.

Our investigation continues. We will report when we have
reliable information. Stay tuned. (Editor-in-chief Hirai)

common/csv/reading_material.csh.r30:c4:
HOW DEEP-SEA CREATURES GROW GIANT
Hitomi Fukazawa, Professor, Miyato University

People say the deep sea is farther away than space.
Even with the latest equipment, research is still
in its infancy, and much remains unknown.
Here I would like to introduce one of my research
subjects: gigantism in deep-sea creatures.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r30:c5:
Giant squid, seen more often recently; Japanese spider
crabs, the largest arthropods; and oarfish, reaching
10 meters long, all inhabit the "deep sea," below 200 meters.
They are far from the only deep-sea creatures larger
than their counterparts in shallow, surface waters.

Without sunlight and under tremendous pressure, deep-sea
life has developed unusual forms. Gigantism is thought
to be one of the means by which these creatures survive.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r30:c6:
There are several theories about deep-sea gigantism:
1. Large size makes animals harder for predators to eat.
2. Larger bodies store more nutrients, helping animals
   survive where prey is scarce.
3. Buoyancy reduces gravity's effects, making larger
   bodies easier to support.

Of course, the deep sea holds many mysteries, so this
is not an exhaustive list. Creatures with sizes and habits
beyond our imagination may well exist there.
Finding them is precisely why we keep researching.
