common/csv/reading_material.csh.r32:c4:
FEATURE: THE POLICE OFFICERS WE ADMIRE!

The dependable officers we all looked up to as children...

The wish to dress in a police uniform seems universal.
An officer I know even says, "I became a police officer
because I wanted to wear that uniform."

A costume with enough appeal to change someone's
whole life: that is the power of a police uniform.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r32:c5:
Police uniforms come in many forms. There are men's
and women's versions, seasonal variations such as summer
uniforms, and outfits for riot police, motorcycle officers,
and other assignments.

According to the Cosplay White Paper, the most popular
of all is still the classic spring-and-autumn uniform.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r32:c6:
My personal recommendation: men, try a women's police
uniform, and women, try a men's uniform.
Everyone has their own feelings about it, but I believe
it may open up exciting new possibilities for you.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r33:c4:
FEATURE: WELCOME! FAST-FOOD STAFF!

Remember being a student, cheered or even charmed
by a fast-food worker's bright smile? Someone I know says,
"I kept going back for that uniform and smile until
I'd even tried everything on the secret menu!"

This issue features one of the most familiar cosplay
choices of all: the fast-food worker!
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r33:c5:
Fast-food uniforms combine friendliness, cleanliness,
modesty, and flair to an impressive degree.
The real uniforms are more than just stylish: they're
easy to put on and remove, resist stains, and last well.
Their practical design makes you feel ready to work!
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r33:c6:
When you're feeling a little down, why not try
cosplaying as a fast-food worker?
A bright, positive costume may lift your spirits
and put a lovely smile on your face before you know it!
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r34:c4:
FEATURE: HOT FOR FIREFIGHTERS!

Heroes who brave blazing flames to save lives...
That's a firefighter! Alongside police uniforms, their
outfits are popular as the costumes of everyday heroes.
Someone I know says, "I wanted to become a firefighter
just to wear the uniform, but I wasn't tall enough..."
Well, cosplay has no height requirement!
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r34:c5:
The familiar outfit worn when responding to a fire
is called turnout gear. It's made from tough,
heat-resistant materials. Add the helmet, boots, gloves,
and breathing apparatus, and it weighs nearly 10 kg.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r34:c6:
Turnout gear is so sturdy that wearing it makes you
feel much stronger. It may even give you enough
confidence to want to help someone.

But heat resistance isn't an invitation to jump
into a fire, all right? (Laughs.)
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r35:c4:
Dear Dad,
I'm sorry I married Tomoatsu against your wishes.
After Mom died when I was in eighth grade, you raised me
alone. You drove a bus every day, yet still came to my
high school entrance ceremony and graduation.

I've been married five years now, and my son Kenta is four.
Next Sunday, I'm bringing him to see you.

You may still be angry with me,
but please hold your grandson in your arms.

Your daughter, Madoka

It's Iwabuchi. I still can't leave the store, so I asked

Please give the person who brings this note the ticket
for the live radio broadcast.

Because you were late, I've been stuck at work
for an extra hour! You WILL make this up to me!

common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c3:
The Holho cedar forest was restless tonight. Standing
on a cliff above a mountain game trail, Naran touched
the dagger at his waist. His father's keepsake always
seemed to restore his courage and composure. He planted
his feet and nocked an arrow with practiced ease.

Summoned in haste, he had forgotten his cloak. Kiranaria
flowers would soon bloom, but the nights were still cold.
Flames rose from the southern settlement. Naran's still
youthful brow furrowed. Ophir's advance troops, no doubt.
He thought of Maas, a childhood playmate.
Hadn't he lived there?
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c4:
Yet he could no longer clearly recall Maas's face.
With elven blood in his veins, Naran lived longer
than the villagers. If Maas still lived,
he would be about 150 by now.

Naran thought himself heartless, but knew he must
delay "them" from reaching the village
for as long as possible.
Elena was there.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c5:
Naran's slightly pointed ears twitched. Many figures
approached along the trail below. Not people, exactly:
monsters controlled by Ophir, wizard of the Seven Towers.

Great armored pigs lumbered noisily on two legs.
A troop of roughly ten orcs, each carrying a different
weapon, jostled their way along the narrow path.
Up close, their stench was terrible.
Naran grimaced at the memory.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c6:
"Only a few... Still, it can't be helped."

Naran drew his bow and fired far wide of them.
The arrow sailed lightly through the air, began to glow,
and struck a rock jutting from the cliff. A magic arrow.
It flashed faintly. The rock split and rained down
on the pigs below.
When the roaring cloud of dust settled,
the trail was silent. The troop seemed wiped out.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c7:
"Two arrows left. Nowhere near enough."

Naran slung his bow over his shoulder and ran for the village.
Kane, who had also gone out to intercept the enemy,
joined him along the way.
"Naran! They destroyed the southern settlement!
What do they want? Food, after all?"
"Who knows? But probably not food."
"Treasure?"
"There's no treasure in our village. Not that I know of."
"Some elf you are."
"Even at my age, there's more I don't know than do."
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c8:
Naran knew Ophir sought the Sage's Greenstone.
The village had a legend about it, now little more than
a fairy tale. Nobody knew where it lay. Naran and his
father had come seeking it. For two generations, they
had guarded the village while searching.
He had a likely location, but no certainty.

Now, however, life with the villagers mattered
more to him than the stone.
"Elena..."
Startled by his own whisper, he glanced sideways.
Kane was grinning: an honest, quick-witted young man.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c9:
They reached the village before the orcs. Naran hurried
to the well at its edge, where he believed the stone lay.
Nothing had been disturbed. But once Ophir arrived,
he would find it eventually. Before that happened...

A sword pierced Naran's chest. Kane had stabbed him
from behind. "Thank you for leading me here.
So this is where it was."
Kane's outline blurred into a middle-aged wizard: Ophir.
Naran collapsed, blood pouring from his chest.
Through dimming eyes, he saw Ophir cast a detection spell.
It was over. The Sage's Greenstone...
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r42:c10:
Someone shook Naran hard. He regained a sliver
of awareness and forced his heavy eyes open. Kane.
"Naran! Are you all right? I can't believe they got you!"
"You needn't worry anymore. I'm done for."
"I'll treat your wounds right now!"
"Do as you like. More importantly..."

Naran handed Kane the dagger from his waist.
"I'm sorry. The rest is up to you."
He gazed at the sky and quietly breathed his last.

The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 1: The Past - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r43:c3:
Since then, he had escaped with his life and now
found himself in pitch-black darkness. A seven-headed
white horse carried him through that black expanse.
The glow of its white body vanished into the darkness,
where no one could see its form.

The white-hulled space cruiser Uchchaihshravas
had traveled through this void for two full Earth weeks.
The command room midway up its bridge had windows
as black as walls, as though defensive shutters
had been closed over them.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r43:c4:
He, the protagonist of this tale, was Vice Admiral
Momihogg: an unreliable officer known as
the "Torture Admiral."

Staring through the unchanging window, he recalled
the battle at the space fortress in Pluto's orbit
two weeks earlier.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r43:c5:
After eighteen months of large-scale fighting
throughout the solar system, the Granzella Reform Army
had been forced to retreat before the overwhelming
resources of the Earth Union forces. It made its stand
at Pluto's fortress, only to lose that two weeks ago.

Vice Admiral Momihogg's Pluto garrison had packed
as many soldiers as possible aboard a handful of ships.
Using the fortress's railgun catapult,
they barely escaped into outer space.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r43:c6:
Momihogg pondered how to retake the solar system
with so few vessels. A direct clash with the Earth
Union forces offered no hope. They lacked both ships
and the dimensional fighters those ships carried.

Unable to settle on a plan, he speared a piece
of his half-eaten chiffon cake. Just as he stuffed it
into his mouth, his adjutant, Lieutenant Commander
Miyoko G. Lazarov, spoke.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r43:c7:
"Admiral Momihogg! Several ships at three o'clock!
They're not broadcasting friendly identification!"
The command room erupted.
(They've beaten us to the punch...)
Momihogg loosened his uniform collar and looked up
at the large screen suspended from the ceiling.

It showed the space off their starboard side.
Particles of light welled up in the darkness.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r43:c8:
In an instant, the light spread left and right,
deploying around Momihogg's fleet.

In pitch-black subspace, half a dimension removed
from ordinary space, the white-hulled cruiser
Uchchaihshravas prepared for battle.

The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 2: Pitch Black - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c3:
Much had happened since then. Kane had walked for three
days and nights, yet found neither town nor village.
At last, his food and drinking water ran out.

Racked by hunger, he had almost given up hope when
he saw an old man in rags standing ghostlike by the road.
Kane asked whether any settlement lay nearby.
The old man weakly pointed into the forest
and murmured, "A village..."
Kane bowed his thanks and went into the woods.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c4:
Thick vegetation blocked Kane's way. Could a village
really lie here? His unease grew, but he pressed on.
By nightfall, he found a great lake deep in the forest.
Moonlight shimmered on its surface, holding his gaze.
Something seemed to float there, but hunger
brought him back to himself. He searched urgently.
No matter where he looked, there was no village.

Had he lost his way, or had the old man deceived him?
His hunger was nearing its limit,
but he had no choice except to turn back.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c5:
Not long after leaving the lake, he caught a scent:
soup, perhaps, or some other food.
Was there a village nearby after all?
Following the aroma, he somehow returned to the lake.

Now a village stood where there had been none.
He wondered if he was hallucinating, but it was real:
about five houses of different sizes,
like flattened mushrooms with chimneys.
Puzzled though he was, relief mattered more.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c6:
Light shone from the windows, but he could not
make out the interiors. Hoping to beg some food,
he approached the largest house.

He called out, but nobody answered.
When he knocked, the door creaked open,
and the smell of food drifted out.

Feeling a little guilty, Kane decided to enter.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c7:
Inside, Kane called again. Still no answer.
Stranger yet, though the house was filled
with the smell of food, it was completely empty.
He walked around. It seemed to be a single room,
without even stairs. Something lay in one corner.

Kane picked it up.
It was unmistakably a human bone.
Then the house began to shake violently.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c8:
Sensing danger, Kane turned, but the door had vanished.
The house shook so hard it seemed to move sideways.

Struggling to stay upright, he thrust his sword
into the wall, desperate to escape.

The sensation was strange. The wall was oddly elastic,
softer than it looked. Thick, dark-red fluid
oozed from the wound.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c9:
The house was alive. It disguised itself
and lured prey with the smell of food.
That was the kind of creature it was.

Kane drove his sword into the wall again.
A hole opened, and clear water gushed in.
As the room flooded, he widened the hole
and forced his way outside.
He was underwater, apparently in the lake.
The creature sank toward the bottom.
Looking closely, he saw the other houses
swaying beneath the surface.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r44:c10:
When Kane reached shore, the village was gone.
Only the "chimneys" poked above the water.
Was that how the creatures breathed?
He hurried back to the old man, but found only
rags and bones. On impulse, he matched the bone
from the house to them. It fit perfectly.
Strange as the experience was, his hunger was at its limit.
He bit into a piece of flesh cut from the house.
A flavor like soup filled his mouth. With an odd sense
of satisfaction, Kane resumed his journey.

The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 3: Hunger - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c3:
Afterward, Kane reached a port town, seeking rest
for a body worn out by his long journey.
For someone whose days had been consumed by battle,
time in the port brought a brief peace.

But there was another reason for his visit:
to win the town's arena tournament and obtain
the royal treasure shield awarded
to a warrior deemed worthy.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c4:
Possession of the royal treasure shield
was proof of supreme strength.
Warriors from around the world gathered at the arena.

For Kane, eager to test his abilities
and face powerful opponents,
it was the stage of his dreams.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c5:
The next day, the fighting finally began.

It was a one-on-one elimination tournament,
with any weapons or armor allowed. Humans, trolls,
centaurs, birdfolk, and many other peoples competed.
Some, like Kane, fought with weapons; others used magic.
Powerful contenders had gathered from every discipline.

His blood stirred by their presence, Kane entered
the arena with his beloved blazing sword, Ragun-Raze.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c6:
Kane defeated formidable foes in the first round,
then the second, advancing steadily. Few could read
the movements of Ragun-Raze's flaming tip.
The blazing sword had endured every hardship with him,
and now answered the passion that carried him
through so many trials.

I want to be stronger.
Driven by that wish, Kane could not be stopped.
As the flame swordsman swept all before him,
not a spectator doubted he would win.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c7:
Only one bout remained.
Kane had reached the final.
His opponent was a boy smaller than himself,
but the crimson sword in the boy's hand startled him.

It was Ragun-Raze, the blazing sword said to be given
by the fire god to those with burning resolve.
Exactly the same sword Kane carried.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c8:
The two flame swordsmen began their final battle.
Kane could not hide his surprise at facing another
wielder of the same blade. The boy, by contrast,
wore a strangely happy smile.

As they fought, someone came to Kane's mind.
A young boy seeking strength, bearing a crimson sword...

Yes. This was his long-lost younger brother.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c9:
Kane had always told himself that his own weakness
had cost him his brother. His brother, in turn,
believed his lack of strength had caused Kane pain.

Losing their beloved family was what drove them
to seek power, so that the chain of sorrow
would never grow longer.

And that very wish had brought
the two brothers together again.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r45:c10:
A night had passed since their fiery duel.
After both brothers gave everything they had,
the two flame swords entered a long sleep.
Perhaps they had seen their wielders become truly strong.
The blades lay quiet, as if at peace.

With his brother's fierce resolve etched into his heart,
Kane set out once more.
Next time, he would claim the proof of supreme strength.

The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 4: Crimson Flame - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c3:
Kane next set out for the village of a tribe
that had once helped him. Several days later,
while walking through the Saphilia Mountains,
he heard beautiful music, as if played on strings,
coming from beyond the roadside bushes.

Curious, he pushed through the undergrowth.
Beyond it stood an exposed cliff face
with a small hole in it.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c4:
Kane peered into the hole. Mist filled it,
concealing whatever lay within,
but the music definitely came from its depths.

As he brought his face closer for a better look,
everything went black,
and he lost consciousness.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c5:
When he awoke, Kane was immersed in a large pot
of blue-green liquid. A fire burned beneath it,
and the heated fumes stung his eyes and nose.

He tried frantically to climb out,
but a creature unlike anything
he had ever seen held him down.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c6:
The creature stood about a meter tall.
At first it seemed human, but its face had only
a single eye and what looked like a mouth beneath it.
It was naked except for fur wrapped
around its waist like a grass skirt.

It looked scarcely muscular, yet was so strong
that one alone could keep Kane from moving.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c7:
Looking around again, Kane saw what seemed
to be a settlement. Several dome-shaped buildings
had an unfamiliar, perfectly smooth surface.

Dozens of creatures of the same kind
as the one restraining him surrounded the pot,
staring at Kane.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c8:
Noticing he was awake, the one-eyed creatures
began what looked like a dance,
all chanting something like "Geh, geh."

His ears rang, and his awareness began to fade.
Dimly, he saw a great shadow approaching
from deep within the village, shaking the ground.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c9:
With the last shreds of consciousness,
Kane felt himself lifted, pot and all,
and heard a great gulping sound.

As he passed out, a voice echoed inside his head.
"Honerarino funarama."

Along with the voice,
he heard that music once again.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r46:c10:
When he woke, Kane was back before the hole
he had first looked into. Now it ended
a few centimeters inside. The music was gone.
A piece of parchment bearing unknown writing
was tucked against his chest.
After staring into space for a while,
he returned to his journey.

The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 5: Slumber - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c3:
Escaping the basilisk's nest, Kane found night falling.
The wayfinder grass told him of nearby Note village,
so he set off to find lodging. Soon a vast black expanse
opened before him: the sea. Then came a splash and
a young woman's cry. "Someone! Help!"
He ran toward it, lit his torch, and spotted a figure
in the waves. Diving in, he brought her ashore,
gathered scraps of wood, and built a fire.
When he patted her cheek, she awoke. Her long black hair
shone beautifully in the firelight. Her features were not
refined, but her beauty was as startling as a delicate
flower. Kane felt his heart stir.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c4:
Her name was Isabella, a fisherman's daughter from Note.
She had fallen into the sea while gathering shellfish
on the rocks at low tide. Still weak, she let Kane
carry her on his back to the village.
Her elderly parents came out, shocked to see her.
Her mother tended her and took her into a back room.
Her father offered Kane a reward. When he asked
for a night's lodging, the man readily agreed.

The next morning, voices outside woke Kane.
Young men had gathered with flowers and food.
A knock sounded, and Isabella's father entered.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c5:
"You're awake. Was the bed comfortable?"
"Yes, thank you. Who are those men?"
"They've come to see how my daughter is feeling."

Isabella's beauty clearly stood out even here.

"How is she?"
"She seems quite well, thanks to the fire
you built to warm her so quickly."

Breakfast was salt-grilled Himiburi, a rich, delicious
fish. But Kane was too busy thinking of Isabella
to taste much of it.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c6:
By the next morning, Isabella was fully recovered.
Her bright, kind nature explained why every village youth
adored her. Kane was no exception, lingering for days.
His travels had given him knowledge and experience
that made him invaluable to villagers who knew little
of the outside world. When his archery drove a troll
from the road, their respect deepened.
Comfortable as he was, he had to find the Sage's
Greenstone. Despite their pleas, he chose to leave
the next morning. At his farewell feast, Isabella
leaned close as she poured his drink.
"I'll wait on that beach. Let me thank you properly."
Feigning calm, Kane slipped out to where they first met.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c7:
A full moon lit the beach stretching into the bay
between the mountains. Isabella stood where
he had rescued her, holding a lamp.
She gave a little wave when she saw him.
They sat on driftwood, chatting about nothing.
The sea breeze was chilly, and they drew close.
Then a crash came from the village. They turned.
Near the meeting hall stood a troll, easily taller
than a two-story house. Kane ran back to his room
for his bow. Now that it was in the village itself,
he had no choice but to kill it. He wrote magical
charms, tied them to arrows, and headed for the square.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c8:
The troll was ripping roofs off houses. Besides attacking
people, trolls hoarded treasure. There could be little
here, but perhaps it smelled even a few copper coins.
The villagers watched fearfully from a distance.
Kane looked up. The moon was sinking in the west.
He touched his dagger, breathed deeply, and drew it.
"Want treasure? I've got some here!"
The blade glittered in the moonlight. The troll turned,
saw it, and strode toward him. Holding the dagger high,
Kane led it to the village edge.
There he shot a charmed arrow into its shin.
The spell activated, wrapping vines around its leg.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c9:
The vines thickened rapidly. The troll tripped
and fell forward. Kane shot its hands and jaw,
binding them with vines as well.
The distant villagers cheered. "We did it!"
"Not yet! Stay back!"
Roaring, the troll tore at the vines. With seemingly
endless strength, it thrashed and stripped them away.
Kane backed off. The troll ripped free and stood.
Raising his dagger, Kane lured it toward the rocky shore.
"I have to hold it off until sunrise...!"
Trolls turned to stone in sunlight.
He meant to immobilize it until dawn.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r47:c10:
The sky paled. Few arrows remained. Thick vines pinned
the troll among the rocks. It still fought savagely,
though perhaps it was tiring. Then it spotted Isabella.
Hungry, it thrashed harder. "Isabella! Run!"
The vines burst. With startling speed, it raced at her.
Kane shot at her feet, enclosing her in thick vines.
His next arrow struck its leg, toppling it onto the sand.
The roots held poorly there; it soon pulled free.
But Isabella was hidden, and it had lost its meal.
"Over here!" Kane raised the dagger again. Furious
with hunger, it lunged at him. He drew it onto the rocks
and fired his last arrow.
The Tale of the Last Sword, Volume 6: Love's Path - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c3:
Kane wandered aimlessly through an unfamiliar land.
Huge buildings towered around him, and he could not
hide his amazement at the crowds.

"Some kind of fortified city...?
It's a completely different world from my own."

He thought back to what had brought him here.
Could the magic sword in his hand be responsible?
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c4:
THE MAGIC SWORD SEKISHOTUK

Its blade is not particularly long, but shines
a vivid crimson and emits dazzling light in darkness.
That light enchants all who see it,
allowing its wielder to control them at will.
Legend says it once halted the charge
of a gigantic iron boar in an instant.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c5:
Kane was relieved to find the magic sword still
in his hand. The quest for it had been grueling:
perilous roads, powerful monsters,
and countless brushes with death.
He could not easily surrender what he had
finally found after so much hardship.
Even in another world, having it with him
helped him stay calm.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c6:
That did not improve his situation, however.
Just as he grew used to people's strange looks,
a well-built man in a yellow helmet approached.
"Hey. You're not from this world, are you?"

Kane asked how he knew.
"Because I'm not from this world either."

His name was Eiska. By his own account,
he had been a fairly capable wizard.
Kane was amazed to meet someone
who shared his predicament.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c7:
Eiska explained that certain unstable places
in the world sometimes connected
to entirely different worlds.
The place where the sword lay was one of them.
It must have connected to this world
just as Kane picked up the sword, bringing him here.

There was something Kane had wanted to ask
ever since meeting Eiska. The answer might
make all his struggles seem meaningless,
but he could not stay silent.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c8:
Kane asked about the object hanging at Eiska's waist,
identical to the magic sword.
Apparently, the sword originally came from this world.

"Here, take a look."

At Eiska's prompting, he looked around.
Several men carried the same thing.
Here, it was commonplace and had no legendary power.
Only when used in Kane's world
did it become a magic sword.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c9:
Kane was a little disappointed that his prize was so ordinary,
but it remained a magic sword back home.
Perhaps sensing his feelings, Eiska said:
"I'll tell you how to return to our world.
There's a certain facility where you can try it."

They headed there together. On the way,
Kane asked if Eiska would return too.
"I've grown fond of this world.
I'm staying a while longer."
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r48:c10:
At the building, Kane thanked Eiska and said farewell.
Inside were several small cubicles, each with
a water vessel. Following the instructions,
he entered the farthest cubicle and quickly
pulled the lever beside its vessel three times.
The water began to swirl and glow white.
Believing it would take him home,
Kane leaped into the shining vortex.

The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 7: The Magic Sword - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c3:
Even after parting from Eiska, Marlo kept walking:
through unfamiliar towns, over mountains, across rivers,
gazing at the sky, toward the rising sun.
He felt he had traveled a very long time.
When had this journey begun? He could not remember.
Still, he walked on.

One day he reached a barren wasteland without
a single blade of grass. Though he could not recall
when his travels began, he dimly remembered visiting
such a place long ago. When, exactly,
was another thing he could not remember.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c4:
Back then, Marlo had not traveled alone.
Many people had been around him.
He had lived in a great city in a small country,
and thought he had been close to a certain girl.
They met nearly every day, but were not lovers.
They were dear friends bound by a powerful bond.
No: comrades in arms.

Yes, Marlo had apparently fought in a war.
"Apparently," because strangely, he could not
remember it clearly. Yet he and that girl
had certainly fought in a wasteland like this one.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c5:
They belonged to a revolutionary army:
rebels against their own country.
They fought not for peace, but the opposite.
The world, peaceful now, had been an age of warring
states, each eager to expand its territory.
Their own ruler alone disliked conflict.
Having lost his parents to war at a young age,
the king was said to have become timid.
He sought only to protect his little nation
with as few sacrifices as possible.
Now one could travel safely alone. Marlo could
recall little, but that was apparently how it had been.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c6:
"I want to make our country great," the girl said
one day. "It's tiny now, but I want it so large
that nobody will ever mock us."

Her bold, spirited eyes seemed filled
with unshakable resolve.
She, too, had lost her parents in war.
Invading soldiers cut them down while mocking them
as people of a weak nation.
Marlo agreed with her. Perhaps it was sympathy,
but he seemed to have wanted a larger country
so fewer people would suffer as she had.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c7:
They fought their own ruler and crossed blades
with his personal soldiers. The civil war divided
and weakened their country. Powerful neighbors
preyed on it, taking more and more land.
Though they knew this, they believed only a display
of the people's resolve could move their weak king.
The internal fighting never stopped.

One day, during a battle in the wasteland,
Marlo noticed the girl was no longer beside him.
Even when the fighting ended, she did not return.
He searched for her.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c8:
She was crouched behind a rock.
"Uhh..."
Concerned, he peered at her face. She was crying.
"What happened?!"
He took her slender shoulders and shook her.
Through her tears, she answered,
"We were wrong..."

Badly wounded, she had hidden here.
Then the king himself appeared. She tried to draw
her sword, but must have dropped it leaving the battle.
Her scabbard was empty.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c9:
The king neither hurt nor blamed her. He simply
sat beside her, treated her wounds, and said:

"This is not the war I want. The larger a country grows,
the more its king cannot see. He can no longer
seek the happiness of every subject. Such a king
is no king at all. I don't want to become one.
I only want everyone in this little country
I love to live with a smile. That would be enough."

She realized she had overlooked what truly mattered.
As she tried to apologize, a fellow rebel stood
behind him... Beside the weeping girl lay a headless body.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r49:c10:
Marlo dragged those memories from deep within his mind,
yet knew they were not his. He came from a peaceful
rural village and had never known war. He carried
a sword for protection, but preferred magic.
Yet the memories felt real, despite their oddities:
being polished by the girl, being swung by her
in the most literal sense, cutting through human flesh...
"Ah... I see. These are your memories."
He gently touched the old sword at his waist,
his silver companion, still echoing its owner's will
and longing for her. Man and blade traveled on,
unable to recall when their journey began, or why.
The Tale of the Last Sword, Volume 8: Memories - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c3:
Later, Kane sat alone by a cabin window
aboard the airship Ibird, looking out.
The sky was clear blue, with what looked
like a pleasant breeze.
"Hey, mister."
He turned at the sudden call. A girl in a dress
and a pretty hat smiled and held out her hand.
"You can have this."
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c4:
"Hehe. You don't have to look so surprised."
He must have looked badly startled, for the girl laughed.
In her hand was a piece of candy.
He disliked sweets, but saw no reason
to reject her kindness. "Thank you."
She smiled as he took it, then left for the deck.

They still had some time before arrival.
Putting the candy in his pocket,
Kane decided to go out on deck too.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c5:
The passengers were relaxing in their own ways.
The girl was chatting happily with an older man.
Not a shy child, Kane thought.
Then he noticed a young woman clutching the rail
as though about to collapse. "Ahh..."
"W-what's wrong?" he asked instinctively.
"Well... It's embarrassing,
but I'm terribly hungry..."
A pitiful rumble followed.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c6:
"I haven't eaten since yesterday...
I hurried aboard assuming they'd sell food,
but they told me there's nothing like that..."
"I see... But I don't have anything to eat either..."

Then he remembered the candy.

"Wait. Someone gave me this.
If candy would help, please take it."
"R-really?! Thank you...!"

Just then, the little girl returned.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c7:
"Here, miss. This is for you."
With the same bright smile,
she offered the woman another piece of candy.
"Oh? Th-thank you..."
The girl smiled again and walked away.
"Well, I'll gladly accept both your kindnesses..."
Putting one candy happily into her mouth,
the woman asked Kane,
"That girl looks about ten.
Do you think she's traveling alone?"
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c8:
"Gwaaaaaah!"
A man's voice rang out, less a scream
than a cry of agony.
Kane turned. The older man was collapsing,
clutching his chest.
"Uhh... Aaagh..."
Another cry sounded close by.
The young woman had fallen too.
All around, people were dropping.
What was happening?
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c9:
It happened in an instant.
People burst apart, and lizardlike creatures
emerged from within, attacking Kane.
He immediately drew his sword and took his stance.
Fortunately, the creatures were dull-witted
and no match for him now.

Somehow, the sky had clouded and darkened,
and the airship was listing.
Had its pilot become a lizard too?
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r50:c10:
Kane tried to hurry to the cockpit,
but his body floated up, unable to push off the floor.
We're falling...
As he looked outside, the girl hovered in the air.
She smiled at him, then transformed into a silver dragon.
Kane lost consciousness.


The Tale of the Last Sword
Volume 9: The Open Sky - End
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c3:
Kane stood at the place called the end of the world.
Deep in a forest so dense it hid the sky lay a clear lake
and a small shack, lit by the gentle colors of dawn.
The far shore was invisible; the lake was as vast
as a sea. Legend said that beyond it, a waterfall
plunged into the abyss. This truly was the world's edge.

A legendary land no one had ever reached,
a place people thought merely myth or fairy tale.
Kane had traveled in search of it,
and finally arrived yesterday.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c4:
Last night, Kane had pitched his tent by the lake,
but had not slept inside.
In this remote, uninhabited land,
stars filled the entire sky.
He lay down in the grass to watch them
and looked back on his life.

All those days wandering the world
before reaching the place he sought.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c5:
Once, he had taken the life of a brave young elf
who lived in the forest. He recalled the elf had loved
a girl, yet died without ever meeting her.
At another time, he wondered if what he sought
lay beyond the earth, and ventured into space.
There he became a soldier for the first time.
Inexperience made it hard, but effort eventually
raised Kane to vice admiral. Space life was enjoyable.

He also recalled a strange village beneath another lake.
A creature shaped like a mushroom house almost ate him.
Its flesh had been wonderfully delicious.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c6:
He had plunged into a blazing, truly heated battle,
thinking perhaps only the strong could reach his goal.
There he met his owner's long-lost brother.
Learning that they shared the same wish deeply moved him.

Once, beautiful music lured him into unconsciousness.
He awoke in a pot over a fire. A strange experience.
What did the writing on that mysterious parchment mean?
He had no way to find out now.

He had loved a fisherman's beautiful daughter,
and she had loved him. So much time had passed.
What life had she led? Kane hoped she had been happy.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c7:
He had even become a magic sword that controlled
all who saw it, wondering whether his destination
lay in another world. It did not. Once shown the way
back, he appealed to his young owner's will to return.

One young man sensed his thoughts like telepathy.
That surprised Kane: in his usual form,
he could not communicate with humans. They traveled
together for years. He still remembered that man
as often as the girl who had once wielded him.
He recalled the color of the airship girl's candy, too.
Had a proud dragon done all that to show humans,
who dared take to the sky, who truly ruled it?
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c8:
Remembering all this under the stars, Kane meant
to stay awake on his final night of travel.
Yet he fell asleep without even a dream,
on his last night in human form.
He woke early in the chilly air and gazed at the lake.
After a deep breath, he rose and opened the shack.
Inside were a simple table, chair, bed, and cupboard.
One person could have lived there, but no one remained.
Dust filled a room untouched for years.
On the table lay one worn, age-weathered sheet:

"We, the Waterfolk, await the swords.
May their power bring salvation through the lake god."
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c9:
The world's edge had once been a small, advanced village.
Its peaceful people, grateful for the lake and forest,
were called the Waterfolk. An invasion shattered
their peace. Unwarlike, they soon faced destruction.
At the end, they placed their hopes in an old legend:
"Long ago, ten sacred swords were forged here.
Scattered across the world, they shall return
in our hour of need and empower the lake god."
A few survivors built a hut deep in the forest,
protected by a barrier, and lived praying to the swords.

"I'm sorry I took so long," Kane whispered.
common/csv/reading_material.csh.r51:c10:
Yes, he was a sword: one of the sacred blades forged here
long ago. He knew nothing of his nine siblings' fate,
but he had returned. With the power his Waterfolk smith
bestowed, he traveled sometimes as a man, sometimes
as a blade. Finding his now-legendary homeland took
many years, but he had come safely home.
Now he would sleep long as a sword within this hut.
He could choose the spell that would next awaken him.
Last night's memories offered an idea. Kane grinned.
"Honerarino funarama."
His metallic voice rang out; dazzling light filled the area.
When it faded, only a worn sheet and a battered sword remained.
The Tale of the Last Sword, Final Volume: Silence - End

common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k6: Just the right heat! Chicken Minister: Chili!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k7:
One of Chicken Minister's most popular flavors pairs rich chicken thigh with the exciting kick of chili powder.
The powder goes into both the marinade and the coating. Imported red chilies and several spices are blended using our very own special process.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k10: 100 million a year! Classic Soy Sauce!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k11:
Our undisputed classic has topped the sales charts ever since Chicken Minister launched. We improve the recipe a little each year, always striving for better quality and flavor.
Seasoned with naturally brewed soy sauce made from Japanese organic soybeans, it has a crowd-pleasing taste you never tire of.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k15:
This Chicken Minister uses a marinade made with delicious, high-quality milk from our partner farms across Japan.
Milk adds a mellow richness, allowing us to use less salt than in our other Chicken Minister flavors.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k19:
Strawberries are at their best in spring, and we've created a Chicken Minister flavor to celebrate!
Coarsely crushed strawberry flesh combines with savory chicken for a refreshing balance of sweetness and tang. Sprinkle on the strawberry sesame salt provided at the counter for even more berry flavor!
The perfect companion for a spring outing!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k22: The taste of your most precious memories
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k23:
Wonderful memories with you.
Times of pain, times of joy, all so precious.
Yet even our most vivid memories
will one day fade and be forgotten.
The future always comes, changing what we remember.
Still, I want to hold on to this moment a little longer.

Make your memories just a little stronger
with Chicken Minister: Special Memories.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k27:
I've been thinking of you all this time.
We met by chance.
Before I knew it, you meant the world to me.
But I couldn't find the words, and it hurt.
I ached for you and felt so helpless.
As the time to part drew near,
I finally managed to give you a letter.
Your reply made me so happy.
I'm truly happy now.
I can't wait to see you again.
Currents that bring us together. Chicken Minister: Whirlpool.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k31:
Something I've never told anyone else.
Now you alone know.
Please keep it between us.

The thrill of sharing a secret.
A grown-up taste with just a little spice.
Chicken Minister: Secret.

common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k35:
Wish you could enjoy autumn's delicious Pacific saury all year?
Chicken Minister: Pacific Saury is finally here to answer your wish!
Flakes of grilled saury are mixed into the chicken, while broth made from its backbone enriches the marinade.
Each luxurious bite uses an entire fish!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k38: Back this year! Legendary Bird Flavor!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k39:
Chicken Minister made with the legendary local breed, the Nameless Chicken, returns for a limited time!
Raised strong and free to roam, these birds yield superb thigh meat.
Firm and springy, it fills your mouth with a hearty, rustic flavor that deepens with every bite.

*Limited quantities. Some stores may sell out.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k42: The hottest in the universe! Blazing Red!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k43:
The Andromeda chili is said to be the hottest pepper in the universe.
This spring, it invades as Chicken Minister: Blazing Red!
It boasts about 120 times the heat of our Chili Flavor, according to our own tests.
One bite sends sweat pouring down like a waterfall, a sight said to rival the Milky Way glittering in the night sky...
Can you take the heat?

*Small children, pregnant customers, older customers, and anyone sensitive to spice should take care.

He takes the train to the newspaper office and arrives safely, without incident!
He meets his friendly colleagues, and the workday ends with nothing unusual happening!
On his way to the company dorm, he stops at a pub for delicious local fish!
Back at the dorm, he takes a relaxing bath and sleeps soundly!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k51:
Has your household fire extinguisher expired?
Using an expired extinguisher can cause unexpected, dangerous accidents. Cartridge-operated extinguishers in particular may rupture and cause serious injury.
Stored-pressure extinguishers avoid such ruptures and have handles that are easy to squeeze, even with limited strength.
Choose stored pressure when replacing your extinguisher!
*Replace expired stored-pressure extinguishers promptly, too.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k54: Rare! Aya Suzumura radio audience ticket!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k55:
Aya Suzumura is a talented young singer-songwriter who shot to fame. This ticket admits you to a live public broadcast of her radio show, Aya Suzumura's Midnight Sky Garden.
Along with a mini piano concert, enjoy popular segments "Suzumura the Swordswoman Slices Through Your Problems" and "Aya's Innovative Gourmet"!
*Because this is a late-night program, minors cannot attend.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k58: The hit series! Two lives bound by fate!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k59:
The previous book, Hard Boys WS, sold an unprecedented 500,000 copies for its genre. Now the story moves to Nanahata High's swim club! Follow star player Hikozawa, his troublemaking friend Ushida, and Ushida's rival Oribe through the trials of youth. Ushida's confession of his secret love for Hikozawa will bring tears to your eyes.
In the second half, Hikozawa and Oribe carry the wishes of the late Ushida in their hearts as each pursues the national high school tournament. Don't miss Keisuke from the previous book, who returns as a rival and a cyborg water polo player!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k62: Two classic sandwiches in one pack!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k63:
A ham-and-lettuce sandwich paired with an egg salad sandwich.
Our carefully raised pork becomes ham cured for a full year. Its savory saltiness is a perfect match for crisp lettuce grown with reduced pesticide use.
The egg salad sandwich is generously filled with creamy salad made from boiled, chopped eggs laid by healthy hens.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k66: Lasts eight hours! Easy to apply by yourself!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k67:
Koshini-Cool is a cooling patch for pain and inflammation. It works on more than just lower backs!
Thin, light, and long-lasting: one patch works for eight hours. Our unique stacking technology extends that to 64 hours with two patches, or 512 hours with three!
Our self-guiding sheet even lets you apply it to your back with one hand. No help needed, anytime!
Buy now and get one extra patch free!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k70: A piggy bank with a special sound
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k71:
This ceramic piggy bank holds about 50,000 yen in 500-yen coins.
We carefully select our clay for the sound coins make when dropped inside. Our proprietary equipment handles everything from kneading to firing, creating a texture that feels handcrafted.
Also available: the Large Piggy Bank, with room for 600,000 yen!
For a limited time, every purchase comes with a factory tour ticket!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k75:
Made with high-quality orange juice from California.
Our Orange Juice is celebrating its 50th anniversary!
Thanks to your enthusiastic support over the years, it has become an orange juice classic. We will keep making products you can drink with confidence.

For commercial customers, we offer not only 350 ml cans but also 18-liter barrels and 2,000-liter tanks.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k79:
A classic single-breasted, two-button jacket with flat-front trousers.
Its balanced silhouette suits any occasion. Careful tailoring extends to the lining, pockets, and every detail.
Two pairs of trousers make this set excellent value and help keep you fresh through summer.

The jacket's slit cuffs are designed with keyboard use in mind.
The skirt's clean lines flatter your figure, while stretch fabric keeps it comfortable and easy to move in.
Machine washable at home, making everyday wardrobe changes a breeze!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k87:
A men's cardigan and chinos in a classic silhouette.
The cardigan is durable, comfortable, and machine washable at home.
The slightly slim chinos use stretch fabric for an easy, versatile fit.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k91:
A long cardigan and short culotte skirt, perfect for spring.
The knitted cardigan keeps chilly days at bay, with varied stitching for lasting appeal.
The culotte skirt's soft fabric and flowing silhouette make it comfortable and easy to mix and match.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k95: A green hooded jacket paired with cargo pants. The outer layer is light yet wind-resistant, making it ideal for everyday wear. The relaxed cargo pants are light and durable, perfect for active days out.
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k99: A blue spring hoodie paired with a short striped skirt. The hoodie has just the right softness and stretch for superb comfort. The miniskirt flatters your legs, and its soft fabric lets you move freely. An outfit that makes you want to go out!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k102:
A coordinated flannel shirt and jeans set.

The soft, comfortable jeans have a classic design with a washed finish.
Our customer appreciation sale pushes prices to the limit! Try this set while the offer lasts!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k106:
A women's long-sleeved blouse paired with jeans.

We're clearing stock, so this set is a real bargain. Get yours now!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k109: Make a bold impression with punk style!

A white collared shirt paired with flashy plaid flap trousers and belts. Three striking belts are sure to turn heads! Open the ankle zippers for a boot-cut shape that makes your legs look longer.
Recommended for anyone seeking cool style without limits.

A leather jacket, camisole, and shorts make a daring outfit with leather appeal to spare!

Remove the camisole straps to wear it as a tube top!
Wear the set together or mix the pieces. Enjoy your own punk look!
common/lua/item_ad_text.luc.0:k116: Like new! Genuine men's police uniform!

common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r0:c7: Now I must say "goodbye" to you...\nNo. I must say "I'm sorry."
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r1:c7: I am not Yuki Kono, who lives on this planet.\nI am a consciousness that wanders the cosmos.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r2:c7: I have traveled the cosmos for ages. In one star system,\na mighty shadow hunted and wounded me, and I needed rest.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r3:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you on your way home from work.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r4:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you on your way home from your classes.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r5:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you heading into the city, full of energy.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r6:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you wandering the city with no particular aim.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r7:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you on your way home from work.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r8:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you on your way home from your classes.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r9:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you heading into the city, full of energy.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r10:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you wandering the city with no particular aim.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r11:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you heading into the city, bursting with energy.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r12:c7: So I stopped at this planet,\nand found you heading into the city, bursting with energy.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r13:c7: While I rested, I needed someone to protect me.\nSo I entrusted you with "power."
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r14:c7: I could not give you enough power to drive the shadows away,\nbut it was all I could spare.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r15:c7: From her thoughts, I took the form of one "Yuki Kono,"\nand altered your memories so you would want to protect me.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r16:c7: From her thoughts, I took the form of one "Yuki Kono,"\nand altered your memories, hoping you'd want to protect me.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r17:c7: Until my power returned, I hid within Yuki Kono's thoughts,\ntrying to escape the shadows.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r18:c7: The "shadow" covets the knowledge and power I have gathered.\nIt would use them to rule the universe.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r19:c7: I cannot let the shadow capture me.\nYet even on this planet, shadows appeared one after another.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r20:c7: Through it all... my time with you was truly fascinating.\nYou always looked after Yuki Kono so kindly.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r21:c7: Through it all... my time with you was truly fascinating.\nLittle by little, you were drawn to Yuki Kono.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r22:c7: Through it all... my time with you was truly fascinating.\nYou got terribly worked up over Yuki Kono.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r23:c7: I never expected the people of this planet\nto try to take your life...
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r24:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your cat impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r25:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your dog impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r26:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your chicken impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r27:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your wolf impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r28:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your baseball announcer impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r29:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your bush warbler impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r30:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your cicada impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r31:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your boiling kettle impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r32:c7: I'm glad we managed to escape.\nAnd your answering machine impression was very good.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r33:c7: I'm glad we escaped. But it's a shame I never got to hear\nyour Spiral Hercules Chameleon impression.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r34:c7: Come to think of it, we ate some enormous food, too.\nThank you for eating my share.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r35:c7: Then you leapt into the flames, heedless of the danger.\nYou were very dependable.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r36:c7: Then you used your power to pull me out of the flames.\nYou were very dependable.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r37:c7: Then you panicked beyond the flames and seemed helpless,\nbut I could feel how much you cared for me.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r38:c7: Then I saw you laughing loudly beyond the flames.\nI remember feeling deeply uneasy and irritated.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r39:c7: At the hospital, when we happened upon Yuki Kono's family,\nI learned how strongly her feelings were stirred.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r40:c7: Fearing the shadow hunting me would endanger her family,\nI leapt to a small boat far out at sea.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r41:c7: But the shadow's pursuit never ceased.\nIt even rose from the bottom of the sea.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r42:c7: So, to keep the shadow from finding me,\nI tried to hide my consciousness as deeply as I could.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r43:c7: While I was hidden,\nI let Yuki Kono's own thoughts guide her actions.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r44:c7: ...When the people of this planet attacked you,\nYuki Kono tried to protect you.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r45:c7: ...When you cowed this planet's people with your power,\nYuki Kono was trying to protect you.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r46:c7: ...When the people of this planet attacked you,\nYuki Kono tried desperately to protect you.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r47:c7: Yuki began to act in ways beyond my expectations.\nYuki Kono was supposed to be the one you protected.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r48:c7: But she came to see you as someone she wanted to protect,\neven at the risk of her own life.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r49:c7: Even so, I remember how reassuring it was to see the trust\nbetween you and Yuki Kono, each caring for the other.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r50:c7: Though she felt that way, you abandoned her.\nBut I was relieved to see that you wanted to apologize.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r51:c7: Though she felt that way, you abandoned her.\nBut I was relieved to learn you longed to see her again.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r52:c7: Though she felt that way, you abandoned her.\nBut I was relieved to learn you missed her enough to cry.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r53:c7: Though she felt that way, you abandoned her.\nBut I was relieved you wanted to hold her and never let go.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r54:c7: Though she felt that way, you abandoned her.\nBut seeing you grovel on the floor only made me pity you.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r55:c7: Though she felt that way, you abandoned her.\nBut your fierce wish for a kiss somehow won me over then.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r56:c7: When you pointed at the web writer in that eerie institute,\nI felt I was seeing the honest, real you.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r57:c7: When you pointed at Yuki Kono in that eerie institute,\nit made her very sad, you know.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r58:c7: When you pointed at yourself in that eerie institute,\nyou seemed dependable, but I was a little worried.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r59:c7: ...Until now, I had always traveled alone.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r60:c7: And of all my travels, this planet was the most fascinating.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r61:c7: W&P's idea of exploiting the "power," and their obsession,\nwere a threat unlike any shadow I had faced before...
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r62:c7: Your bond with Yuki Kono, each protecting the other,\nwas fascinating, too.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r63:c7: How your seemingly haphazard choices\nstill led to good outcomes was fascinating, too.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r64:c7: Your tangled thoughts when you handed Yuki over to W&P\nto save yourself were also most fascinating.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r65:c7: We made our way through sewers and went to so many places.\nNow they are all fond memories.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r66:c7: Our time together was short,\nbut it became very precious to me.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r67:c7: I apologize to Yuki Kono, whose form I borrowed,\nfor rousing her, as it were, from her eternal sleep.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r68:c7: I am grateful for all you did for me.\nThanks to you, I regained my power.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r69:c7: Your quick thinking saved me many times.\nYou were very dependable.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r70:c7: Your progress with the "power" was remarkable.\nYou were very dependable.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r71:c7: Your unexpected actions surprised me again and again.\nIt was a lot of fun.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r72:c7: I'm glad it was you who protected me.\nI'm glad this was the planet I came down to.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r73:c7: ...Now, it is time for me to return to my journey.
common/csv/staffroll_image.csh.r74:c7: Produced by BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment Inc.
